factCheck.note: The values ​​are the same as the evaluation date and unit stated in the original text. ‘The lowest in almost four years’ is the expression used by Reuters regarding the SGX December contract of $86.9 on November 17, and the closing price on the 23rd was $88.85. The dollar conversion of Dalian 654 yuan is 98.02 dollars, which is the value used by Reuters, and is different from the standard yuan exchange rate (6.7128) on the same day in the decimal point. Port inventory is based on 35 ports counted by SMM, and Mysteel counts 47 ports separately, so the numbers are different even on the same day (173.2 million tons on October 8). China's crude steel production of 70.83 million tons is the October value reported on November 20, and the China Customs General Administration's January to October iron ore import of 1.060.55 billion tons is the value announced on November 10. Guinea's exports of 'more than 5 million tons' in October were quoted by SMM as government data, and the first decimal place was not disclosed, and the accumulated 22 million tons this year and 8.9 million tons in the third quarter were not simply added up due to different aggregation ranges. Simandou's 2027 sales of 26.99 million tons is the average forecast of analysts disclosed by Rio Tinto, not company guidance, and the difference from production of 30.83 million tons is due to the timing of inventory and sales recognition. The rail and port transportation capacity of 72 million tons is the current capacity reported by MINING.COM, and the forecasts of S&P Global CERA (over 5 years) and Fernley Securities (2028) are different regarding when the annual target of 120 million tons will be achieved. POSCO's dollar unit price of $85 and $248 is the quarterly average based on Platts published in the quarterly report, and the won unit price is the purchase price per ton in the same report (131,000 won for iron ore and 342,000 won for coking coal). The 2025 value is an annual average, so the quarterly value and base period are different, and 27.6%·1.5% is a calculation that compares the two values. The increase in raw material price of KRW 214 billion, selling price of KRW 180 billion, and cost of KRW 159 billion are based on Hanwha Investment & Securities' analysis of POSCO's third quarter performance and are not the amounts disclosed by the company by item. The securities firm also predicts a 14% decrease in raw material costs in 2027. Australian PLV of $273.60 was assessed on November 18, and the standard is different from the average of $267 in October and $278 in September. '49 mines closed' is a figure compiled by Mysteel as of November 23, and it is also based on the same report that more than 200 mines were shut down for safety inspections after the Shanxi accident in May. Korea's annual iron ore imports of 70 million tons and Gwangyang Port's 45-50% are column values ​​quoted from Clarkson Research and could not be compared with the original data from the Korea Customs Service. 'Full import' is based on the industry's explanation that domestic iron mines are virtually not in operation due to profitability issues, and its scope is different from the entire supply and demand of iron sources, including inventory and scrap.

title: Ten days of leave expire on Dec 31 — one letter sent in July decides whether they are worth 1,148,320 won
deck: The leave accrued this year expires in 35 days. If the employer did not send a written demand inside the window set by Article 61 of the Labor Standards Act — the ten days after the six-month mark, July 1-10 this year — the unused days are not leave the company extinguished but wages the worker can claim for three years. Since Oct 8, 2026, the statutory penalty for unpaid wages has risen to up to five years in prison or a 50 million won fine.
author: Insight Brief Editorial Room
summary: Article 60 of the Labor Standards Act gives 15 days of paid leave to a worker with at least 80% attendance over a year, and one more day for every two years of continuous service beyond the first, up to 25 days for those with three years or more. Leave not used within a year expires, unless the worker could not use it for reasons attributable to the employer.

To avoid paying for unused leave, an employer must follow the promotion procedure in Article 61: a written demand within ten days of the six-month mark, then, if the worker does not answer within ten days, a written notice designating the dates by two months before the period ends. On a calendar-year cycle that window this year was July 1-10.

Without that procedure the unused days become a wage claim with a three-year limitation period. The amount is one day's ordinary wage times the unused days, and an en banc Supreme Court ruling on Dec 19, 2024 brought regular bonuses conditional on continued employment into the ordinary wage. From Oct 8, 2026, the penalty for unpaid wages rose to up to five years or 50 million won.
body:
Thirty-five days remain until Dec 31, 2026. At workplaces that run annual leave on a calendar-year basis, the period for using this year's leave ends that day. Article 60(7) of the Labor Standards Act provides that leave not taken within a year expires. What disappears that day is the leave; whether the leave had already become wages is decided by other provisions.

![A desk calendar with the last day circled in red pen, a stack of unsigned leave-request forms, an unsealed envelope and a pay slip blurred out. Image · AI illustration](/assets/img/articles/annual-leave-dec31-unused-pay-3years-2026.jpg)

## What disappears on Dec 31

Article 60(1) gives 15 days of paid leave to a worker who attends at least 80% of the year. Paragraph 2 gives one day for each full month to a worker with less than a year of service, or less than 80% attendance. Paragraph 4 adds one day for every two years of continuous service beyond the first year to a worker of three years or more, capped at 25 days in total including the added days.

Paragraph 7 says the leave expires if not used within a year, then adds that this does not apply where the worker could not use it for reasons attributable to the employer. That sentence, which carves out an exception to expiry, is where the calculation that follows begins.

The reach of these provisions is defined too. Articles 60 and 61 do not apply to workplaces with four or fewer regular employees (Table 1 of the Enforcement Decree). At a workplace under five employees, the employment contract and the rules of employment are the standard.

## Did the company send a letter in July?

An employer that wants to avoid paying for unused leave must follow the promotion procedure in Article 61. For a worker with a year or more of service, the employer must notify the worker of the remaining days and demand in writing, within ten days of the six-month mark before the period ends, that the worker set the dates. On a calendar-year cycle, that window this year was July 1 to 10.

If the worker does not answer within ten days of the demand, the employer must designate the dates and notify in writing again by two months before the period ends, which was Oct 31. Both steps must be in writing, and a step taken after the deadline has no effect. A verbal request, a company notice or an alert in the HR system is hard to count as completing the procedure.

Even if the procedures are followed, there are exceptions. If an employee comes to work on a vacation day designated by the company, but the company orders work without clearly stating its intention to refuse to receive labor, the obligation to pay allowances for that day remains (Supreme Court decision 2019Da279283, February 27, 2020).

Without the letter in July, the remaining leave is not leave the company extinguished but leave the worker could not use. From the day after the period ends, those days become a claim for wages.

## The money left behind lasts three years

Pay for unused annual leave is wages. Article 49 of the Labor Standards Act applies a three-year limitation period, which runs from the day after it is settled that the leave was not taken within a year of the right arising. For 2026 leave the claim arises on Jan 1, 2027, and the limitation period is complete once Dec 31, 2029 passes.

The calculation differs for a worker who leaves. The employer must settle wages and other payments within 14 days of the date of resignation (Article 36), and the claim for leave accrued in the final year arises the day after the employment relationship ends. The labour ministry's counselling service gives the same guidance: payment within 14 days of resignation, and a three-year limitation period from the day the claim arises.

## Why the same ten days is worth more

The amount is one day's ordinary wage multiplied by the unused days. For a 40-hour week, the monthly ordinary wage is divided by 209 hours, including paid weekly rest, to get an hourly rate, which is multiplied by the eight contractual hours of a day. On a monthly ordinary wage of 3 million won, the hourly rate is 14,354 won, a day is 114,832 won and ten days are 1,148,320 won (rounded to the won).

What changes the amount is what is included in the numerator, the regular monthly wage. The Supreme Court removed ‘fixity’ from the standard for determining ordinary wages in a unanimous decision (2020da247190) on December 19, 2024. Regular bonuses paid only to those who are employed on the payment date are included in ordinary wages if they are paid regularly and uniformly in return for regular work.

For a worker receiving a regular bonus of 3 million won a year, the monthly ordinary wage rises to 3.25 million won. The hourly rate becomes 15,550 won, a day 124,401 won and ten days 1,244,010 won. The same ten days is 95,690 won more expensive. Overtime, night and holiday premiums and notice pay use the same hourly rate, so they rise together.

The scope is not wide. The new rule applies to statutory allowances for work performed after the ruling, and work up to Dec 18, 2024 is calculated under the old standard. Of performance pay, only a minimum amount guaranteed regardless of grade enters the ordinary wage; the part that varies with results does not.

## The penalty that changed on Oct 8

The amended Labor Standards Act (Act No. 21533), in force since Oct 8, 2026, raised the statutory penalty for unpaid wages from up to three years in prison or a 30 million won fine to up to five years or 50 million won. The provision also moved from Article 109 to Article 107, which now carries a clause barring prosecution against the victim's explicit wish, with an exception for employers whose names have been published as repeat offenders.

Not paying leave pay violates the duty to pay wages (Article 43) and to settle payments on resignation (Article 36), so it falls under this provision. Penalties follow the law in force when the act was done, and wages are breached only once the payment date passes, so the higher penalty applies to wages whose payment date fell after Oct 8. Failing to grant the leave itself is handled separately under Article 110, at up to two years or 20 million won.

## Three things to check first

Start with how many days you have. The number differs: one day a month below a year of service, 15 days at a year, and added days from three years. Enter your hire date and a reference date in section 2 of Insight Brief's [payroll and labour calculator](https://insightbriefnews.com/salary.html) and it returns the days accrued.

Then three things: whether your workplace runs leave on a calendar year or from the hire date, whether you received a written demand in July, and whether the hourly rate on your pay slip was worked out from base pay alone. What disappears on Dec 31 is ten days on a calendar; these three decide whether those ten days became wages.

factCheck.title: Fact check & calculation basis
factCheck.note: The calculation of the annual leave use period varies depending on the workplace. The calculations for December 31 and July 1 to 10 in the main text are based on the assumption that workplaces operate annual leave based on the fiscal year (January 1 to December 31), and in workplaces based on the date of employment, the same procedure moves before and after the date of employment. The example amounts (3 million won, 3.25 million won, 1,148,320 won, 1,244,010 won for 10 days) are self-calculated by rounding and multiplying the daily normal wage to the nearest won, and the actual payment amount varies depending on the normal wage and average wage standards set by employment rules, working hours, and number of unused days. The completion of the statute of limitations for claims for allowances for 2026 (December 31, 2029) is calculated based on the date of occurrence of claims as January 1, 2027. The statutory penalty increase will apply to wages that are due after October 8, 2026, and violations prior to that will follow the previous statutory penalty (3 years, 30 million won).

title: Coin taxation pushed to January 2029, all that remains is December 9 and ‘Is it 3 or 5 years?’
deck: On November 5, the government announced that it would postpone virtual asset income taxation by two years to January 2029 and pursue a three-year carryover deduction for losses. On November 17, it was agreed to maintain the basic deduction of 2.5 million won, but the legal effective date is still January 1, 2027. The regular National Assembly ends on December 9, and the plenary session is scheduled for December 1, 2, and 9.
author: Insight Brief Editorial Room
tags: Amendment to the Income Tax Act
summary: On November 5, 2026, the government announced a plan to postpone virtual asset income taxation for two years to January 1, 2029, and carry forward deductions for losses for three years. On November 9, 10 people, including Representative Ahn Do-geol, proposed the government bill as legislation (bill number 2222597), and on November 11, the Tax Subcommittee tentatively agreed to a postponement, but postponed the resolution.

On November 17, it was agreed to maintain the basic deduction at the current 2.5 million won. The remaining issues are the loss carryover deduction period (3 years for the government vs. 5 years for the opposition party) and the timing and scope of submission of exchange tax data. The National Tax Service's tax notice is on hold until discussions on deferment are completed.

Until the law is revised, the statutory effective date is January 1, 2027. The regular National Assembly ends on December 9, and the plenary session is scheduled for December 1, 2, and 9, so whether it is processed within the year determines the start of taxation in 2027 and the base date of the acquisition price (late 2026 vs. late 2028).
body:
After the Income Tax Act defined income from the transfer and rental of virtual assets as other income in December 2020, this taxation was postponed three times. On November 5, 2026, the government issued a fourth moratorium. The effective date will be two years later, from January 1, 2027 to January 1, 2029. However, what has now been confirmed is the government policy and the provisional agreement of the National Assembly Standing Committee. Until the law changes, the statutory effective date is still January 1, 2027.

## What is confirmed and what is not?

On November 5, Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Finance and Economy Lee Hyung-il announced at a briefing at the Seoul Government Complex a two-year deferral, a three-year carryover deduction for investment losses, and the formation of a public-private joint working group. There are two reasons for this. The automatic exchange of cryptographic asset information (CARF) with the United States will not begin until 2029, and the market discipline will change with the enactment of the Digital Asset Act.

On November 9, 10 people, including Democratic Party of Korea lawmaker Ando-geol, proposed a government bill in the form of legislation by lawmakers (bill number 2222597). Along with the change in the enforcement date, losses will be carried forward for 3 years, and virtual asset business operators will be required to submit transaction data from 2027. On November 11, the Tax Subcommittee of the Finance and Economy Committee confirmed that there was no disagreement with the postponement, but did not pass a decision. On November 17, it was agreed to abandon the plan to raise the basic deduction to 50 million won and maintain the current level of 2.5 million won. The remaining issues are the carryover deduction period (3 years vs. 5 years) and the method of submitting transaction data.

|items|Current Income Tax Act|Suspension plan (under review by the National Assembly)|
|---|---|---|
|Effective date|2027.1.1. Subsequent transfer and rental|2029.1.1. After|
|Income classification|Separate taxation of other income|Maintain|
|Basic deduction|2.5 million won per year|Maintained at 2.5 million won (agreed on 11.17)|
|Tax rate|20% + 2% local income tax|Maintain|
|Loss Carryover|None (only profit and loss for the same year)|3-year carryover (government plan), parallel discussion on 5-year plan|
|Base date of acquisition price|2026.12.31. The larger amount between the market price and the actual acquisition price|Moved to 2028.12.31 (government explanation)|
|First report|May 2028|May 2030|

## Why January 1, 2027 is still alive

The statutory enforcement date remains the same until the National Assembly revises the Income Tax Act. The regular National Assembly ends on December 9, and the plenary session is scheduled for December 1, 2, and 9. As of November 25, there are 26 bills submitted to the plenary session, and due to the filibuster, there is no agreement between the ruling and opposition parties on the scope and order of processing. The tax law revision bill is scheduled to be submitted to the plenary session in early December along with the budget, so the Tax Subcommittee must complete its review by the end of this month. Even after holding five subcommittees as of November 20, no conclusion has been reached.

Administrative preparations are also at a standstill. The National Tax Service planned to prepare a notice containing the calculation of income amount, calculation of acquisition price, and designation of business by market notification by the end of October, and to issue an administrative notice from November 30 to December 20. The process was put on hold as the ruling party requested that it be postponed until the conclusion of the postponement. If the National Assembly is unable to process it within the year, the implementation date and detailed standards will come at the same time.

## 3 years or 5 years?

The government and ruling party insist on a 3-year carryover period, while the opposition party insists on a 5-year carryover period. Financial investment income tax is designed to be carried forward for 5 years, and business income losses are, in principle, 15 years. The US and UK carry forward capital losses without any period limit. Japan is reforming its taxation system to be similar to that of financial products and is pushing for a three-year carryover. The government is sticking to the three-year limit, citing the fact that carrying forward losses creates an exception to the system.

## The base date is moved

The current law considers the acquisition price of the holding before taxation to be the larger of the market price on December 31, 2026 and the actual acquisition price. If implementation is pushed back to 2029, this base date will also be moved to December 31, 2028 (government explanation). There is no need to determine the valuation profit at the end of 2026, but instead, the price change until the end of 2028 becomes the tax base. For quantities for which the actual acquisition price cannot be proven, a rule is applied that deems a certain percentage (up to 50%) of the transfer price as necessary expenses.

## Burden in numbers

Subtract 2.5 million won from annual net profit and multiply by 22%. Net profit of 10 million won is 1.65 million won, 20 million won is 3.85 million won, and 50 million won is 10.45 million won. The biggest complaint with the current structure was that the loss from the year in which the loss occurred could not be carried over to the next year. This is why the government bundled carryover deductions with deferral.

## Remaining schedule

If the law is passed, the government will create a system improvement plan by the first half of 2027 and submit it to the regular National Assembly in 2027, and detailed tax standards will be announced in the first half of 2028. The first report of 2029 imputed income is May 2030. The risk that experts point out is the time between standard confirmation and computer construction. Bitplanet Research Lab calculated that if the standard is confirmed in June 2028, it will take 9 to 11 months just to build the exchange system, which will be about 3 months short of the implementation date.

## Reporting Memo

This article was written based on government announcements, National Assembly review reports, and National Tax Service guidance released until the morning of November 26, 2026. The postponement is in the implementation stage and is not confirmed until it is passed and announced by the plenary session. The tax amount example and 2.5 million won/22% structure are simple calculations based on the provisions of the current Income Tax Act, and the actual tax amount varies depending on necessary expenses and incidental expenses. The carryover deduction period and transaction data submission scope are pending as of November 20.

factCheck.note: As of the report on November 20th, the final resolution of the tax subcommittee has not yet been made, and reports of its passage in the plenary session have not been confirmed until the morning of November 26th. Deferral and carry-over deductions are not final laws, but are in the stage of government policy and provisional agreement by the standing committee. Examples of tax amounts (10 million won, 1.65 million won, 20 million won, 3.85 million won, 50 million won, 10.45 million won) are internal figures calculated as (net profit - 2.5 million won) x 22%, and vary depending on necessary expenses, incidental expenses and profit and loss results. title: 4,053,137 won and 11,042,071 won — the AI price table only hardens in 2028
deck: The Korea AI and Software Industry Association (KOSA) published an 'AI Project Pricing Reference (Draft)' on Nov 24. It maps 18 AI jobs onto the 17 existing rows of average SW technician wages: an AI test engineer lands in the IT tester row (4,053,137 won a month) and an AI quality-verification specialist in the IT quality manager row (11,042,071 won), though both work the same verification stage. The guide takes them in only in 2028, while the 2027 government AI budget of 16.4 trillion won is being tendered already.
author: Insight Brief Editorial Room
summary: KOSA published an 'AI Project Pricing Reference (Draft)' on Nov 24 that splits the cost of an AI build project into five items and creates a new 'AI-specific technology element' line. It is a separate annex, not a formal revision of the SW Project Pricing Guide.

The 18 AI jobs get no new wage table; each is mapped to one of the 17 existing average-wage rows. An AI model architect goes to IT architect (11,103,230 won a month), an AI model developer doing fine-tuning to system SW developer (5,840,196 won), an AI test engineer to IT tester (4,053,137 won) and an AI quality-verification specialist to IT quality manager (11,042,071 won).

Quantitative criteria are due in 2027 and the guide reflects them from 2028. The 2027 government AI budget is 16.4 trillion won in the government's proposal, with the science ministry's share up 84.3% to 9.4211 trillion won.
body:
At the 2026 SW Project Pricing Seminar held at POSCO Tower Yeoksam in Seoul on Nov 24, the Korea AI and Software Industry Association (KOSA) put out two documents: an 'AI·SW Project Pricing Improvement Roadmap' setting out how to price AI work, and an 'AI Project Pricing Reference (Draft)' meant for use in the field. It is not a revision of the SW Project Pricing Guide but a separate annex placed beside it.

![In a corridor where an enormous ledger lies open like terraced steps, two people in identical work clothes stand at different heights of the ledger. A thin red line joins the vertical distance between them. Image · AI illustration](/assets/img/articles/ai-project-wage-table-18-jobs-2028.jpg)

## The project cost split into five lines

The reference defines the cost of an AI build project as the sum of five items: service usage fees (LLM subscriptions and the like), customization work (data building, model training), the AI-specific technology element, AI system development and AI infrastructure. The new line is the third. Work that brings in specialist skills such as building RAG (retrieval-augmented generation), fine-tuning an LLM or running MLOps was hard to separate under the function point (FP) method. This line exists to price that work separately on a man-month basis. KOSA explains that with no AI job definitions, bidders and contracting agencies have argued over which average wage applies.

> "Rather than adopting any single method uniformly, we will improve AI project pricing on the principle of reflecting verified elements step by step." — Kim Kyu-il, team leader at KOSA

## Eighteen jobs went into seventeen rows

No new wage table was created. Eighteen AI jobs were defined and each attached to one of the 17 IT jobs in the average SW technician wages KOSA publishes. An AI model architect corresponds to IT architect (11,103,230 won a month), a RAG and knowledge-search engineer to application SW developer (7,754,124 won), an AI model developer running fine-tuning to system SW developer (5,840,196 won), an AI test engineer to IT tester (4,053,137 won) and an AI quality-verification specialist to IT quality manager (11,042,071 won).

Two jobs working the same 'verification and stabilization' stage sit at opposite ends of the table. The quality specialist handles performance evaluation and hallucination checks, the test engineer functional and performance testing; the price differs 2.7-fold. A model developer running fine-tuning (LoRA, RLHF, DPO) is tied to the row that holds embedded developers, roughly half the architect who designs the model. Over 12 months (12 man-months) direct labour cost splits into 93.05 million won and 70.08 million won — a gap of 22.97 million won.

Nor was the word AI absent from the wage table. IT planner already lists 'AI service planner', IT architect 'AI architect' and application SW developer 'AI SW developer' among their included jobs. What was missing was not the name but a price for the work that divides inside it.

## The gap in one row widens in the project cost

The costing form stacks three ratios on top of direct labour cost: overhead (144–154% of direct labour), a technology fee (20–40% of direct labour plus overhead) and profit (0–25% of development cost). Because the amounts on top grow with labour cost, the choice of row widens further in the final project price.

Nothing yet compels anyone to choose a row. The document says an AI job not listed 'may also be classified at will according to the market environment or social agreement'. It also states that the jobs were 'mapped at will' to current IT jobs.

## The price table hardens in 2028

The roadmap's schedule is long. It will push to add AI jobs and work areas to the wage survey in the second half of this year, build quantitative criteria for the AI-specific element in 2027 and pilot them in public and private projects, then put verified items into the guide from 2028. The 2026 survey already closed with submissions from Aug 13 to Sep 4, so whether AI items actually went in could not be confirmed.

Signs of a draft remain inside the table. The reference numbers the information security specialist as ⑬, but in the wage table applied this year ⑬ is IT marketer and the information security specialist is ⑰.

## The 16.4 trillion won goes out before that

The 2027 government AI budget is 16.4 trillion won in the government's proposal. The science ministry's share is 9.4211 trillion won, up 84.3% and 57% of the total. The ministry's own AI budget alone goes from 1.5 trillion won in 2025 to 9.4 trillion won in 2027, more than six-fold. AI transformation (AX) of industry and regions alone gets 1.8611 trillion won.

In 2027, when this money is tendered as AI projects, prices are set by the draft reference; the formal guide only gains an AI line in 2028. The document also names the path a contracting agency is likely to take where the standard is empty: 'the price may be calculated by reference to a recent purchase price or a similar transaction price'. The last contract becomes the price of the next.

The price of AI work will not be fixed on a single day in 2028. It is set little by little with each contract signed before then, and by which row that contract chooses.

factCheck.title: Fact check & sources
factCheck.note: The reference is a separate annex, not a formal revision of the SW Project Pricing Guide, and is neither a statute nor a ministerial notice, so following it is not a duty carrying sanctions. The wage figures are the 2026 average wages published from the 2025 SW Technician Wage Survey (national approved statistics No. 375001) and will change with the next survey in 2027. The 12-month direct labour costs of 93.05 million won and 70.08 million won, their 22.97 million won gap, and the 2.7-fold difference between the test and quality jobs are our own calculation, multiplying the published monthly averages by 12. The rates of 144–154% overhead, 20–40% technology fee and 0–25% profit are the ranges written in the reference's costing forms and are negotiated in actual contracts; we did not compute a total project price from them. KOSA's press release states the announcement date as 'Oct 24', but the seminar and press reports put it on Nov 24. We confirmed that the 2026 wage survey closed to submissions on Sep 4, but could not confirm whether AI job items were actually included. The reference numbering the information security specialist as ⑬ is as printed in the original PDF; in the wage table applied in 2026, ⑬ is IT marketer and the information security specialist is ⑰. The 2027 AI budget of 16.4 trillion won is the government's proposal and may change in the National Assembly. KOSA's complaint that AI technical jobs were undefined reads as the absence of specialist-level jobs such as fine-tuning and RAG; the published wage table already lists AI-named included jobs such as AI architect and AI SW developer.

title: 5% for India, 2% for China — while prices rise, Europe-bound cargo is being registered at customs
deck: In November Formosa Plastics lifted PVC to $1,020 a tonne for India and $880 for China. In the same weeks, since 27 October, EU customs has been registering Korean PVC tonne by tonne. Europe takes 35.1% of Korea's PVC exports. The injury-elimination level in the complaint is 53%.
author: Insight Brief Editorial Room
summary: The November shipment price for Asian PVC was set by Formosa Plastics at $1,020 a tonne for India ($45 above October) and $880 for China ($20 above). China's operating rate is 59.59%, the lowest since December 2015, and the combined chlor-alkali margin in Shandong is minus 1,166.15 yuan a tonne.

From 27 October the EU has required customs to register S-PVC and M-PVC from Korea, China, Mexico and Taiwan. Definitive duties can be collected retroactively on nine months of registered cargo; the complaint puts Korea's dumping margin at 21-61% and the injury-elimination level at 53%.

Europe takes 35.1% of Korea's PVC exports (272,346 tonnes). India set a minimum import price of $0.766 a kg on 24 July. Hanwha Solutions' PVC price rose 14.8% while caustic soda fell 12.8%, leaving its chemicals division with a 44.7 billion won operating loss in the third quarter.
body:
Formosa Plastics of Taiwan set the November shipment price for Asian PVC. India was $1,020 a tonne, up $45 (5%) from October, and China $880, up $20 (2%) (Nikkei, 24 November). It is the fourth straight monthly rise, and the gap between the two markets is $140. In the same month Korean PVC cargo carried a registration number instead of a price tag: from 27 October the European Union has required member states' customs to register Korean, Chinese, Mexican and Taiwanese cargo tonne by tonne.

![An export warehouse before dawn: white PVC resin sacks on pallets, a forklift, and a container wreathed in cold air beyond the open shutter. Image · AI illustration](/assets/img/articles/pvc-eu-registration-35-percent-2026.jpg)

## What lifted prices was not demand

China's average PVC plant operating rate was 59.59% in the week to 19 November, the lowest since 25 December 2015 (Longzhong Information). Calcium-carbide plants ran at 69.07% and ethylene-based plants at 37.50%. Per-product margins were minus 606 yuan a tonne on carbide and minus 932 yuan on ethylene, and the combined chlor-alkali margin in Shandong — chlorine and caustic soda counted together — was minus 1,166.15 yuan (Huatai Futures, 20 November). The plants that could not cover cost stopped first. Demand is falling, not rising: pipe plants ran at 33.24% and window-frame plants at 37.17%, both lower again.

## On 27 October, customs began assigning numbers

The European Commission opened an anti-dumping investigation on 23 September into S-PVC and M-PVC from Korea, China, Mexico and Taiwan (Official Journal C/2026/4912; the complaint was filed on 10 August by Europe's PVC Trade Committee). On 23 October Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/2345 ordered customs registration, which took effect on 27 October, the day after publication. Registration runs nine months, and definitive duties can later be collected retroactively on what was registered. For China the complaint adds a raw-material distortion claim that could carry the duty all the way to the dumping margin; for Korea there is no such claim.

## 21-61% and 53%

The complaint put Korea's dumping margin at 21-61% and the injury-elimination level at 53%. In the same document China is 84-273% and 68%, Taiwan 13-39% and 56%, Mexico 65% and 55%. Definitive duties are normally set at the lower of the two (Article 9(4)). On cargo worth $850 a tonne, 53% is $450.

> "At this stage the Commission is not in a position to estimate the amount of possible future liability. The figures in the complaint are for information only." — Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/2345, 23 October 2026

## The country that sends 35.1% to Europe

S&P Global data show Korea exported 272,346 tonnes of PVC to the EU between June 2025 and June 2026, 35.1% of all its PVC exports. Over the same period the EU took 2.8% of China's PVC exports and 7.6% of Taiwan's. Britain is moving on a separate track: its Trade Remedies Authority opened a case on 4 August into S-PVC from China, Mexico and Korea, began registering imports on 11 August and put Hanwha Solutions and LG Chem in the sampled exporters, and on 9 November published three questionnaires on a particular market situation in Korea. If domestic prices are not accepted as normal value, normal value is rebuilt from cost and the dumping margin grows.

## The second door: India

India acted on 24 July, when the Directorate General of Foreign Trade restricted imports of S-PVC (HS 39041020) with a CIF value at or below $0.766 a kg under notification 25/2026-27. It runs six months, into late January 2027; inputs for export production are exempt. A country whose 1.615 million tonnes of capacity cannot meet 4.139 million tonnes of demand has raised a floor. On top of that, on 26 October the DGTR recommended provisional countervailing duties of $83.72-143.82 a tonne on Chinese cargo only. The room China leaves is being taken first by Taiwan: in mid-November the Taiwanese producer cut only its India offer (ChemOrbis). The premium is now on trial.

## What was left after the quarter

The third-quarter numbers answer whether higher prices leave anything behind. Hanwha Solutions sold PVC at 1,146,000 won a tonne in the quarter, up 14.8% from 998,000 won in 2025. Caustic soda, made in the same process, fell 12.8% to $362 a tonne from $415 (quarterly report, 12 November). Splitting brine with electricity yields chlorine for PVC and caustic soda at once, so when one rises and the other falls the account barely moves. Hanwha's chemicals division posted a 44.7 billion won operating loss, against an 87.1 billion won profit the previous quarter, and LG Chem's petrochemicals division lost 175.6 billion won. Both named Chinese exports and the European case in their fourth-quarter outlook.

## January and July 2027

India is the nearer deadline: the minimum import price ends in late January and European registration expires in late July. Until then Korean cargo keeps piling up at customs. The Chinese plant's profit and loss sets the price; the doors in Europe and India set the volume. Two dates in 2027 will test both at once.

factCheck.title: Fact check & sources
factCheck.note: The price is based on the evaluation date and unit as shown in the original text. Taiwan Plastic Industries (FPC)'s November delivery price of $1,020 was reported by the Nippon Keizai Shimbun as 'an increase of $45 (5%) compared to October', and the Tokio Shimbun wrote that it was a $20 increase from the October revised price of $1,000. Because I made two offers in the same month, the base month is different. ‘Four months in a row’ is the expression Credco Sourcing quoted a market insider on November 3. The $140 gap between India and China is calculated by subtracting $880 from $1,020. ChemOrbis reported on November 16 that Taiwan-made products only slightly lowered their offers to India in mid-November, but the exact amount of the reduction could not be confirmed as it was a paid article. ‘If the cargo costs $850 per ton, 53% is $450’ is an example of multiplying $850 by 0.53, and is a calculation unrelated to the actual charging standards (net selling price, CIF, and customs price). The Commission has stated in its regulations that the burden cannot be estimated at this stage. The nine months of EU registration are from October 27, 2026 to late July 2027, and the investigation is stipulated to end within one year of its start (September 23, 2026). The end date of India's minimum import price is calculated as 6 months from the date of notification (July 24, 2026) and is written as 'late January 2027'. India's DGTR's October 26, 2026 recommendation is an interim ruling and the actual imposition is subject to a notification by the Finance Ministry. The anti-dumping duties recommended for Korean products in the final decision for seven countries on August 14, 2025 were expressed as $95-136 (industry summary) and $22-284 (explanation by the Indian Ministry of Commerce) depending on the data, and were not used in the main text. ‘Domestic capacity of 1.615 million tons, demand of 4.139 million tons’ is the value revealed by the Indian Ministry of Commerce in August 2026. Hanwha Solutions' selling price is the Korean Won amount based on the 'average international price' in the quarterly report, and the 2025 value is the annual average. The KRW 44.7 billion loss in the chemical division was different in scope from the operating profit of the basic materials division (KRW 82.7 billion, KRW 76.5 billion after consolidation adjustment) disclosed by the company, so it followed the segment standards in media reports. China's operation rate and margin are weekly data from China Futures and Huatai Futures, and the weekly aggregation date (November 19-20) is one day different.

title: 4,697.51 — down 50.22% from the peak, and the sidecar rang 102 times
deck: KOSPI closed at 4,697.51 on 25 November 2026, down 6.16% and its lowest close in more than ten months. The intraday low sat 50.22% below the 19 June peak, the fourth time since 2000 that the index has halved from a high. Sidecars were triggered 102 times this year and 43 sessions moved more than 5%. Individuals net bought 1.42 trillion won, while the credit-loan balance still stood at 25.88 trillion won.
author: Insight Brief Editorial Room
summary: KOSPI closed at 4,697.51 on 25 November 2026, down 308.52 points (6.16%) from the previous session. It was the lowest close since 13 January (4,692.64) and the index fell as far as 4,672.55 during the session. A sell-side sidecar was triggered at 9:08 a.m., eight minutes after the open.

The intraday low was 50.22% below the 19 June intraday high of 9,385.59. According to Mirae Asset Securities, the index has fallen more than 50% from a high only four times since 2000: the dot-com bubble, the 2003 card crisis, the 2008 global financial crisis and this year. Foreigners net sold 1.8994 trillion won and individuals net bought 1.4232 trillion won.

Korea Exchange data show 102 sidecar triggers this year through 25 November, the first year above 100. Circuit breakers were triggered 11 times on KOSPI and 5 on KOSDAQ, and 43 sessions moved more than 5% either way. The credit-loan balance stood at 25.88 trillion won on 24 November and investor deposits at 82.05 trillion won, more than 57 trillion won below the June peak.
body:
On the 25th, KOSPI closed at 4,697.51, down 308.52 points (6.16%) from the previous trading day. The 5,000 mark gained by jumping 6.32% the previous day was returned in one day. Based on the closing price, it was the lowest in 10 months since January 13 (4,692.64), and during the day it was pushed to 4,672.55.

![In the dealing room of a bank in Seoul in the evening, dozens of monitors display steeply curved red lines and blue screens, and a desk with an empty coffee cup on it. On November 25, 2026, KOSPI closed at 4,697.51, down 6.16%. Image · AI illustration](/assets/img/articles/kospi-4697-sidecar-102-volatility-2026.jpg)

## 6.16% — Sell sidecar rang within 8 minutes of opening

The index opened at 4,809.00, down 3.94%, and at 9:08 a.m., eight minutes after opening, KOSPI 200 futures fell by more than 5%, triggering a selling sidecar. This is the 62nd and 33rd sale in the stock market this year.

Supply and demand were clearly divided. Foreigners net sold 1.8994 trillion won, the highest since the 6th (2.6892 trillion won), and individuals bought 1.4232 trillion won.

The decline was concentrated in semiconductors. Samsung Electronics fell 9.87% to 170,700 won, bringing its market capitalization below 1,000 trillion won for the first time in eight months since March 31. SK Hynix lost 11.05% to 1.03 million won. Last night, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell 7.88%, and the trigger was that BNP Paribas lowered the target stock price for Micron (-11.01%) by warning of an oversupply of memory. Another burden is that the results of the U.S. Trade Representative's (USTR) tariff investigation into 'excess production' remain to be announced. KOSDAQ fell 2.29% to 650.64, and the won-dollar exchange rate was 1,343.2 won.

## 50.22% — Fourth halving since 2000

Heavier numbers are intraday lows. It is 50.22% lower than the intraday high (9,385.59) on June 19th. Since 2000, there have been only four declines of more than 50% from the peak, including the dot-com bubble (early 2000), credit card crisis (2003), and financial crisis (2008) (Mirae Asset Securities).

The reason the decline is special is that it is focused on two stocks. As of the 20th, the proportion of Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix in the KOSPI market capitalization was about 47%. At the end of June it was 55.7%. As of the end of June, minority shareholders of the two companies held 66.24% and 67.98%, respectively, and the combined number of minority shareholders was 11,432,768. The structure is such that half of the index is delivered directly to most household accounts.

## Episode 102 — Nine times the five years from 2022 to 2025

The volatility itself is a record for the year. According to the Korea Exchange, as of the 25th, sidecars were used 102 times, exceeding 100 for the first time on a yearly basis. It averages once every two trading days, more than double the 45 times in 2008, and cannot be compared to the 11 times in the five years from 2022 to 2025 combined. There are 11 circuit breakers for KOSPI and 5 for KOSDAQ, which is double the cumulative number of 6 KOSPI breaks before 2026. It rang 10 times in June and July alone, and the reason for the 8 times for KOSPI and 4 times for KOSDAQ was semiconductor and AI issues. The number of days with a rise or fall of more than 5% per day was 43 trading days (18 rises, 25 falls), which is more than 20 times the number of days last year (2 days). The all-time records for the largest increase (+17.91% on July 31) and the largest decline (-12.06% on March 4) were also set this year. From the 20th, the sidecar was activated for 4 consecutive trading days with sell, sell, buy, and sell.

> "The activation of the sidecar for four consecutive trading days shows that the market's price discovery function is greatly shaken." — Seok-hwan Kim, researcher at Mirae Asset Securities

## 1.4232 trillion and 25.88 trillion — money purchased by individuals, remaining debt

On this day, individuals also bought 1.4232 trillion won, but the amount of ammunition decreased. Investor deposits amounted to 82.5 trillion won on the 24th, which is more than 57 trillion won less than the record high on June 4 (139.6947 trillion won). The credit transaction loan balance was 25.88 trillion won, down 12.75 trillion won from June 24 (38.6328 trillion won), but still close to 26 trillion won.

Payment burden comes in shorter cycles. On the 24th, receivables from consignment sales amounted to KRW 966 billion, and counter sales amounted to KRW 13.7 billion (1.6% of receivables). If the outstanding transaction is not paid by the settlement date (D+2), it will be forcibly disposed of the next day. The payment date for purchases made on the 25th is the 27th. The authorities exempted the obligation to maintain the credit loan collateral maintenance ratio (140%) from the 9th to the end of January next year, but outstanding transactions are not an exception. The credit balance of the two semiconductor stocks alone was 6.9032 trillion won as of the 20th.

## Monetary Policy Committee meeting on the 26th, and payment date

On the 26th, the Monetary Policy Committee released the base interest rate, dot plot, and revised economic outlook, and ahead of the U.S. Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) on December 8-9, the futures market reflects more than 90% of the December increase.

Kim Jun-seok, senior research fellow at the Korea Capital Market Institute, points out that the long-term institutional investor base must be accumulated as long-term investment funds through “retirement pensions, personal pensions, and long-term public offering funds.”

The number to check is three. My account's credit loan and collateral ratio, whether there are outstanding transactions, and how much reverse trading has increased in the 25-day statistics released on the 26th. This article does not recommend investment decisions.

factCheck.note: Index, supply and demand, and market capitalization are based on the Yonhap News article published at 16:11 on November 25, citing the Korea Exchange tally. The annual tally, including 102 sidecars, 11 circuit breakers, and 43 trading days with fluctuations of more than 5%, is the value reported by Maeil Business Newspaper (20:09 on the same day) citing data from the Korea Exchange. '50.22% from the high' is a comparison between the intraday high of 9,385.59 on June 19 and the intraday low of 4,672.55 on the 25th, and the four cases of declines of more than 50% from the high since 2000 are cited by Mirae Asset Securities analysis. Credit transaction loans, deposits, receivables, and counter sales are published one day late in the Korea Financial Investment Association's comprehensive statistics, so the values ​​are as of November 24th, and the 25th's worth is released on the 26th. '38.6328 trillion won on June 24' is the highest of the year, and '139.6947 trillion won on June 4' is the highest deposit ever. The 13.7 billion won in reverse sales is for receivables from consignment sales, and reverse sales carried out due to lack of credit loan collateral are not separately announced and are therefore not included in these statistics. The payment date for purchases made on the 25th is the 27th, which is calculated based on D+2 payment business days. Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix's credit balance of 6.9032 trillion won is the value as of November 20 (Sisa Journal e) citing KOSCOM's tally. The number of minority shareholders, 11,432,768, is the simple sum of the number of minority shareholders of the two stocks as of the end of June, and there may be duplicate holders. The announcement of the results of USTR's investigation into overproduction tariffs for 16 economic entities is scheduled, and the probability of an FOMC hike in December is not a confirmed decision as it is reflected in the futures market. title: Profit zone 43.6%, lowest since February 2019 — This is the first time this number has been shown above the realized price
deck: On November 20, the supply of Bitcoin profit section fell to 43.6%. It is lower than during the crash in March 2020 and the bear market in November 2022. However, three times in the past, the number came out when the price was below the realized price, and this time it came out 11% above the realized price. Spot ETF net outflows of $4.71 billion in November appear to have made the difference.
author: Insight Brief Editorial Room
summary: Based on the Bitfinex Alpha Report, the Bitcoin profit section supply on November 20 was 43.6%, the lowest since February 2019. The volume tied up in the loss section is 11.35 million BTC, the highest ever, with Glassnode's weekly tally at 47.3% and Coinglass' daily tally at 44.44% (4-year percentile 0%).

In the past, in 2018, 2020, and 2022, the price was below the realized price by less than 45%, but this time, the number came out about 11% above the realized price. The average buyer is in the profit zone, but only recent buyers are pushed into the loss zone.

Net outflow from the U.S. Bitcoin spot ETF from November 1 to 23 was $4.71 billion, the highest ever for a month. The realized price of $53,200 presented by Glassnode and the forecast of $37,000 to $41,000 when applying the discount rate are calculations, not predictions, and the PCE on the 25th, the Monetary Policy Committee meeting on the 26th, and weekly ETF flows are the next confirmation points.
body:
On November 20, the amount remaining in the profit section of the total Bitcoin supply fell to 43.6%. This is a compilation of the Alpha Report released by Bitfinex on November 24th. It is the lowest level since February 2019, and is even lower than the crash in March 2020 and the FTX collapse in November 2022. At the same time, the amount tied up in the loss section was 11.35 million BTC, the highest ever.

If you look at this number alone, it reads as ‘bottom.’ In fact, if you look at past cases where the supply in the profitable section fell below 45%, the price for the next year was generally higher. Bitfinex mentioned such cases about 150 times, but added the caveat that “it is not a reliable prediction model.” The problem is the **place** where the number appears this time.

## ① The three numbers pointed in the same direction

|Metrics|Mid-November|November 25|Source|
|---|---|---|---|
|Bitcoin Price|$61,270.93 (closing price on the 24th)|$58,870.52 (17:20)|Kubi Lab·Block Media|
|Profit section supply|54.2%(11/16)|47.3%(11/23) · 44.44%(11/24)|Glassnode·Coinglass|
|Profit section supply (exchange tally)|—|43.6%(11/20)|Bitfinex Alpha|
|Fear and Greed Index|11|8|CoinMarketCap|
|US Spot ETF|Net outflow for 5 consecutive trading days|Cumulative amount of $4.71 billion in November|Farside Investors|

The base dates for the three indicators are slightly different, and the aggregation agencies are also different. But the direction is the same. The profit section supply, which had exceeded 60% until October, decreased by 12.7 percentage points in 7 days to 47.3% (Glassnode, the week of November 23), and a day later, according to Coinglass, it fell to 44.44%. Based on Coinglass, the 4-year percentile is 0%. This means that it is the lowest position in the last four years.

The price is also in the same direction. As of 17:20 on November 25, Bitcoin was at $58,870.52, down 2.34% from 24 hours ago, at $58,870.52, and in the Upbit Korean Won Market, it fell to 79.97 million won, breaking the 80 million won mark. Ethereum fell by $1,640.65, Solana by $67.80, and Hyperliquid by 8.62% on the day.

## ② Difference from the past three times — 43.6% of the above realized price

The difference pointed out by Bitfinex is this. When the supply of the profitable section fell below 45% in 2018, 2020, and 2022, the price had already fallen below the realized price (average on-chain acquisition price). This time, the price went below the realized price even though it was about 11% above it.

To put it simply, even though the average buyer is still in the profit zone, a large number of recent buyers have been pushed into the loss zone. In fact, the net unrealized profit/loss ratio for short-term holders is -18.3%, the lowest since mid-June (Glassnode), and the SOPR for short-term holders is 0.963, showing that recent buyers are selling at a lower price than the acquisition price (Bitfinex).

This combination often appears in the ‘middle of a selloff’ rather than the ‘end of a selloff.’ The fact that the loss section volume is 11.35 million BTC, the highest ever, means that the layer where stop loss and reverse trading can overlap is that thick if the price falls even a little further.

## ③ Size of outflow — $4.71 billion in November alone

The numbers on the supply and demand side are more direct. From November 1 to 23, there was a cumulative net outflow of $4.71 billion from the U.S. Bitcoin spot ETF. It is the highest ever on a monthly basis and surpasses the $4.5 billion record set in June. It was an outflow for 6 consecutive trading days, and $231.4 million was lost on the 24th alone. $175.3 million was withdrawn from BlackRock IBIT.

The Ethereum spot ETF also had a net outflow of $64.1 million for 7 consecutive trading days. The two assets combined are worth $295.5 million.

The derivatives market has already been cleaned out once. The most recent 24-hour forced liquidation was $337.18 million, of which long accounted for $275.69 million (81.8%), and open interest in dollar terms was $256.89 billion, down 14.92%. The decrease in leverage means that the factors that increase the downward shock have decreased, but conversely, the fuel that can lead to a rebound has also decreased.

## ④ What these numbers don’t say

First, profit section supply only counts ‘how many units are in the profit section’ rather than ‘how much profit is’. Even at the same 43.6%, the volume with a 1% profit and the volume with a 200% profit are mixed.

Second, this indicator is calculated from the price at the time the coin last moved on-chain. Even if the same person moves the wallet, the acquisition price is reset. Exchange holdings and lost coins are also included.

Third, Glassnode presented a realized price of $53,200 as a major downside indicator, and also calculated that applying a discount rate compared to the realized price at the bottom of the past bear market would be $37,000 to $41,000. This is a calculation, not a prediction. 21 Shares mentioned $43,800. The fact that the numbers vary from institution to institution shows the uncertainty in this section.

## ⑤ Next confirmation point

- US 3rd quarter GDP revision and October PCE price index as of 22:30 pm on November 25th (Korean time)
- November 26, Bank of Korea Monetary Policy Committee decides base interest rate
- Are net inflows and outflows of US spot ETFs turning positive on a weekly basis?
- Will the profit section supply exceed 50% again and will the realized price of $53,200 be maintained?

It's hard to say the word 'bottom' until two of these turn around. Conversely, if ETF funds change to net inflow and the supply of the profit section recovers 50%, this 43.6% will be recorded as the 'purchase section' after the fact. What has now been confirmed is that it is neither of those two.

※ This article is for informational purposes only and is not an investment recommendation. The decision and responsibility for investing in virtual assets rests with the investor.

title: 80 mandatory, 148 checks — the keyboard reaches the checklist in February 2027
deck: The Ministry of the Interior and Safety distributed its Public AI Service UI/UX Guidelines to central and local governments and public institutions on Nov 25. They carry 29 design criteria, 99 detailed requirements (80 mandatory) and 148 checklist items, but accessibility criteria such as button descriptions and keyboard operation are added only by February 2027. Europe has enforced the same sentence as law since Aug 2.
author: Insight Brief Editorial Room
tags: Ministry of the Interior and Safety
summary: The Ministry of the Interior and Safety distributed the Public AI Service UI/UX Guidelines to central government bodies, local governments and public institutions on Nov 25. With 29 design criteria, 99 detailed requirements (80 mandatory, 19 recommended) and 148 checklist items, they are sized to be used directly when agencies tender projects and inspect the results.

Accessibility criteria such as button descriptions and keyboard operation are added by February 2027. Guaranteeing accessibility of public websites and apps is already a duty on state institutions under Article 19 of the Digital Inclusion Act, in force since Jan 22, 2026.

Europe has enforced disclosure that a system is AI for interactive AI under Article 50 of the EU AI Act since Aug 2, 2026. Korea brought Article 31 of its AI Basic Act into force on Jan 22 but is holding penalties under a grace period of at least a year, and the new guidelines are a recommendation, not law.
body:
On Nov 25 the Ministry of the Interior and Safety distributed its Public AI Service UI/UX Guidelines to central government bodies, local governments and public institutions. They are the first screen-level standard for services where people receive civil-service guidance and counselling by talking with an AI.

Twenty-nine design criteria come with 99 detailed requirements and 148 checklist items, and 80 of the 99 are 'mandatory'. Yet the checklist has no 'keyboard' yet. Accessibility criteria such as button descriptions and keyboard operation are added in February 2027.

![A long checklist unrolled across a service counter and an empty chat window beside it, with only the outline of a keyboard left faint in the middle of the form. Image · AI illustration](/assets/img/articles/public-ai-uiux-checklist-2026.jpg)

## Twenty-nine criteria, 148 checklist items

Six 'public AI persona' criteria set the role and tone of an AI that guides civil-service matters on behalf of officials. It must first identify itself — 'I am the civil-service AI of ○○ agency' — state what it can help with, and explain difficult administrative terms in plain language. Twenty-three 'journey UI/UX' criteria set how users confirm and choose across five stages: entry and guidance, information input, AI processing, checking and understanding results, and correction. Results are shown with their sources, and when an error occurs or the user does not want an AI, the service must connect them to a human counsellor.

Each criterion carries 99 requirements (80 mandatory, 19 recommended), 148 checklist items, prompt examples and screen cases. Digital Daily judged the set sized to be used as-is for procurement and inspection. The guidelines are a reference standard, not a statute or a ministerial notice.

> "Public AI services must go beyond convenience and be provided so that people can trust the results and choose and control them for themselves." — Hwang Kyu-chul, head of the AI Government Office at the Ministry of the Interior and Safety

## The checklist has no keyboard

The ministry said it will add accessibility criteria, including button descriptions and keyboard operation, and reinforce the examples and checklist items by February 2027. That is why the version distributed now does not contain them.

Accessibility is already required by law. Article 19 of the Digital Inclusion Act, in force since Jan 22, 2026, obliges state institutions to guarantee accessibility so that digitally vulnerable groups can use intelligent information services — websites, apps, unmanned kiosks and more — without difficulty. The accessibility duty for public screens was fixed in statute first; the detailed criteria for conversational AI screens follow later.

## Conversational first, while the field already acts

Public AI in the field has already moved past conversation into action. Changwon City's 'AI duty officer' independently handled 2,624 of 5,498 night and holiday civil-service calls (47.72%) in the three months from August. Seocho District's 'Seocho AIgent', running officially since December 2025, handled 13,000 cases in three months and also books reservations and applications on users' behalf. The guidelines list 'agentic AI', which judges and acts on its own, and 'generative UI', which builds screens to fit the situation, as areas to be covered 'later'.

## Europe has enforced it as law since Aug 2

Article 50 of the EU AI Act requires AI systems that interact directly with people to be designed so that it is immediately clear they are AI. Chatbots, AI agents and avatars are named. Generative outputs must carry machine-readable marks and deepfakes must be disclosed. Enforcement began on Aug 2, 2026. The European Commission said in a Jul 31 press release that the transparency rules apply from that day. Only the machine-readable marking for systems placed on the market earlier was deferred to Dec 2.

## Korea made the law on Jan 22 and put off enforcement

Korea was earlier. Article 31 of the AI Development and Trust Framework Act requires products and services using high-impact or generative AI to tell users in advance that they run on AI. Its effective date of Jan 22, 2026 is about six months ahead of Europe. Failing to give prior notice carries a first-instance fine of 5 million won, up to a ceiling of 30 million won.

But the government said it would run a grace period of at least a year from the law's start and in principle not conduct fact-finding or impose fines. Press reports put the end at Jan 21, 2027. The statutes contain no deferral clause, so the duty is alive while enforcement is paused, and the science ministry said as recently as Nov 24 that the regulatory parts remain on hold pending field input.

## A checklist without anyone to check it

The distributed material does not say who reviews the 148 checklist items or when. Nor does it say what disadvantage follows for a project or budget if they are not met. The places where force can be applied are procurement and inspection, and the work instructions to be distributed to AI development tools.

Field records show what remains when that place is empty. World Center Media requested disclosure from 17 public institutions in Naju and received answers from 10; AI systems confirmed at four institutions numbered 21, and who reviewed and took responsibility for the results differed by institution. In the same outlet's survey, 45 of 99 respondents (45.5%) picked 'a human checks at the end' as the most necessary condition when AI is used on civil-service matters, and 52.5% said they had not known AI was used.

The weight of the guidelines is set not by clauses but by the calendar. The grace period ends on Jan 21, 2027, and accessibility criteria arrive in February. Whether the checklist reaches a tender document in between decides what the standard is worth.

factCheck.note: The 'mandatory' label in the guidelines is a classification inside the document, not a legal duty that carries sanctions when breached. The ministry's press release does not state who inspects the 148 items, how often, or what disadvantage follows non-compliance; that means those points are absent from that material, and does not rule out separate operating instructions. We did not examine all 148 checklist items in full, so the statement that accessibility criteria are missing rests on the ministry saying it will 'newly add' them by February 2027. Article 19 of the Digital Inclusion Act imposes an accessibility duty on state institutions for websites, apps and similar services; we could not confirm an authoritative interpretation on whether conversational AI screens fall within that scope. Article 31(1) of the AI Basic Act covers products and services using high-impact or generative AI, so not every public civil-service chatbot can be assumed to fall under it. The Jan 21, 2027 end of the grace period is a press figure, not a date written in statute; the government has said only 'at least one year'. The Aug 2, 2026 application and enforcement of EU Article 50 follows the Commission's press release and the AI Act Service Desk; the Dec 2 deferral applies only to machine-readable marking under Article 50(2) for systems placed on the market before that date. What the AI Omnibus, in force Jul 27, 2026, postponed was the high-risk obligations; the transparency application date did not change. Seocho AIgent figures are from an Apr 1, 2026 report on the district's announcement covering the three months after December 2025, and Changwon's figures cover the Aug-Oct pilot, with a decision on full rollout due at year-end. The WCM findings rest on 10 of 17 institutions answering a disclosure request and a non-random survey of 99 people; they are not a measure of opinion across Naju or of how supervision actually works.

title: Four days' worth of tin left in the warehouse, and the price still fell 19% — Nasdaq, not the mine, moved it
deck: On 13 November LME tin for immediate delivery cost $790 a tonne more than the three-month contract. On 24 November it cost $75 less. In between, a kilogram went from 65,000 won to 55,000 won, and the warehouse held about four days of world consumption. When Chinese smelters restarted, the spread gave way first; the price then followed AI stocks down.
author: Insight Brief Editorial Room
summary: On 24 November the official LME tin cash settlement was $40,825 a tonne against $40,900 for three-month metal, leaving cash $75 cheaper. On 13 November cash was $790 dearer. LME stocks stood at 3,725 tonnes, 41% of the 9,025 tonnes on 17 June.

What ended the squeeze was Yunnan Tin's Gejiu smelter finishing maintenance. Chinese refined tin output is expected to rise from 8,615 tonnes in October to 15,615 tonnes in November, and social inventory that had fallen for five straight weeks turned back up to 5,673 tonnes. Myanmar's Wa State still runs at 40–50% of capacity.

The price moved with AI infrastructure stocks. In New York on 24 November the three-month contract closed at $39,580, below $40,000 for the first time since December 2025. Korea, which produces none of its own, imports all its tin from Indonesia and China, and half of that tin goes into semiconductor solder.
body:
On 24 November the London Metal Exchange settled tin for immediate delivery at $40,825 a tonne and three-month metal at $40,900 — cash $75 cheaper than the forward. Eleven days earlier, on 13 November, it was the other way round: cash carried a $790 premium at $48,295, and a kilogram of tin cost 65,000 won. The same kilogram cost 55,000 won on 24 November. Ten thousand won gone in eight sessions.

![Piles of tin ingots and empty racks in a metal warehouse at dawn, and port cranes beyond the open shutters. Image · AI illustration](/assets/img/articles/tin-below-40k-four-days-stock-2026.jpg)

## The day the price fell, the warehouse was nearly empty

That day LME warehouses held 3,725 tonnes of tin, 41% of the 9,025 tonnes recorded on 17 June. Spread over world consumption of about 350,000 tonnes a year, that is a little over four days. In New York on 24 November the three-month contract closed at $39,580, its first close below $40,000 since December 2025; it touched $39,110 intraday and fell around 6% on the day, the largest drop since March (SMM). Shanghai tin closed its night session at 300,000 yuan a tonne, down 5.19%.

What set the price was not metal but equities. The Nasdaq fell 5.28% on 20 November, the market priced a December rate rise at 95%, and the dollar index stood at its highest since April 2025. Through 2026 tin futures have moved with AI infrastructure shares.

> “Concerns about the sustainability of AI investments triggered a sell-off in technology stocks. The impact of financial flows and investment sentiment on tin prices increased, and speculative selling in China increased the correction.” — Tim Langston, Senior Analyst, International Annotation Association (ITA), November 24

## What went out first was the spread

The gap between cash and three-month metal flipped in twelve days: +$790 on 13 November, +$360 on the 20th, +$350 on the 23rd and −$75 on the 24th. On that last day the three-month price did not move at all; cash alone fell $425. These are figures computed from LME official settlements. The ex-China spot premium SMM tracks also collapsed, from $687 on 16 November to $155 on the 20th. Metal earmarked to leave the warehouses — cancelled warrants — was 560 tonnes on the 20th, or 15.05%.

## The smelters, not the mines, ended the spread

Yunnan Tin's Gejiu smelter finished on 26 October the 45-day maintenance it began on 30 September. The operating rate at sample smelters in Yunnan and Jiangxi rose to 59.67% in the week to 6 November, up 32.75 percentage points from the week before, and Yunnan had recovered to 80% by mid-November. Chinese refined tin output is expected to climb from 8,615 tonnes in October to 15,615 tonnes in November, a gain of 7,000 tonnes (SMM). Chinese social inventory, which had fallen five weeks running, turned back up to 5,673 tonnes.

## The mines are still at half

Output in Myanmar's Wa State remains at 40–50% of capacity, and treatment charges are still low — 40% ore in Yunnan fetches 16,000–18,000 yuan a tonne, a sign concentrate is hard to find. Indonesian refined tin exports fell 14% year on year to 32,800 tonnes in January–September, and September alone was 3,970.25 tonnes, down 18%. State miner PT Timah, however, produced 16,190 tonnes in the nine months, up 49%, and exported 96% of what it sold. CRU puts the January–September shortfall at 11,000 tonnes, with consumption of 275,000 tonnes against output of 264,100 tonnes.

## Korea buys every tonne it uses

Korea has no domestic production and imports all its tin (Korea Nonferrous Metals Association). Of Indonesia's 4,670.54 tonnes of tin ingot exports in August, 360.42 tonnes (7.72%) came to Korea, the fifth-largest destination after China's 2,783 tonnes, and China sold Korea a further 310.2 tonnes in July. Half of all tin demand is solder. Korea's semiconductor exports rose 259% to $56.44 billion in October and computers 497%, while the price of the solder inside them fell 19% in the past month.

The lag also works the other way. At solder-ball maker Duksan Hi-Metal, the standalone operating margin fell to 5.4% in the first quarter, which the company attributed to higher tin and silver prices and the delay in passing them on. Now that the price has fallen, that lag works in reverse.

## What is left to watch

Watch LME stocks at 3,500 tonnes and the cancelled warrants first. Beyond that: SMM's view that new mine supply accelerates from 2027 and peaks in 2028, Indonesia's annual mining quota (RKAB) and export licensing, and the December rate decision. While the price hangs on AI stocks, the first screen for cost management is not mine news but the Nasdaq.

factCheck.title: Fact check & sources
factCheck.note: Prices and inventory are based on the Westmetal table, which publishes LME daily official settlement price and warehouse data. On November 24th, spot price was $40,825, 3-month contract was $40,900, and inventory was 3,725 tons. On the same day, the 3-month contract closed at $39,580 (down 5.99% from the previous day) in electronic trading in the U.S. This is the SMM valuation and is different from the official settlement price ($40,900). The decline from the intraday low of $39,110 was written by SMM as 7.15% and 8.3%, respectively, in an article on the same day, but because the reference point was different, the text wrote about 6%, which is the closing standard. '19% per month' is our calculation that rounds off -19.7% calculated from $50,855 in spot on October 23rd to $40,825 on November 24th, and Hindu Business Line, citing Reuters, reported it as 18.5% on a 3-month basis (-8% in the last week). 1 kg 65,000 won/55,000 won is calculated by multiplying $48,295·40,825 by 1,346.60 won/dollar (Notice by Bank of Korea on November 24, 2026, published by LME KOREA) and dividing by 1,000 (65,035 won·54,976 won), excluding exchange rate fees and domestic premium. It wasn't. 'Four days' supply' is 3.9 days, which is 3,725 tons of inventory divided by annual consumption of 350,000 tons (959 tons per day), or 3.7 days divided by CRU's January-September consumption of 275,000 tons (about 1,007 tons per day), both of which are our calculations. The spread of +790 (11/13), +360 (11/20), +350 (11/23), -75 (11/24) dollars is calculated by subtracting the two official settlement prices, and SMM's offshore spot premium (11/16 +687.01 → 11/20 +155.04 dollars) was not compared in the same series due to different evaluation standards. November production of 15,615 tons is the October production of 8,615 tons (FT Mercati citing SMM data) plus SMM's 'November previous month +7,000 tons', and SMM also wrote November production as 'more than 15,000 tons'. The 11,000-ton shortfall is a value quoted by Bright Securities as a CRU estimate, and the original text of the CRU could not be confirmed. Tim Langston's remarks were translated from the Hindu Business Line's November 24 report. Indonesian exports may differ depending on the agency, with August at 4,670.54 tons based on the Bureau of Statistics (BPS) and September at 3,970.25 tons based on the Ministry of Trade. Korea's 'full import' was based on an industry article citing the outlook of the Korea Nonferrous Metals Association. Duksan Hi-Metal's separate operating profit margin of 5.4% in the first quarter and the explanation of the cause are the values ​​of the Korea IR Council report, and the fact that the decline in value leads to margin improvement in subsequent quarters is an interpretation based on the sales price pass-through lag structure and not the company's outlook. The statement that spread narrowing is the cause of the price plunge is an interpretation based on inventory and premium data, and there is no quantitative data that divides the price decline into supply and demand and sentiment.
