factCheck.title: Fact check & sources
factCheck.note: Figures are the official ones released by the education and culture ministries, with secondary reporting used only for the surrounding context. Applicants (지원자) are not test-takers (응시자): in 2025, 543,600 applied for the paper-based TOPIK and 421,046 sat it. Country rankings cover paper-based tests only, count the country where the test was taken rather than nationality, and exclude 224,408 applicants who tested inside Korea; the 22,531 internet-based applicants are not broken down by country. The 20 million visitor figure was declared by the culture ministry on 12 November 2026 on the basis of a provisional 19.97 million cumulative arrivals on 11 November plus the daily average — it is an official estimate for the year, not a count closed on 31 December. Spending per arrival (about 932,000 won) is our calculation from the ministry's January-September card spending (15.94 trillion won) and arrivals (17.11 million); dollar figures use the 24 November 2026 base rate of 1,346.6 won. The 42.3% figure comes from a preliminary third-quarter 2025 survey and measures the trigger for interest, not the reason for a specific trip; the 45.2% figure is from a 2024 survey of potential visitors. The 35-fold and 38-fold local figures are year-on-year comparisons of the same three weekdays without controls, and the two agencies behind the BTS analysis measured different populations and spending scopes — this article reports the caveat alongside the numbers. No Korean agency publishes an estimate of Hallyu's share of arrivals or of the Korean-language education market's size, so this article does not supply one.

title: 38 companies in 28 months — from March 9, AI training data goes through the review room
deck: The Personal Information Protection Commission gave notice of the enforcement decree for the AI training data exception on November 23, 2026; it takes effect March 9, 2027. Three legal conditions become five checkpoints and a review, and processing stops entirely if the work does not begin within six months of approval. The regulatory sandbox that has handled this so far approved 38 companies in about 28 and a half months.
author: Insight Brief Editorial Room
summary: With the revision of the Personal Information Protection Act (Law No. 21910, promulgated on 2026-09-08), a special provision allowing legally collected original personal information to be used for AI technology development will be implemented from March 9, 2027. It must be difficult to develop through pseudonymous and anonymous processing, have strengthened safety measures, have public interest and social necessity, and the risk of unfairly infringing on the interests of information subjects must be significantly low. Deliberation and resolution by the Personal Information Committee is essential.

The revised enforcement ordinance (2026-11-23 ~ 2027-01-04 legislative notice) includes 5 safety measures, risk factor assessment target No. 5, deliberation and resolution procedures, establishment of an expert committee, simplification of similar cases, and post-inspection. The law stipulates that if the process is not started or conditions are not fulfilled within 6 months after approval, 'all processing will be restricted' and it will be stopped without corrective procedures. The 30 days and 15 days of deliberation are not the enforcement decree, but the operational goals of the Personal Information Committee.

The regulatory sandbox, the existing route, was 38 companies (4 self-driving cars, 26 robots, 8 intelligent CCTV) using the original video from January 2024 to May 15, 2026, with an average of 1.3 companies per month for about 28 and a half months. The 2027 budget includes 90 technical and legal consulting sessions each. The EU does the same with GDPR 'legitimate interests' and post-processing oversight, without new law.
body:
On November 23, 2026, the Personal Information Protection Commission gave notice of a partial amendment to the Enforcement Decree of the Personal Information Protection Act. Public comments run until January 4, 2027. The statute behind it is Act No. 21910, promulgated on September 8, 2026, and it takes effect on March 9, 2027. From that day a company may use original personal information it collected lawfully, without fresh consent from the data subject, to develop AI. There are three conditions: pseudonymised or anonymised data must not be enough for the development; strengthened safeguards must be in place; and the purpose must include promoting the public interest or protecting the interests of data subjects or third parties, with little risk of unfairly harming them. The Commission's deliberation and resolution come on top of that.

> "This exception is meaningful in that it reasonably widens the chance to use personal information in an era when the level of AI development becomes national competitiveness, while building a matching system of management and oversight with companies and institutions."
> — Song Kyung-hee, Chair of the Personal Information Protection Commission, August 20, 2026, after the bill passed the National Assembly plenary

![At the end of a dim review-room corridor, hundreds of film reels and folders ride a conveyor toward the one lit inspection arch. A red line is painted on the floor before the arch, and one folder has failed to cross it. Image · AI illustration](/assets/img/articles/ai-training-data-exception-review-2027.jpg)

## Three requirements turn into five gates

What the decree creates is not a commentary on the conditions but a route through them. Article 29-13 requires five measures for the personal data covered: appoint a responsible officer and draw up, run and review an internal management plan; prevent use beyond the approved scope; restrict access rights; control access; and destroy the data without delay once it is no longer needed, confirming and recording the result. Article 29-14 lists five categories that trigger a prior risk assessment: sensitive or unique identifier information; data subjects needing special protection because of age, disability or health; AI that observes or tracks people continuously, or evaluates, predicts or infers their traits, tendencies or behaviour; decisions that significantly affect rights, obligations or opportunities; and cases where the structure of processing raises risk. Media reports covered only the first four; the last category is left to the Commission's notice.

## 30 days is not in the law; six months is

The Commission has said it is preparing to finish deliberation within 30 days for a first application, and within 15 days where the case resembles an earlier one (Maeil Business Newspaper, August 20). But this decree sets no deadline for a decision. If the filing needs supplementing, the Commission may set a "considerable period" for it, and the documents to attach are also fixed by notice. For a company drawing up a schedule, 30 days is an operating target, not a rule.

There is a deadline the statute does fix. Article 28-14 makes it grounds for restricting all processing if the approved work has not begun within six months without special reason. Failing an attached condition, or later being found not to meet the requirements, ends the same way. The law says the Commission "shall restrict all of the processing". There is no step-by-step correction; it is a switch.

## 38 companies in 28 months

The route that has handled this work so far is the regulatory sandbox. The Commission said that from January 2024 to May 15, 2026 it approved 38 companies, Hyundai Motor among them, to use original video: four for autonomous driving, 26 for robots and eight for intelligent CCTV. Thirty-eight approvals across about 28 and a half months is 1.3 a month on average. A sandbox approval is an exception that runs two years, four at most, so the clock keeps ticking. What is different now is that the exception becomes a standing legal basis. How many reviews happen still depends on the Commission's capacity: the regulatory impact analysis says the 2027 budget funds 90 technology and 90 legal consulting sessions.

## Europe placed the gatekeeper behind the door

The EU did not write a new law. In Opinion 28/2024 of December 18, 2024, the European Data Protection Board held that the "legitimate interests" basis in Article 6(1)(f) of the GDPR can be used to develop AI models. The controller weighs and documents three steps — that the interest is legitimate, that the processing is necessary, and that it is not overridden by the data subject's interests. There is no prior approval. Instead, people can object, and supervisory authorities investigate afterwards. Korea has put approval in front, with conditions and periodic checks attached. It trades speed for certainty.

## Three things left on March 9

When the first review opens, the applicant, the substance of the request and a summary of the risk assessment are published on the Commission's website (Article 28-12(6)). That first list could become the year's industry map. The second is the scope of the exemptions. Article 28-15 lets the Commission set aside, "through deliberation and resolution", ten provisions — including limits on use for other purposes, notice of where data came from, restrictions on sensitive data, and limits on overseas processing. Approval is not a blanket waiver. The third is public interest. Hwawoo Law Firm notes that how far a strongly commercial AI service can make that case has yet to be settled in subordinate rules or review practice.

The door opens on March 9. The price is set in the review room; the pace depends on who has the paperwork ready to file.

factCheck.title: Fact check & sources
factCheck.note: The 30 days and 15 days of deliberation are not provisions of the enforcement ordinance, but are the operational goals stated by the Personal Information Commission. Article 29-15 of this Enforcement Decree does not include a time limit for deliberation and processing, and only stipulates that a 'considerable period' can be requested when supplementation is necessary (P&C provided an explanation saying that it is preparing for processing within 30 days for the first time or 15 days for similar processing, and Maeil Business Newspaper reported the same in the Personal Information Committee's explanation). On the other hand, the provisions of Article 28-14 of the Act remain as they are: ‘if the processing is not commenced within 6 months, all processing shall be restricted’ and if conditions and requirements are not met, ‘all processing shall be restricted.’ The number of 38 companies in the regulatory sandbox is a cumulative number since January 2024, which the Personal Information Commission announced on May 15, 2026, and may have increased further thereafter. ‘About 28 and a half months’ and ‘average of 1.3 places per month’ are our own calculations divided by the number of months from January 2024 to May 15, 2026. The scope of the risk factor assessment is different from the four types reported by the media, as the Enforcement Decree defines five types, and the last one is delegated to the committee notice. The exclusion from the application of the 10 provisions of Article 28-15 of the Act is not an automatic or blanket exemption, but is decided on a case-by-case basis through committee deliberation and resolution, and the text was revised as such during the review by the Legislation and Judiciary Committee of the National Assembly (Huawei commentary). ‘90 sessions each of technical and legal consulting in the 2027 budget’ is the support plan revealed in the regulatory impact analysis, and this does not represent the forecast for the total number of applications. In the EU comparison, 'no prior approval' means that the GDPR does not have a separate approval process for AI learning and focuses on the processor's legality judgment and recording, the data subject's objection, and the supervisory authority's follow-up investigation. It does not mean that the EU freely allows the use of personal information. The last sentence, 'The price is determined in the deliberation room, and the speed depends on when the application can be used' and the statement that the first list may be the industrial landscape are not confirmed facts, but interpretations of the text.

title: The price is set at €82.32, but no certificate can be bought yet — the year that closes on 31 December
deck: The EU has fixed the third-quarter CBAM certificate price at €82.32 per tonne. Certificates go on sale only on 1 February 2027, and the first declaration is due on 30 September that year. A tonne of Korean hot-rolled coil works out to about 120,000 won, and the door to domestic verification opened in Korea only on 5 November.
author: Insight Brief Editorial Room
summary: On October 5, the European Commission confirmed the price of CBAM certificates for the third quarter at 82.32 euros per ton. It is the highest this year, 9.4% higher than 75.36 euros in the first quarter and 75.28 euros in the second quarter, but certificate sales will begin on February 1, 2027.

If you add 10% of the 2026 addition to the default value of 2.118 tCO2e for Korean hot-rolled coil (CN 7208) and subtract the free allocation, it is 81.83 euros per ton, or about 120,000 won. The Chinese product with the same calculation costs 178.63 euros, which is more than twice the price of the Korean product.

The Korean Standards Association was recognized as Korea's first CBAM verification agency on November 5, but the 2026 data closes on December 31 and the first report is September 30, 2027, so verification demand is concentrated in the first half of the year. From 2028, it will be expanded to include downstream products such as automobile parts and home appliances.
body:
The Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy announced on November 12. As of November 5, the Korean Standards Association was recognized as a verification agency for the European Union Carbon Border Adjustment System (CBAM) by the Italian national accreditation body (Accredia). This is the first time for a Korean institution, and two additional institutions (Korea Foundation for Quality and Korea Management Certification Board) are currently reviewing it.

The reason this recognition is important is for the calendar, not the value. The 2026 emissions limit for steel, aluminum, cement, fertilizer, electricity, and hydrogen to the European Union will close on December 31, the first report and certificate submission will be September 30, 2027, and certificate sales will begin on February 1 of that year. The job of exporting companies is to verify one year’s worth of emissions and hand them over to the European importer.

> “If not verified, default values, which are usually set higher than actual emissions, may be applied, increasing the cost burden on companies.” — Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment, November 12, 2026

![Yards in European ports early in the morning. Packed aluminum ingots are stacked next to a pile of dew-soaked hot-rolled coils, and a cargo ship hangs in the fog behind them. Image · AI illustration](/assets/img/articles/cbam-verification-first-bill-2027.jpg)

## The value has already been determined three times

On October 5, the Commission confirmed the certificate price for the third quarter at 82.32 euros per tonne. It is the highest this year, 9.4% higher than 75.36 euros in the first quarter and 75.28 euros in the second quarter. Fourth quarter values ​​are due on January 4, 2027. From 2026, it will be the quarterly average price, and from 2027, it will be the weekly average price. The price is already known, but certificates can only be purchased on the joint central platform from February 2027.

## 2.118 becomes 2.33

The basic emission of Korean hot-rolled coil (CN 7208) is 2.118 tCO2e per ton. If you add the 10% additional rate attached to the 2026 income, it becomes 2.33. If we subtract the free allocation share (BF/BOF benchmark 1.370 × CBAM coefficient 97.5% = 1.33575), the actual target is 0.9941 tCO2e. Multiplying the price in the third quarter, it is 81.83 euros per ton, or about 120,000 won in won.

If you do the same calculation with the Chinese default value of 3.187, it is 178.63 euros. Just looking at the basic values, the carbon bill of Korean steel is less than half that of Chinese steel. The additional rate is 20% from 2027 and 30% from 2028. If actual measurements are not recognized, the same amount of emissions becomes more expensive every year.

## If you use the default value, no verification is required.

This is where we diverge. There is no verification obligation for importers using default values. Verification is only necessary for those who wish to have the actual measurements recognized. The choice for exporting companies is not “Can you get verified?” but “Will you accept the default value of 2.33 or pay the cost and time for verification?” The default value is usually set higher than the actual measurement.

## Door opened on November 5th

Verification is not at the business site level. Process boundaries are determined for each product destined for the European Union, and the emissions of incoming precursor materials are also added. It is different from the units familiar from the emissions trading system (K-ETS), and the monitoring plan is also subject to verification. As of last month, there were only seven member countries accepting applications for offshore verification agencies, including Italy, Sweden, and the Netherlands. Until then, raw material and fuel records had to be transferred overseas, paying for the auditor's airfare and interpretation costs.

## The bottleneck is not the value, but the calendar

Verification can begin only when data from January 1 to December 31, 2026 is confirmed, and submission is due until September 30, 2027. A year's worth of demand is concentrated in the remaining 9 months. Even if the number of verification agencies increases to three, the calendar remains the same. The government published a practical manual containing calculation cases in March and provided expert consultation to 100 workplaces.

## 50-ton threshold and 2028

Not everyone is a target. Importers of less than 50 tons per year are exempt from reporting and certification obligations. According to the Commission's estimates, about 90% of importers are exempt, but their emissions are only about 1%. Importers with large volumes will remain, and most European customers of Korean small and medium-sized businesses will be large corporations.

Weight will increase in 2028. An amendment is being prepared to expand the scope to include steel and aluminum downstream products, and automobile parts and home appliances are also within the jurisdiction. The final item is confirmed only after internal procedures are completed. Exports to the European Union in October were $8.1 billion, and automobiles alone from October 1 to 25 were $800 million. Steel costs $200 million and aluminum costs $400 million per year (industry estimates). Currently, the bills are confined to steel and aluminum, but by 2028, they will extend to automobiles and home appliances. The UK also plans to launch its own system in January 2027.

## Industries other than steel

Plastics and recycled raw materials are not yet subject to CBAM. Packaging pressure comes from the European Union Packaging and Packaging Regulations (PPWR). Application began on August 12, 2026, and there is still no method for calculating the content of recycled raw materials. For those who import and use raw materials, the two regulatory calendars overlap. CBAM increases the cost of steel and aluminum customers, and PPWR requires a greater proportion of recycled raw materials.

There are three things to see in the remaining five weeks. Do European customers require actual emissions, when do they hire a verification agency, and is it cheaper to go with the default than the verification cost? After December 31, the data for 2026 will not increase further. The only thing that can be changed is the verification method and timing of submission.

factCheck.title: Fact check & sources
factCheck.note: For the certificate price, only the confirmed values ​​from the Commission's official page (Q1 75.36, Q2 75.28, Q3 82.32 euros) were used, and only the fact that the fourth quarter value was scheduled to be announced on January 4, 2027 was stated. The 9.4% increase rate is calculated as 82.32÷75.28. 81.83 euros per ton is our calculation. The components are all taken from public data (Korean default 2.118 = Commission default regulations, benchmark 1.370 and 2026 CBAM coefficient 97.5% = delegated regulations/guidelines, quarterly price 82.32 = Commission), but it is the DeCarbonPro working paper that presents this combination and not the cost per ton officially announced by the European Union. Actual charges may vary if free allocation deduction methods and precursor calculation exceptions apply. The 1,467.69 won used for won conversion was the trading base rate on November 23 (Notice by the Bank of Korea, posted by LME KOREA) and was rounded to 'approximately 120,000 won'. 178.63 euros from China is the calculation from the same working paper. '90% of importers exempted from 50 tons, 1% of emissions' is a value quoted by secondary literature as the Commission's estimate, and the original text of the Commission could not be directly verified. 'Exemption from verification when using default values' is based on the revised regulations (2025/2083) and domestic commentary data, and verification by a recognized verification agency is mandatory to use actual emissions. The US$200 million for steel and US$400 million for aluminum per year for the EU in October are respectively the values ​​quoted by the media and estimates from industry insiders, and the figures directly confirmed from the text of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy's press release are US$8.10 billion for the EU as a whole and US$800 million for automobiles from October 1 to 25. The number of member countries receiving applications from offshore verification agencies is as of October and may have increased since then. The items subject to downstream goods in 2028 have not been confirmed at the revision stage. The British system was only listed as ‘to be implemented’. The statement that plastics and recycled raw materials are not subject to CBAM is based on the current six items, and it has not been confirmed whether it will be expanded in the future.

title: 10 trillion won for 100 people — What Amazon bought before selling the chip is ‘the money it costs to change the chip’
deck: Amazon decided to buy Decart's optimization software DOS and its founder and researchers. Amazon did not disclose the amount, but Bloomberg and Calcalist reported it as $7.5 billion (approximately 10.1 trillion won). Based on 100 employees, it is 101 billion won per person. Amazon will sell Tranium outside of AWS at the end of 2027. To sell chips, you have to pay the customer's moving costs first.

The amount was not disclosed. Bloomberg reported about $7.5 billion, and Calcalist reported $7.5 billion (cash and stock split payment). When applying the sales standard rate of 1,346.60 won, it is approximately 10.1 trillion won.

Antropic negotiated to purchase the same assets entirely in stock for about $6 billion in August, but withdrew in early September. Amazon will sell Tranium outside of AWS starting in late 2027. In the performance announcement on October 29, it was revealed that sales commitments for Tranium and Graviton each increased more than 20 times in one year. The competitor is NVIDIA (86% share of data center AI chips), which has built the CUDA ecosystem.

Korea's semiconductor exports from January to October reached a record high of $396.8 billion (42.7% of the total, +193.1%), but the total sales of Rebellion (sales of 32 billion won, operating loss of 120.5 billion won) and Furiosa AI (sales of 5.7 billion won, operating loss of 62.5 billion won) in 2025 are KRW 37.7 billion. It is won (about 28 million dollars). The place where the value is attached is not the chip, but the software layer that allows the chip to be replaced.
body:
On November 23, 2026, what Amazon bought was not a company, but a set of technologies. Amazon announced, “We are purchasing the proprietary technology of the Decart Optimization Stack (DOS) and welcoming three co-founders and a team of AI researchers and engineers.” The amount was not disclosed. Bloomberg and Calcalist put it at $7.5 billion. As of November 24, the base selling rate was 1,346.60 won, which is about 10.1 trillion won, and with about 100 employees, it is 101 billion won per person.

> "Every leap forward in AI starts with getting more out of every chip."
> — Peter DeSantis, Amazon Senior Vice President of Basic AI Models, Custom Semiconductors, and Quantum Computing, November 23, 2026

![Above a canyon where two huge chips stand facing each other like buildings, a golden box of code blocks is being transported by a glass bridge. Below, people in work clothes walk in a line down the server rack hallway. Image · AI Illustration](/assets/img/articles/amazon-decart-chip-switching-cost-2026.jpg)

## Two months when 6 billion became 7.5 billion

These assets did not originally belong to Amazon. Bloomberg reported in August that Antropic had negotiated to purchase Decart entirely in stock for $6 billion and completed due diligence. The expression of Calcalist, which announced its withdrawal on September 8, was, “After reviewing the business and technology, we decided not to purchase.” Globes reported that Antropic made the offer conditional on closing its development center in Israel and relocating to San Francisco, which Descartes rejected. The reasons vary depending on the report. The value went from 6 billion to 7.5 billion dollars in two months. Globes reported that the transaction will be completed in January 2027 after regulatory approval, and that the three founders will receive a significant portion of the payment after five years. There is no completion date for Amazon's announcement.

## What did you buy and what did you not buy?

The object of Amazon’s announcement is not the company. It is “the proprietary technology behind DOS.” Videos and world models (Oasis 3, Lucy) are not mentioned. What lives is the code and people, and what remains is the company and its sales. DOS is not software tied to a specific chip in the first place. Reuters described DOS as “a software engine that makes AI systems run faster and move more easily between Nvidia, Amazon, and Google chips.” Nvidia also participated in Decart's $300 million round in May.

However, the only chips mentioned in Amazon's announcement are Tranium and Graviton. There is no word on whether DOS will continue to support competing chips. The test method for the 1,600 tokens per second (200 in the industry) proposed by Decart is not disclosed.

## The day Amazon sells chips

The reason for buying was revealed in the performance announcement on October 29th. “Customers continue to ask us to make Tranium available outside of AWS, and we plan to do so by the end of 2027,” CEO Andy Jassy said. The chip business grew by triple digits, and Tranium and Graviton contracts each increased more than 20 times in one year. Torch Neuron, an open source tool that runs on Tranium without modifying the existing PyTorch code, was also released. In his April shareholder letter, Jassy wrote that the externally sold chip business could be worth $50 billion a year.

The market still belongs to NVIDIA. According to Visual Capitalist estimates, the data center AI chip market share in the fourth quarter of 2025 is 86% for Nvidia, 10% for AMD, and 4% for Intel. The line of defense is not only about performance. This is the CUDA ecosystem that has been built since 2006. The Software Policy Research Institute analyzed that “even if competing chips offer similar performance, they increase switching costs and entrench dependency.” Those who want to sell chips must pay the customer's moving costs first. 10 trillion won is considered the moving cost.

## Two numbers in Korea: 42.7% and 37.7 billion won

Korea achieved a record high in hardware. According to the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy, semiconductor exports from January to October amounted to $396.8 billion, up 193.1% from a year ago and accounting for 42.7% of total exports. Annual exports exceeded 1 trillion dollars for the first time on November 19. High bandwidth memory (HBM) market share is 83.0% (2nd quarter), DRAM 65.6% (1st half).

Domestic companies on the same floor are small. Rebellion has 2025 sales of 32 billion won, operating loss of 120.5 billion won, and corporate value of 3.4 trillion won (March). Furiosa AI has sales of 5.7 billion won and an operating loss of 62.5 billion won. The combined sales of the two companies, 37.7 billion won, is just over $28 million, or 1/268th of the $7.5 billion that Amazon spent on Decart. It is precisely this layer that both companies make. Rebellion boasts a torch.compile support SDK, and FuriosaAI boasts its own compiler. The Export-Import Bank's Overseas Economic Research Institute assessed that there is a gap of more than three years between them and leading companies in terms of capital, commercialization experience, and ecosystem.

## place with value

The place where the value was attached was not the wafer or HBM. It was the cost for the customer to change chips. Some things remain unconfirmed. $7.5 billion is not a number disclosed by Amazon. When Tranium begins to move out of AWS in late 2027, the next question is who sets the price of the software running on the chip.

factCheck.title: Fact check & sources
factCheck.note: The transaction amount of $7.5 billion is not the value disclosed by Amazon, but the value reported by Bloomberg (an official familiar with the situation) and Calcalist. Amazon's statement did not reveal pricing and it declined to comment to Reuters. The won conversion is an internal calculation using the trading base rate of 1,346.60 won announced by the Export-Import Bank of Korea on 2026-11-24 (USD 750 million = KRW 10.0995 trillion, KRW 101 billion per person based on approximately 100 employees reported by Calcalist). '1 in 268' is a comparison between the transaction price and the two companies' total sales in 2025 (KRW 37.7 billion ≈ $28 million), and is not a comparison that places corporate value and sales on the same axis. Rebellion's corporate value of 3.4 trillion won is based on the pre-IPO round in March 2026, and sales and operating loss are based on the 2025 fiscal year. There are conflicting reports about the reason for Antropic's withdrawal. Calcalist (quoted by Bloomberg) reported that after due diligence, 'after reviewing the business and technology, we decided not to purchase', and Globes cited the conditions for closing the Israeli development center and relocating to San Francisco and Decart's refusal. There has been no announcement from the parties that revealed which of the two reasons was confirmed. Completed in January 2027, the founder's five-year tenure was reported by Globe and Calcalist, and Amazon did not disclose the completion date. DOS's 1,600 tokens per second and 100 frames in Full HD were claims presented by Decart during the round in May 2026, and could not be verified because the test method was not disclosed. Data center AI chip market share (Nvidia 86%) is an estimate for the fourth quarter of 2025 by market research firm Visual Capitalist, confirmed by a Maeil Business Newspaper report. The sentences 'Those who want to sell chips must pay the customer's moving expenses first' and the expression '10 trillion won for moving expenses' are not confirmed facts but interpretations of the text.

title: Quotas have been pushed back three times and stocks are at 95 days — figures in Guinea bauxite document due this week
deck: Guinea said it would release a document to regulate bauxite production later this month. The upper limit expected in the market by a country that sold 165 million tons between January and September of this year is 150 million tons. However, the price did not move from 70 to 72 yuan throughout the second half of the year. This is because Chinese refineries hold 95 days worth of inventory.
author: Insight Brief Editorial Room
summary: Guinea exported 165 million tons of bauxite from January to September 2026, catching up with the 2025 annual record (183 million tons) with three months left, and shipments to China from January 1 to November 13 increased by 19.08% compared to the previous year. The minister said he would release a production regulation document at the end of this month, but promises made in March and May were not kept both times.

Value has not yet responded. Guinean 45/3 grade Chinese port spot was 70-72/dmt yuan throughout the second half of the year, and the SMM imported bauxite index was 71.63 dollars on November 19. As Chinese alumina refineries hold about 95 days worth of inventory, quota news does not attach to the spot.

Mysteel believes that there are almost no restrictions if the upper limit is 190 to 200 million tons, and that supply and demand will be tight only if it is 150 to 160 million tons. Korea imports all of its aluminum ingots without an alumina refinery, and the price of domestic aluminum sheets fell by 340,000 won in October and 380,000 won in November.
body:
Guinea's Minister of Minerals and Geology, Buna Sylla, spoke at the Simandou Mines Summit on 13 November. They plan to release a document to regulate bauxite production by the end of this month. In mid-March, they said they would reduce exports in early April, and in late May, they said they would introduce a quota system in June. Both times, no documents were released.

> “Before the end of this month we will announce regulations on Guinean bauxite production. Oversupply is not good for the market.” — Buna Sila, November 13, 2026

![Heaps of red bauxite extend to the riverside docks, and long conveyors pour the ore into bulk ships. Alumina refinery silos at the back. Image · AI illustration](/assets/img/articles/guinea-bauxite-quota-alumina-2027.jpg)

## The year caught up with three months left

Guinea exported 165 million tons of bauxite between January and September this year. This amount catches up with the 183 million tons sold in 2025 with three months remaining. According to Mysteel's satellite tracking, shipments from Guinea to China increased 19.08% from January 1 to November 13 compared to the previous year. China receives 70-74% of its bauxite imports from Guinea. The quota upper limit that the market has been expecting is 150 million tons, 18% lower than the 2025 performance.

## Futures wavered and spot stopped

The value did not move. Chinese port spot for 45/3 grade ore from Guinea was 70-72 yuan/dmt throughout the second half of the year, and the SMM imported bauxite index was 71.63 dollars on November 19. The long-term contract between Guinea and China in November was $72 per ton, but the basic freight rate was lowered by $6 to $7 compared to October, which lowered the price.

The reason is inventory. As of November 19, the number of days in possession at Chinese alumina refineries was about 95 days, and those with generous long-term contracts had 6 to 7 months worth. Since there is no worry about supply being cut off, we do not pay extra for quarter news.

## The freight rate tightened first.

There have been times when supply was reduced without documentation. The Capesize Guinea-China freight rate in March was 28 yuan per ton, but rose to 36 yuan in early May, and mines that were unable to meet the freight rate reduced or stopped shipments in June. The C3 fare in November is $35 to $38. Departures from Guinea ports decreased and increased in the same week, reaching 4.449 million tons and arrivals at Chinese ports at 4.694 million tons.

## If the number is weak, the value goes down.

Mistil sees the number of documents in three ways. If the upper limit is 190 to 200 million tons, there are few practical restrictions. Supply and demand will actually tighten if pushed down to 150 to 160 million tons. Since the volume has already been cleared through the freight channel, a weak document could actually be a trigger that explodes bearish expectations.

China's alumina market is heavy even while waiting for the signal. The operating capacity is the highest ever at 99.2 million tons/year, and the operating rate as of November 19 was 1.83% points lower than the previous week. Shanghai alumina flagship futures fell from 2,618 yuan on November 20 to 2,548 yuan on the 24th.

## Price list, not value

The change that will last longer than quotas is GBX. Guinea said it would launch a bauxite index modeled after the LME as early as 2027. If GBX is established as a FOB standard, the gap between the mine's reported price and the transaction price will be reduced, and the authority to determine the standard price will come to the government. However, until November 18, the formula, management entity, and regulatory text were not made public.

The demand not to send raw light as is is in the same direction. Guinea said it would require alumina to be processed and exported domestically starting in 2027. Some in the industry believe that maritime volume will decrease by 10 to 20 percent when this rule is enacted, but the schedule is likely to be pushed back due to the time it takes to build a refinery. In the same month, Guinea was reviewing the license renewal of Russia's RUSAL subsidiary CBK. Regulations that cut total volume and individual mine production increase plans do not conflict.

## Comes to Korea as aluminum ingots.

There are no alumina refineries or primary aluminum smelters in Korea. Bauxite comes not as ore but as aluminum ingots. Last year, imports of Russian aluminum (HS 76) increased by 41% to 483,084 tons, making it the largest supplier for the first time. Domestic aluminum plate prices are determined by LME aluminum, Japanese port premium (MJP), and exchange rates. The 4th quarter MJP was $255, down 35% from $395 in the previous quarter, and the LME spot average in October was $3,061.11, down 6.58% from September. So, the selling price in October was lowered by 340,000 won per ton and in November by 380,000 won.

Quotas do not reverse this trend now. LME alumina was at $398.23 on November 11-13, up 8% from $369 on September 30, but this level still leaves smelter margins. However, if quotas are actually tightened, cost pressure will first cut smelter margins and then come later to domestic sales prices. It is a variable that will reverse the trend of price cuts next year.

There are three things to look at in this week’s document. Is the cap 150 million tonnes or 190 million tonnes, is GBX mandatory in the contract, and is the processing obligation deferred to 2027? If the document is weak, the value will be lower than it is now. If it is strong, long-term contract negotiations for 2027 with Chinese refineries will move first in December.

GBX is scheduled for implementation 'as early as 2027', and as of November 18, the formula, management entity, and regulatory text have not been disclosed, so it is not assumed to be implemented. The 10-20% reduction in processing obligations and cargo volume in 2027 was the minister's statement and industry estimates in June 2026, and the possibility of an extension of the schedule was also reported. Departures from Guinea ports amounted to 4.449 million tons and arrivals from Chinese ports amounted to 4.694 million tons as of the week of November 13. The statement that there are no alumina refineries and primary aluminum smelters in Korea was based on secondary literature (Korea Nonferrous Metals Association, e-Nara Indicator citation) that compiled trade and statistical data, and the association's original text could not be directly verified. The 483,084 tonnes from Russia is the entire HS 76 (aluminium and its products) and not just aluminum ingots (7601). The 4th quarter MJP of $255 is the value quoted by Steel and Metal Newspaper based on a Reuters report. The selling price reduction is 340,000 won in October and 380,000 won in November. The path through which bauxite quotas are transferred to domestic sales prices via alumina costs is an interpretation based on structure, and there is no numerical data confirming the extent of the transfer. title: National pension extra payment, November 30th is the last 9.5% of this year — 300,000 won more in December for the same 60 months
deck: The additional premium is calculated at the rate of the month in which the payment is due, not the month of application. For applications filed in November, 9.5% must be paid by December 31, and for applications filed in December, 10% must be paid by January 31, 2027. If the standard monthly income is 1 million won for 60 months, it is 5.7 million won and 6 million won. Up to 119 months, required document is marriage certificate (detailed).
author: Insight Brief Editorial Room
summary: The national pension extra payment (later payment) premium is calculated at the rate of the ‘month in which payment is due’ rather than the ‘month of application’ due to the revision of the National Pension Act that took effect on November 25, 2025. If you apply in November 2026, the payment due date is December 31st, so 9.5% is applied. If you apply in December, 10% is applied, because it is January 31, 2027.

If you complete 60 months with a standard monthly income of 1 million won, the application in November is 5.7 million won, and the application in December is 6 million won. The limit is up to 119 months, including military service, and a lump sum payment or up to 60 installments (interest added for installment payments) is possible. To apply, you must be a current national pension subscriber.

If you file in December and pay in the same month, there is a special supplementary provision for December 2025 to 2032 that uses the same year's rate, but the specific procedure for paying in December is not confirmed in the Corporation's general guidance in a structure where the bill comes out the following month. 1355 Prior confirmation is required.
body:
**November 30th is the last '9.5% door' of this year.** The national pension additional payment (subsequent payment) premium is calculated at the premium rate of the month in which the payment is due, not the month of application. This rule changed with the revision of the National Pension Act, which took effect on November 25, 2025. If you file in November, the payment due date is December 31st, so the 2026 rate of 9.5% will be charged. If you file in December, the payment due date will be January 31, 2027, and a 10% rate will be charged.

If you look at the numbers, it is like this. When a person with a standard monthly income of 1 million won renews 60 months, the application in November is 5.7 million won, and the application in December is 6 million won. It costs 300,000 won more to live for the same period. Additional payment is not compulsory and applies only to those who apply. So, this 300,000 won is ‘the money you have to pay if you don’t decide now.’

## Why does the rate look at the ‘payment month’ rather than the ‘application month’?

Article 92, Paragraph 3 of the National Pension Act defines the extra-paid insurance premium as “the amount calculated by multiplying the pension insurance premium for the month in which the payment due date under Paragraph 6 falls by the number of months in the period during which payment is to be made later.” Only the standard monthly income amount is based on the month of application. Before the revision on November 25, 2025, the rate was also based on the month in which the application was made.

The reason for the revision stated by the Corporation is fairness. If you apply in December 2025 and pay in January 2026, the pre-increase rate of 9.0% before the revision was applied, and the increased income replacement rate of 43% was calculated. The problem was that the conditions were different for subscribers who paid insurance premiums every month. The revised law also eliminated the advantages and disadvantages between December applicants and other applicants.

The example in the corporation's press release is a standard monthly income of 1 million won and a lump sum payment for 50 months. Before revision, 9.0% is 4.5 million won, and after revision, 9.5% is 4.75 million won. The insurance premium rate will rise by 0.5 percentage points each year to 9.5% in 2026 and 10% in 2027, reaching 13% in 2033. This means that while rates are rising, the cost of filling the same month becomes more expensive every year.

|When to apply|Sending notice (approximately)|Payment due date|Applicable insurance premium rate|
|---|---|---|---|
|November 2026|December 11-15|December 31, 2026|9.5%|
|December 2026|January 11-15, 2027|January 31, 2027|10.0%|
|January 2027|February 11-15, 2027|February 28, 2027|10.0%|

Source: National Pension Service later payment guide (confirmed in November 2026), 2026 rate is National Pension Act effective November 25, 2025. The date the bill is sent is the value provided by the corporation as 'approximately'.

## Same 60 months, 5.7 million won and 6 million won

The additional insurance premium is calculated by multiplying three numbers. The standard monthly income amount for the month in which the application is applied × the insurance premium rate for the month in which the payment due date falls × the number of additional payment months. The most frequently misunderstood point is that the current reported income is the standard, not the income from the past when you were unable to pay. Even if you are an employee subscriber, you pay the entire amount of additional insurance premiums yourself, rather than the company adding half of it.

|Standard monthly income|60 months, 9.5%|60 months, 10%|Differences|
|---|---|---|---|
|1 million won|5.7 million won|6 million won|300,000 won|
|2 million won|11.4 million won|12 million won|600,000 won|
|3 million won|17.1 million won|18 million won|900,000 won|

The table shows the values directly inserted into the calculation formula based on a lump sum payment. The actual notice amount is confirmed through inquiry by the corporation. The 119 months to fully reach the limit ranges from the standard monthly income of 1 million won to 11,305,000 won. If it is difficult to pay at once, you can split it into up to 60 installments on a monthly basis, and in this case, interest is charged based on the interest rate of a one-year term deposit.

## Who can apply and how long it can be completed

Only National Pension subscribers can apply for additional payments. You must report your income or be enrolled voluntarily or continue to be voluntarily enrolled. If you are exempt from payment due to lack of income, you cannot apply immediately, and you will be eligible only after you start paying again.

There are three periods that can be filled. This includes periods of exemption from payment due to unemployment, leave of absence, or business interruption, periods of exclusion from coverage as a non-income spouse or recipient of basic livelihood security after paying premiums for more than one month, and periods of military service after January 1, 1988. The three together add up to 119 months. Periods excluded from application due to overseas migration are not eligible, and service already entered during the military pension or other public pension period is also excluded.

There are many people who get caught in documents. If you do not submit a marriage certificate (indicating both details and resident registration number), your application will not be processed. If you have a history of divorce or bereavement before 2008, you must add a copy of your military registration, and if you want to complete your military service period, you will need a certificate of military registration or a copy of your resident registration that includes military service information. Applications can be made on the Corporation's website, mobile app 'National Pension near me', by visiting a branch, or through Government 24. For inquiries, call 1355.

## Doors are not completely closed in December

There is one exception to the law. From 2025 to 2032, there is a supplementary provision that applies the rate for that year if application is made in December and payment is made in the same month. For December 2026, it is 9.5%. In December 2025, the Corporation guided the same situation to two paths. If you apply in December and pay in January 2026, the insurance premium rate is 9.5% and the income replacement rate is 43%, so you will 'pay a little more and receive more', and if you apply in December and pay in December, you will 'pay a little less and get less', with 9.0% and 41.5%.

The problem is the procedure. Since the bill is issued on the 11th to 15th of the month following the month of application, the corporation's general guidance does not specify how payment is actually made within December. If you are planning to postpone until December, it is safer to check first whether payment is due in December on 1355 before filing. If you push it to the last week of December without checking, there will be no time left to turn back.

Here's one more. The income replacement rate is determined by the month in which the extra premium is paid. If it is paid within 2026, it is in the 43% range, and if it goes to 2027, the standard will be applied at that time. It is easy to miss this part if you only look at the rate.

## Remaining Judgment: Should I Buy Now?

The essence of extra payment is ‘how much more do you pay and how many months of subscription do you live for?’ To complete 60 months, a total of 5.7 million won is spent on a standard monthly income of 1 million won. In 119 months, it is 11.3 million won. If you don't have any extra money, there's no reason to push it into November. You can apply for extra payment at any time before receiving the pension, and as the rate rises, it only becomes more expensive, but eligibility does not disappear.

However, if you do not want to pay 300,000 won more for the same period, the choice is clear. All you have to do is apply in November and pay by December 31st. The practical point of this system is that application and payment are separate. Since the Corporation provides free information on the number of months you can fill and the expected pension amount before and after additional payments, it is better to obtain both values ​​first before deciding on the amount.

**Confirmed** — Change in rate base month (Article 92, Paragraph 3, effective November 25, 2025), 9.5% in 2026, 10% in 2027, 13% in 2033, maximum 119 months, required documents, payment deadline structure, 60 installments and installment interest. **Unconfirmed** — Specific procedure for payment in the same month after filing in December, number of months in which additional payments can be made for each individual and pension increase (requires inquiry by the Corporation), actual applied interest rate for installment payment interest (interest rate on one-year maturity term deposit at the time of notification).

title: Reports increased by 5,420% and people increased by 34% — the number of people at the counter receiving 1.33 million cases was 79.
deck: Korea Financial Intelligence Unit celebrated its 25th anniversary. In 2025, there were 1,333,391 reports of suspicious transactions, of which 44,680 (3.4%) were analyzed in detail. During the same period, the workforce increased by 34% from 59 to 79 people. The suspension of transactions on accounts suspected of new phishing, which began on June 30, stopped 11,586 cases by the end of October, and the number of users next year will be 105.
author: Insight Brief Editorial Room
summary: The Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) celebrated its 25th anniversary. Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) increased more than 100 times from 13,000 in 2005 to 1,333,391 in 2025, but FIU manpower only increased by 34% from 59 to 79 during the same period. The detailed analysis rate in 2025 is 3.4%.

As of the end of October, 11,586 transactions were suspended due to the suspension of new phishing suspicious accounts implemented on June 30. In the first half of this year, voice phishing damage amounted to 7,033 cases and KRW 327.6 billion, a 61.0% decrease in the number of cases and a 52.3% decrease in the amount of damage. The government plans to expand the scope of transaction suspensions to include all crimes that violate the public's livelihood and legislate the objection process.

FIU will increase the number of students from 79 to 105 next year and introduce an AI screening and analysis system starting in 2027. The 5th FATF mutual evaluation will come first in March 2028, and only Korea and the United States have not introduced anti-money laundering obligations for lawyers, accountants, and tax accountants.
body:
On November 23, a ceremony commemorating the 25th anniversary of the establishment of the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) and the 20th Anti-Money Laundering Day was held at the Westin Chosun Hotel in Seoul. In his commemorative speech, Chairman Lee Eok-won of the Financial Services Commission called the anti-money laundering system "an essential infrastructure that maintains sound financial order and trust by blocking the infiltration of criminal funds into the financial system." FIU, which opened on November 28, 2001, receives 1.33 million Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) per year for the first time in 25 years. This is more than 100 times the number of 13,000 cases in 2005.

There is another number in the Memorial material that should be placed alongside this number. FIU has a quota of 79 people, of which 42 are in charge of actual analysis work. Among the 1,333,391 STRs received in 2025, 44,680 cases, or 3.4%, led to detailed analysis.

> “STR analysis needs to be advanced to select and analyze high-risk transactions” — FIU official, Asia Economy, April 5, 2026

![Report documents, which have increased from 13,000 to 1.33 million, are piled up like a mountain in front of the narrow screening gate, and two analysts in front of the gate are flipping through each sheet with a magnifying glass. The detailed analysis rate in 2025 was 3.4%.](/assets/img/articles/aml-25-years-1330k-reports-2026.jpg)

## Reporting multiplied 100 times, organization increased by 34%

According to the Asian Economy report (April 5, 2026) citing FIU data, STRs increased by 5,420% from 24,149 in 2006 to 1,333,391 in 2025. During the same period, FIU's workforce only increased by 34% from 59 to 79 people. The detailed analysis rate fell from 4.5% in 2020 to 2.9% in 2023 and then rebounded slightly. The number of STR cases per employee per year is approximately 17,000, which is an order of magnitude different from Australia (730 cases), Germany (350 cases), and France (1,000 cases).

The increase in reporting is itself an achievement. In 2024, STRs exceeded 1 million for the first time, and the FIU annual report evaluated this as “a sign that the function of detecting suspicious transactions early and gathering them in one place is working.” The problem is the next step. Of the 1.33 million cases collected, more than 96% remain in the computerized/basic analysis stage without undergoing detailed analysis.

## 11,586 accounts suspended since June 30

The number that actually reaches the people is different. Since June 30, FIU, together with the National Police Agency and the financial sector, has been temporarily suspending transactions for accounts suspected of new types of phishing, such as no-show scams, romance scams, and team mission scams. As of the Financial Services Commission's press release, there were 11,586 accounts suspended as of the end of October. Of the 6,914 cases reported as of August 21, 5,018 had transaction suspensions based on strengthened customer verification under the Specific Financial Information Act.

In the background, there was a gap in the system. Under the current system, even accounts suspected of being related to criminal proceeds are difficult to freeze without a court decision, barring some exceptions. The government plans to amend the Special Financial Services Act to provide a legal basis so that the FIU can directly suspend accounts suspected of crimes that violate the public's livelihood, such as drugs, gambling, and terrorist financing. It was also decided to legislate the objection process for disputes when legitimate transactions are halted.

The scale of damage is decreasing. According to the Financial Supervisory Service, there were 7,033 cases of voice phishing damage worth 327.6 billion won in the first half of this year, a 61.0% decrease in the number of cases and a 52.3% decrease in the amount of damage compared to the same period last year. However, 300 billion won was still withdrawn in half a year, and the method has evolved into a psychological control type, such as 'self-imprisonment', where the victim is isolated in a motel.

## The number that grew first in virtual assets

The axis that has driven the increase in STR is virtual assets. STRs related to virtual assets jumped from 199 in 2021 to 62,055 in 2025. In August, the financial authorities revised the Enforcement Decree of the Special Financial Services Act to specify reporting requirements such as financial soundness and social credit for virtual asset business operators and the scope of review of major shareholders, and abolished the standard amount for applying the travel rule. Transfers to high-risk overseas businesses and personal wallets are also managed separately. Unreported sales are responded to by requesting an investigation and blocking access to the website.

At 3 p.m. on the 24th, the Financial Services Commission will hold a virtual asset committee meeting at the Seoul Government Complex. The results of the virtual asset business re-reporting application according to the revised Special Financial Services Act supplementary provisions will be distributed in the evening paper on this day. The first check point is how many businesses remain in the market after the reporting threshold is raised.

## From 79 to 105, but 2028 comes first

The government's answer is to increase the number of people. FIU will increase the number of students by 26 from 79 to 105 next year. Starting in 2027, an AI-based screening analysis system and virtual asset tracking solution will be introduced. However, this schedule is later than the 5th mutual evaluation of the Financial Action Task Force (FATF), which begins in March 2028. The evaluation will continue for approximately 14 months, and the results will be adopted at the general meeting in June 2029. Korea was subject to 'enhanced follow-up inspection' in the 4th evaluation in 2020, but moved up to the regular follow-up inspection stage in October 2024.

## Two remaining countries — lawyers, accountants, tax accountants

The national anti-money laundering strategy announced on September 16 included 5 major strategies and 12 implementation tasks, of which the top priorities are managing information on beneficial owners of corporations and trusts and imposing obligations on specified non-financial business operators (DNFBPs). Currently, with the exception of casinos, lawyers, accountants, tax accountants, real estate brokers, and jewelry dealers are not subject to the obligation. Among FATF member countries, Korea and the United States are the only countries that have not introduced this obligation.

The industry’s response is mixed. An accounting industry official said, “Since the system is being created, one more task may increase,” but added, “It will not be difficult for large corporations to respond.” This means that the gap in burden may widen depending on the size of the law and accounting firm. On the other side are international standards. If a problem is identified in the evaluation, overseas financial companies can apply enhanced customer verification (EDD) to Korea-related transactions, and the overseas remittance procedures for domestic companies become correspondingly heavier.

## Between 1.33 million and 44,680

FIU itself believes that quantity does not equal performance. The 2024 Annual Report wrote that it is necessary to “establish a risk-oriented reporting culture rather than formal or excessive reporting.” This means that costs are at stake on both sides, those who increase reporting and those who analyze it.

Ultimately, 25 years of performance is not measured by the number of reports. It is calculated by how many of the 1.33 million cases were actual criminal funds and whether the money was stopped before it reached the public. As a result of the re-reporting in the evening paper on the 24th, next year's number is 105, and the evaluation in 2028 makes that number again.

factCheck.title: Fact check & sources
factCheck.note: In 2025, 1,333,391 STRs, 44,680 detailed analyzes (3.4%), 79 quota, 42 analysis personnel, 17,000 cases per person are based on the Asian Economic Report (2026-04-05) citing FIU data. We could not confirm the value that FIU announced in a separate press release for the same item, and in a report citing National Assembly data from September, the number of review and analysis personnel was listed as 43. The 13,000 cases in 2005 are based on the Financial Services Commission commemorative speech, and the 24,149 cases in 2006 are based on FIU data, so the two base years are different. The 11,586 new phishing transaction suspensions are accumulated from June 30 to October 31, and 5,018 of the 6,914 cases are from August 21, so the period is different. The number of 7,033 voice phishing cases and KRW 327.6 billion is the Financial Supervisory Service's tally for the first half of 2026 (January to June). Next year's quota of 105 people is government policy and is not a final budget, and the introduction of an AI analysis system in 2027 and the 5th FATF evaluation in March 2028 (adopted at the general meeting in June 2029) are government plans. The anti-money laundering obligation for lawyers, accountants, tax accountants, etc. is not an obligation that has been confirmed in the review/promotion stage. The holding of the Virtual Asset Committee at 15:00 on the 24th and the distribution of the evening edition of the re-reporting results are scheduled based on the Financial Services Commission's weekly schedule (11-21).

body:
On May 8, 2026, the Ministry of Science and ICT disclosed the 693 companies subject to information protection disclosure obligations for that year, and the votes posted by those companies as of June 30 were recently compiled. There were 826 publicly announced companies (773 last year), and the investment in information protection increased by 23.5% to KRW 2.9916 trillion. The total information technology (IT) investment in the same table was 48.7741 trillion won, of which information security accounted for 6.15%. It is 0.13 percentage points lower than 6.28% a year ago. This rate has not exceeded the 6% range for five years since 6.01% in 2022.

> “Guaranteeing the public’s right to know and encouraging companies to voluntarily invest in information protection”
> — Ministry of Science and ICT, subtitle of press release for Cabinet meeting decision on October 20, 2026

![On an office floor overlooking a city at sunset, light pours in from endless rows of desks, empty forms, and a huge filing cabinet open overhead. Image · AI illustration](/assets/img/articles/infosec-disclosure-2193-2027.jpg)

## From 693 to 2,193

The Amendment Decree of the “Enforcement Decree of the Information Protection Industry Promotion Act” (Presidential Decree No. 36783), passed by the State Council on October 20, 2026 and promulgated on the 27th, will take effect on January 1, 2027. The CISO designation and reporting obligation and the requirement of ‘sales of more than KRW 300 billion in the previous fiscal year’ have been eliminated, making all KOSPI and KOSDAQ listed corporations, excluding special purpose acquisition companies (SPACs), eligible. Under the Information and Communications Network Act, the number of companies subject to Information Security Management System (ISMS) certification (593 companies as of February 2026) will be added, and the exclusion from application for public institutions, small businesses, financial companies, and some electronic financial business operators will also disappear. The number of users changes from ‘daily average for the three months immediately preceding the end of the previous year’ to ‘daily average for the entire previous year’.

The government's regulatory impact analysis estimate is about 2,193 in 2027 and 2,357 after 2029, when the small business moratorium ends. Compared to the 693 companies in 2026, it is calculated that 1,500 companies will submit new votes.

## There are four columns in the table.

The four items are in Article 8, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree. Investment in information security compared to IT investment, dedicated manpower compared to IT personnel, status of certification, evaluation and inspection, and status of other activities. It is supervised by the CISO and must be confirmed by the CEO. The Korea Internet & Security Agency verifies it at least once a year, and if it is different from the facts, corrections can be requested. In practice, it even records whether the CISO and Personal Information Protection Officer (CPO) hold concurrent positions and the distinction between internal and outsourcing of dedicated personnel.

What is required for newly incorporated companies is not a new system, but countable numbers. The problem is distribution. Among 826 companies with KRW 2.9916 trillion, the top 10 (Samsung Electronics KRW 412.1 billion, Coupang KRW 134.9 billion, KT KRW 127.6 billion, etc.) account for 39.2% with KRW 1.173 trillion. The proportions are more divided. Samsung Electronics is 3.6%, Naver 4.5%, and Kakao 4.1%, while Samsung SDS is 12.0% and AhnLab 15.0%. Since the industry is different, it is impossible to say superiority or inferiority based on this ratio. However, most of the 1,500 companies submitting new votes are smaller than the latter.

## The numbers in the first table are for 2026.

Since the effective date is January 1, 2027 and the disclosure deadline is June 30 every year, the first report released by the newly incorporated company will be the 2026 performance. The remaining preparation period is about 7 months. In the commentary on the revised enforcement ordinance, Yulchon pointed out, “There is a need to quickly establish standards for compiling the information security investment and human resources status for 2026.”

Finding manpower is more difficult than determining numbers. According to the Korea Internet & Security Agency's 2025 information security industry survey, there are about 24,000 people working in the cyber and network security fields in Korea. In addition, if thousands of companies hire CISOs and dedicated personnel at once, the price rises. The only incentive offered by the government is a 30% discount on the ISMS/ISMS-P certification review fee. Sanctions apply only to non-disclosure. The fine is 3 million won for the first time, 6 million won for the second time, and 10 million won for the third time or more.

## America measures accidents, Korea measures annual votes

Starting December 18, 2023, the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) required that serious cyber incidents be disclosed as 8-K Item 1.05 within 4 business days from the time they are judged to be serious. In the annual report, the risk management system and board supervision are listed as Item 106. The EU NIS2 directive required transition to member states by October 17, 2024, and the target is estimated to be more than 100,000 institutions in 18 fields. Korea’s disclosure is not an accident, but an annual quantitative table.

The two numbers count different things. In 2024, the number of infringement incident reports was 1,887, an increase of 48% from 2023, and the number of companies making disclosures in 2026 was 826. However, the government itself announced on April 10, 2026, in its plan to strengthen the effectiveness of the certification system, that 179 certified companies (approximately 14%) have experienced infringement incidents over the past three years. This means that accidents happen even at certified companies.

The value of tripling a table depends not on the number of subjects but on what makes them comparable. By June 30, 2027, there will be 2,193 places to pay for tickets. Whether the ratio, which has stayed in the 6% range for five years, will move or the number will only increase depends on the criteria for counting investment and manpower in 2026, which has already passed.

factCheck.title: Fact check & sources
factCheck.note: The number of target companies was estimated from the government's regulatory impact analysis (approximately 2,193 in 2027 and approximately 2,357 after 2029). The media reported 'about 2,600 companies from 686', but this is close to the approximate value of adding the number of listed companies such as 828 KOSPI and 1,823 KOSDAQ companies, and the first estimate is 2,193. In the main text, '1,500 companies submit new votes' is the simple difference between 2,193 and 693 companies subject to mandatory certification in 2026, and is not a value that removes overlap with those subject to ISMS certification obligations and financial companies. 'Top 10 accounts for 39.2%' is a calculation calculated by adding the top 10 investments by company in the disclosure portal and dividing them by KRW 2.9916 trillion (KRW 1.173 trillion), and it has not been confirmed whether the base date of each company's value (2026-10-26) and the total base date are completely identical. The number of infringement accident reports (1,277 in 2023 → 1,887 in 2024 and 1,034 in the first half of 2025) was confirmed by reports based on the regulatory impact analysis report citing KISA statistics, and KISA raw data was not seen. The number of breaches of 593 companies subject to ISMS certification and 179 companies certified over the past three years (approximately 14%) is the value announced by the government on April 10, 2026, 'Measure to Strengthen the Effectiveness of the Information Protection and Personal Information Protection Management System Certification System', and 593 companies are as of February 2026, so they are not figures as of 2027. Approximately 24,000 security professionals were unable to compare the original report with the values ​​quoted by the media in KISA's '2025 Information Security Industry Survey'. 'The first table of the newly incorporated company will be the 2026 performance' is an interpretation derived from the practice of the enforcement date (2027-01-01) and the disclosure deadline (June 30 every year) and this year's announcement containing the 2025 performance, and is not something the government has stated in a sentence. However, the premise is the same in that Yulchon pointed out in its commentary that the standard for the 2026 status is to be quickly determined. The investment proportion of individual companies (Samsung Electronics 3.6%, Naver 4.5%, etc.) cannot be used as a basis for superiority or inferiority between companies due to the different composition of the industry, and this is also stated in the text. The US SEC and EU NIS2 figures cited each agency's announcement and Commission estimates.

title: The price of PP bags was attached to the price of raw materials — the reason why the offer was lowered first while reducing 2.49 million tons
deck: On November 12, the Korean PP offer in Indonesia reverted the price raised in the same week. The price of Asian PP bags fell by $40 per ton, and the PP-propylene spread turned negative in the third quarter. Korea is reducing capacity by 2.49 million tons in Daesan and Yeosu, but China increased PP exports by 58.2% in the first half of the year. The next signal is 950,000 tons of Kurei in mid-December.
author: Insight Brief Editorial Room
summary: On November 12, Asian PP raffia (CFR Far East) was $1,290 to $1,340 per ton, down $40 from November 4, and the weekly average from November 12 to 18 was $1,270, $30 lower than the previous week. In the same week, the offer for Korean PP block copolymer in Indonesia reversed the raised price, and the offer in Thailand and Vietnam held up.

The raw material propylene FOB Korea became almost the same as PP raffia at $1,280 on November 18. S-Oil announced that the PP-propylene spread in the third quarter flipped from $29 per ton to -$23 per ton, and Hyosung Chemical's PP·DH division went from a profit of 152 billion won in the second quarter to a loss of 20.6 billion won in the third quarter.

Korea approved a reduction of 2.49 million tons, including 1.1 million tons in Daesan and 1.39 million tons in Yeosu and Yeocheon NCC, but it is 210,000 tons short of the lower limit of the government's target. On the other hand, China increased PP exports by 58.2% and PE by 258.1% in the first half of the year, and commercial volume of 950,000 tons of Guray is expected to be released in mid-December.
body:
On November 12, in the Indonesian PP (polypropylene) import market, the Korean block copolymer offer voluntarily reverted the price raised in the same week. Thai and Vietnamese companies maintained their offers citing increased production costs and supply constraints, but only Korean products came down first. The price of Asian PP bags (raffia) that week was $1,290 to $1,340 per ton, down $40 from $1,330 to $1,380 on November 4. In the weekly tally from November 12 to 18, the CFR Far East raffia average was $1,270, $30 lower than the previous week's $1,300.

> “Korean suppliers returned the prices they initially raised within the same week, and Thai and Vietnamese producers maintained high offers, citing higher production costs and prospects for supply constraints.”
> — CommoPlast, November 12, 2026

![A pile of PP raw material bags piled up in the port yard at dawn, with the petrochemical complex's distillation tower and flare stack visible in the background. Image · AI illustration](/assets/img/articles/pp-negative-spread-ncc-cuts-2026.jpg)

## Raw materials rise above finished products

In the same week, propylene FOB Korea was recorded at $1,280 per ton. PP raffia (CFR Far East) was $1,265 to $1,275. Although it is difficult to subtract the two values ​​directly due to the difference in whether or not freight is included, it can be read that the distance between raw materials and finished products has virtually disappeared. The published numbers are clearer. S-Oil announced in its third quarter results that the spread between PP and propylene flipped from $29 per ton to -$23 per ton.

Hyosung Chemical's PP and dehydrogenation (DH) division suffered an operating loss of 20.6 billion won in the third quarter. The profit of 152 billion won in the second quarter was overturned in one quarter, with Korea's profit being -13 billion won and Vietnam's being -7.6 billion won. The reason the company wrote in the IR data is “spread narrowing due to delay in passing on PP sales price compared to the surge in propylene price.” Prices did not increase along with the raw materials.

## Reduce 2.49 million tons

Korea is in a position to reduce facilities. In Daesan, Lotte Chemical's 1.1 million ton per year naphtha cracking plant (NCC) has been shut down for three years, and in Yeosu, the integration of Yeocheon NCC plants 2 and 3 with an annual capacity of 1.39 million tons is being built for three years. The two approved cases combined amount to 2.49 million tons. It is 210,000 tons short of the lower limit of 2.7 to 3.7 million tons of reduction target set by the government with the industry, and the remaining three projects remain in discussions between companies.

It is also different from PP in that the reduction equipment is centered on ethylene. When an NCC is established, the amount of propylene produced also decreases. It becomes difficult for factories that buy propylene to make PP to obtain raw materials. In addition, the government has restricted naphtha exports since March 27, and in April placed ethylene, propylene, butadiene, and benzene under supply and demand management, which will continue until January of next year.

## There is a separate side for increasing it.

According to the China Petroleum and Chemical Industry Association, China's synthetic resin exports in the first half of this year increased by 41.5% compared to the same period last year. Among them, PP increased by 58.2% and PE increased by 258.1%. China's PE self-sufficiency rate rose from 72% in the first half of last year to 84% in the first half of this year, and during the same period, PE imports decreased by 28% from 6.92 million tons to 5 million tons. Countries that reduced imports began selling the same products.

China's PP production is still depressed. The average operation rate from November 13 to 19 was 65.15%, up 1.05 percentage points from the previous week, and weekly production was 678,000 tons, 14.88% lower than the same week last year. Producer inventory increased by 20.55% in one week to 468,700 tons on November 11.

## Supplies arrive in mid-December

The variable is the point in time. 950,000 tons of PP (550,000 tons of PP-H/R, 400,000 tons of ICP) from the China-Saudi Gurey project are expected to complete test runs in mid-September and commercial shipments are expected to be released in mid-December. The second phase of Chinese coal production, 600,000 tons, is also scheduled to complete production flow in December. The actual new capacity expansion in 2026 is 2.2 to 2.7 million tons, which is half of the plan at the beginning of the year, but the volume is concentrated at the end of the fourth quarter. Hwajin Aramco's 1 million tons was pushed back to the first quarter of 2027.

The market is already responding. On November 23, China's East China PP raffia spot fell 1.9% on the day to 9,986 yuan per ton, and the main futures contract fell 2.51% to 8,550 yuan.

## The math of $4 billion in exports

Korea is a country that sells a lot of PP. Exports of PP resin (HS 3902) in 2025 were the second largest in the world at $4.08 billion, a 9.2% decrease from $4.49 billion in 2024. Petrochemical exports in October of this year amounted to $4 billion, up 27.5% from the same month last year, but volume decreased by 6.8% to 2.73 million tons. The amount was created by increasing the unit price by 36.9% to $1,465 per ton.

The production reduction is made from ethylene, and the value of PP is determined by the Chinese volume in December. If new PP falls below the cost price, the price difference with recycled PP is also reduced. Those who make PP from imported recycled raw materials will now look at whether Chinese supplies actually come out after mid-December and whether Korean offers go down again, rather than what the unit price is.
