factCheck.note: PP prices have different evaluation ranges by institution, so the two series are listed together. On November 12, $1,290-1,340 (−40) is the value at which ChemPortal moved the polymer update assessment, and in the same week, Long Information Weekly (November 12-18) recorded CFR Far East Raffia at $1,265-1,275, with an average price of $1,270 (previous week, $1,300, −30). '$40 drop' at the beginning of the text is the former, and '$30 a week' is the latter. Propylene FOB Korea $1,280 and PP raffia CFR Far East $1,265~1,275 are based on FOB and CFR, respectively, so direct comparison is not possible, so the limitations are written in the text. S-Oil's PP-propylene spread of $29 → -$23 was quoted from a stock review (Sejong Corporate Data, November 5) that summarized the company's announcement, and the company's original text could not be confirmed. Hyosung Chemical's 20.6 billion won is the profit and loss in the PP·DH division, and the consolidated operating profit is different at -19.5 billion won (IR for the third quarter of 2026, October 30). The growth rate of China's PP exports (58.2%) is a figure quoted by Aju Economic Daily from the China Petroleum and Chemical Industry Association, and the original statistical table was not seen. ‘950,000 tons of Kurei commercial volume in mid-December’ is a market forecast and not a confirmed schedule. The statement that procurement of PP raw materials is becoming difficult due to a decrease in propylene due to NCC shutdowns is an interpretation based on the facility structure, and there is no numerical data confirming the resulting cost increase. PP resin exports of $4.08 billion in 2025, second in the world, are values ​​from a private aggregation site organized by UN Comtrade, and could not be compared with the original data from the Korea Customs Service. East China PP raffia 9,986 yuan is the spot valuation on November 23rd.

title: IRP early withdrawal, the reasons for withdrawal and the reasons for tax reduction are different.
deck: When taking out 10 million won from IRP, 16.5% other income tax is applied for home purchase and lease, and 5.5% pension income tax is applied for nursing care and personal rehabilitation. This is because the Employee Retirement Benefits Security Act, which allows withdrawals, and the Income Tax Act, which sets tax rates, have different lists of reasons. We have organized the points where the two lists overlap and the parts that cannot be confirmed through condolences alone.
author: Insight Brief Editorial Room
summary: Article 18, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree of the Employee Retirement Benefits Guarantee Act, which sets out the reasons for early withdrawal of IRP, includes six categories: purchase of a house for a non-homeowner, deposit for lease, medical care for more than 6 months, disaster, bankruptcy, personal rehabilitation, and mortgage loan repayment. House purchase and lease are not included in the list of unavoidable reasons in Article 20-2 of the Enforcement Decree of the Income Tax Act, which sets tax rates.

So, if you take it out as a house or jeonse, it is a non-pension receipt, and 16.5% of other income tax is applied to the tax-deducted payments and operating profits, and 100% of retirement income tax is applied to the deferred retirement income. Nursing care, bankruptcy, and rehabilitation are treated as pension receipts across both lists, and pension income tax of 3.3 to 5.5% and retirement income tax of 70% are applied.

For withdrawals due to unavoidable reasons, the reduced tax rate will be applied only if verification documents are submitted within 6 months from the date of confirmation of the reason. However, whether the pension tax rate is actually applied to deferred retirement income taken out for unavoidable reasons cannot be confirmed solely through the provisions, so financial companies' withholding standards must be checked.
body:
December 31, 2026 is one month away. It is the time to calculate year-end tax deductions, and it is also the time when more and more people need to urgently take out money they have already put in. However, the rules for these two calculations are different. In an individual retirement pension (IRP), the tax rate is determined by “for what reason you took out money” rather than “how much you put in.”

## How to allow withdrawals and how to set tax rates

There are two ways to withdraw IRP savings. It is an early withdrawal that involves closing an account and receiving a lump sum, and withdrawing only the amount necessary when it falls under a reason stipulated by law. The basis for early withdrawal is Article 18, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree of the Employee Retirement Benefits Security Act, and there are six reasons.

- Purchase of a house in one’s own name by a person who does not own a home (including joint names of the couple, excluding gifts and inheritances)
- Burden of rent and rental deposit for non-homeowners (for housing purposes)
- Medical expenses for more than 6 months of care for the subscriber, spouse, or dependents
- Disaster damage (if the requirements notified by the Ministry of Employment and Labor are met)
- Decision to declare bankruptcy or initiate personal rehabilitation procedures within 5 years from the date of application for early withdrawal
- Repayment of principal and interest on loans secured by retirement pension entitlement (within the required repayment amount)

Living expenses, school fees, wedding expenses, and funeral expenses are not on this list. Although it appears in the reasons for providing collateral in Article 2 of the Enforcement Decree, Article 18 is not an item used for partial withdrawal of personal IRP.

The next problem is. Tax rates are separately determined by the Income Tax Act. There are six “unavoidable reasons” listed in Article 20-2, Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Income Tax Act. These are natural disasters, the death of the subscriber or overseas relocation under the Overseas Migration Act, medical treatment for more than 3 months due to illness or injury of the subscriber or dependents, damage requiring hospitalization for more than 15 days due to a disaster under the Framework Act on Disaster and Safety Management, declaration of bankruptcy or decision to initiate personal rehabilitation procedures, business suspension, cancellation of license, resolution of dissolution, or declaration of bankruptcy of the pension account handler.

If you overlap the two lists, the results are different. Purchase of a house, lease, and mortgage loan repayment are only on the previous list, while nursing care, bankruptcy, rehabilitation, and disaster are on both lists. If you take it out for reasons only in the previous list, it will be withdrawn, but it will be classified as “receipt other than pension.”

## Housing and lease payments can be taken out, but the tax rate will not be lowered.

Taxation of non-pension receipts is divided by financial source. Deferred retirement income from the company's severance pay transferred to the IRP is subject to 100% of the deferred retirement income tax. Other income tax of 16.5% (including local income tax) is levied on personal contributions and operating profits that receive tax deductions. Only the principal of personal contributions that do not receive a tax deduction are excluded from taxation.

Conversely, reasons that fall on both lists are considered “receipt of pension” under the Income Tax Act. At this time, only 70% of retirement income tax is imposed on deferred retirement income (30% reduction), and pension income tax of 5.5% (under 70 years old), 4.4% (70-79 years old), and 3.3% (80 years old and older) is applied to tax-deducted contributions and operating profits depending on the age at the time of receipt.

If calculated based on the tax-deducted principal amount of 10 million won, it breaks down like this.

- Withdrawal for home purchase/lease: Other income tax 16.5% = KRW 1.65 million
- Withdrawal for medical treatment for more than 6 months: Pension income tax 5.5% = KRW 550,000 (ages 55-69)
- Difference: 1.1 million won

If deferred retirement income is added here, the difference widens further. It's the same reason and the same amount, but the document changes the tax rate.

## Treatment, rehabilitation, and withdrawal are possible, but the requirements are different.

The periods required by the two laws are different. The reason for withdrawal under the Employment and Labor Act is “medical care for more than 6 months,” and the reason for reduction under the Income Tax Act is “medical care for more than 3 months.” If it is 6 months of treatment, it exceeds both standards and thus satisfies the tax law requirements, but the medical expense burden requirement is attached depending on the account type. There is no amount standard for the IRP subscribed by an individual, and the IRP set by the company in a workplace with less than 10 employees (special provisions of Article 25 of the Act) must cover medical expenses exceeding 125/1,000 of the individual's total annual wages. In the same article, the number of times stipulated that “the reason for renting is once while working for one business” is also attached only to subscribers under this special provision.

Document deadlines must also be viewed separately. According to the Income Tax Act, for unavoidable reasons, the reduced tax rate will be applied only if proof documents are submitted to the financial company within 6 months from the date the reason is confirmed. Withdrawals for medical expenses are available for 6 months from the date of payment of medical expenses. If you miss this deadline, the withdrawal itself is valid, but the tax rate returns to 16.5%.

The conditions for disaster reasons are narrower. Under the Work and Employment Act, withdrawals are made if notification requirements are met, but the tax reduction requirement is “damage requiring hospitalization for more than 15 days.” If the number of hospitalization days is insufficient, the tax rate will not be lowered.

## The order of withdrawals by source changes the actual tax amount

Taxes are not added all at once to the total amount taken out. Article 40-3 of the Enforcement Decree of the Income Tax Act states that withdrawals are made in the following order: tax-exempt amount, deferred retirement income, tax-deducted payment amount, and operating profit. So, even with the same IRP, the withholding amount varies depending on what resources are in the account and how much.

For reference, the tax credit limit is 9 million won, combined with 6 million won in pension savings. If the total salary is 55 million won or less (comprehensive income 45 million won or less), the return is 16.5%, up to 1,485,000 won, and if it exceeds this, 13.2%, up to 1,188,000 won. However, since the tax credit is only included “within the tax payable,” if the determined tax amount is small, it is not refunded as calculated.

> The Work and Employment Act determines “what can be taken out,” and the Income Tax Act determines “how much can be taken out.” The tax rate goes down only at the point where the two lists overlap. — Contrast Article 20-2 and Article 40-2 of the Enforcement Decree of the Income Tax Act

## Parts that cannot be confirmed by the provisions alone

First, whether deferred retirement income withdrawn for unavoidable reasons is actually withheld at the pension receipt tax rate (70% of retirement income tax) cannot be determined solely from the wording of the provision. Article 129, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 5-3 of the Act requires that 70% of the non-pension receipt tax rate be applied to pension receipts. However, when treating withdrawals for unavoidable reasons as pension receipts, the standards of the subscribed retirement pension provider must be checked to see whether this provision is applied as is.

Second, the deadline for applying for disaster reasons is different from financial company guidance. The Enforcement Decree of the Work and Attendance Act does not have unified phrases such as “several months from the date of damage,” and must be read together with the Ministry of Employment and Labor’s notice and financial company’s internal regulations.

Third, the list of detailed documents and reception times for reasons for nursing care or jeonse differ from financial company to financial company. Mirae Asset Securities' information requires resident registration and abstracts to be issued within 3 months and building registration certificates to be issued within 1 month, and Hana Bank provides guidance on early withdrawal applications from 09:00 to 16:00 on business days. It does not apply to other businesses.

## Four things to ask your financial institution before withdrawing money

Rather than deciding on the withdrawal amount first, it is safer to receive the following four things first.

1. Composition of financial resources for this withdrawal (principal that received tax deductions, principal that did not receive, deferred retirement income, operating income)
2. Estimated withholding tax and details
3. Documents required to prove tax exclusion for payments that did not receive tax deductions
4. Actual deposit date and actual receipt amount reflecting the date of sale of the managed product

Even for the same early withdrawal, there is a difference of more than 1 million won depending on how the reason is proven. If you change the order, one document changes the tax rate.

title: Inflation expectations fell to 2.6%, but consumer sentiment fell for the second month — it was the stock price that hit 103.1
deck: The consumer sentiment index in November was 103.1, down 2.3 points from the previous month and the lowest since April. However, expected inflation for one year actually fell to 2.6%. All six component indices fell, and the household savings index fell to 89, the largest drop since April 2020. In the same month, the balance of bank household loans reached 1,203.9 trillion won, exceeding 1,200 trillion won for the first time.
author: Insight Brief Editorial Room
summary: In the Bank of Korea's November 2026 consumer trend survey, the Consumer Sentiment Index (CCSI) was 103.1, down 2.3 points from the previous month (105.4). The drop has increased compared to October (-1.2 points) and is the lowest since April (99.2). All six component indices fell, and the current business judgment had the largest drop, falling 4 points to 78.

In the same survey, the expected inflation rate for the next year was lowered from 2.7% to 2.6%. Even though price anxiety has decreased, sentiment has worsened. The current household savings index fell 4 points from 93 to 89, the lowest since March 2023, and the one-month drop was the largest since April 2020. The Bank of Korea explained that the impact of the decline in stock prices was overwhelming.

At the end of October, the balance of bank household loans amounted to 1,203.9 trillion won, exceeding 1,200 trillion won for the first time. Household loans across all financial sectors increased by 6.4 trillion won, turning to increase for the first time in a month. Household interest expenses in the second quarter increased by 12.1% compared to the same period last year, and the next burden is the 0.25% point increase by the Monetary Policy Committee on the 26th and the FOMC meeting in December (93.4% probability of increase).
body:
In the November survey, fear of prices decreased, but consumer sentiment worsened. In the 'November 2026 Consumer Trend Survey' announced by the Bank of Korea on the 24th, the expected inflation rate for the next year was 2.6%, down 0.1 percentage points from the previous month (2.7%). The value, which had stayed at 2.7% for four consecutive months since July, fell for the first time. However, the Consumer Sentiment Index (CCSI) in the same survey was 103.1, down 2.3 points from the previous month (105.4). The drop has increased compared to October (-1.2 points) and is the lowest since April (99.2).

If prices are suppressing consumption, both numbers should move in the same direction. This month went the opposite way. What the Bank of Korea pointed out was asset prices, not inflation. Park Yong-min, head of the Bank of Korea's economic sentiment research team, cited "domestic and foreign stock market adjustments" as the reason for the 4-point drop in the current economic judgment, and said, "The fall in stock prices had an overwhelming impact" on the collapse in household savings evaluations.

> “The 4-point drop in the current household savings index was ‘overwhelmingly due to the decline in stock prices.’” — Park Yong-min, head of the economic sentiment research team at the Bank of Korea, consumer trend survey briefing in November 2026

![The mercury in the savings thermometer standing on the roof goes down, and the pile of loan books next to it goes up, layer by layer. November's consumer sentiment index of 103.1, household savings index of 89, and bank household loans of 1203.9 trillion won are the numbers displayed on one screen.](/assets/img/articles/consumer-mood-103-savings-89-2026.jpg)

## 89 — the first decline in 6 years and 7 months

Compared to six months ago, the current household savings index fell by 4 points from 93 to 89. It is the lowest since March 2023 (89) and the largest one-month drop since April 2020 (-4 points). The six component indices also fell without exception. The current economic judgment is 78(-4), the future economic outlook is 86(-2), the current living situation is 91(-2), the living situation outlook is 96(-1), the household income outlook is 100(-1), and the consumption expenditure outlook is 108(-1). The employment opportunity outlook fell 3 points to 83. The Bank of Korea explains that sluggish youth employment was coupled with concerns about job losses due to the development of artificial intelligence. In terms of expenditure, the forecast for travel expenses was lowered by 2 points to 94, and dining expenses were lowered by 1 point to 95.

## House price expectations are 118, Seoul is 8 points

The housing price outlook index, which asks about house prices a year later, fell 6 points from 124 to 118. It is the lowest since last May (112), and the drop is the largest in 8 months since March (-12 points). By region, Seoul lost 8 points, a larger drop than other regions. The Bank of Korea cited the perception of a decline in actual apartment prices in some regions such as Gangnam and Seocho, the government's supply and regulation measures, and an increase in loan interest rates. However, 118 exceeds the long-term average (107). It means that there are still many responses that are rising. The interest rate level outlook index, which asks about the interest rate level six months from now, fell 3 points to 124.

## Debt did not decrease — KRW 1203.9 trillion

While sentiment cooled, debt increased. According to the 'Financial Market and Household Loan Trends for October 2026' announced by the Bank of Korea and the Financial Services Commission on the 11th, the balance of household loans from deposit banks at the end of October was 1203.9 trillion won, an increase of 5 trillion won in one month. It exceeded 1,200 trillion won for the first time since compilation. Household loans across all financial sectors increased by 6.4 trillion won, turning around in one month from the decline in September (-2.2 trillion won). Mortgage loans increased by 4 trillion won and other loans by 2.4 trillion won. Among other loans, credit loans decreased by 2.9 trillion won in September but increased by 1.2 trillion won in October. Lee Seung-yeop, Deputy Director of the Bank of Korea's Financial Markets Department, explained that net purchases of individual stocks led to an increase in credit loans. On the contrary, jeonse loans decreased by 800 billion won, decreasing for 14 consecutive months.

## 12.1% and 6.5 trillion — numbers on the 26th

The price already paid by households can be found in the second quarter household trend survey. The average monthly income per household was 5,295,000 won, an increase of 4.5% from the same period last year, but excluding prices, it is 1.5%. Non-consumption spending increased 1.9% to 1.06 million won, and interest expenses jumped 12.1%. This is nearly twice the rate of the previous quarter (6.6%). The average propensity to consume, which is the ratio of consumption expenditures to disposable income, fell 1.2 percentage points to 69.2%. According to data submitted by the Bank of Korea to the National Assembly in September, if interest rates rise by 0.5 percentage points, households' annual interest burden increases by 6.5 trillion won. A 0.25% point increase by the Monetary Policy Committee on the 26th is the market's basic assumption, and the probability of an increase by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) in December is reflected at 93.4% (CME Fed Watch, 24th). The delinquent balance of bank accounts for borrowers in their 40s at the five major banks amounted to 39.984 billion won at the end of October, an 81.6% increase from the end of last year.

## Next check point

This survey was conducted between November 9 and 16. After the investigation was completed, KOSPI gave up an intraday trading level of 4,700 on the 23rd. This means that the impact could be felt once more in the December survey. The Monetary Policy Committee's base interest rate and dot plot on the 26th, the FOMC on December, and the consumer trend survey on December 24 create the following numbers. One thing has been confirmed now. Price expectations have gone down, but households have become more fearful.

factCheck.title: Fact check & sources
factCheck.note: The November consumer trend survey figures are data announced by the Bank of Korea at 06:00 on November 24, 2026 (survey period from November 9 to 16, responses from 2,236 households out of 2,500 in cities nationwide). The expected inflation rate is the median of the responses, and the CCSI is a relative index with the long-term average from 2003 to 2025 set at 100, so 103.1 means 'a little more optimistic than the long-term average' and does not mean that consumption has increased. Team leader Park Yong-min's remarks came from a briefing on the 24th. October's household loans are provisional, and the bank balance of 1203.9 trillion won is based on the Bank of Korea's breaking news, including policy mortgage loans and trusts. The second quarter household trend survey was the results of April to June announced on August 27, 2026, and the results of subsequent quarters were not included in the text. The delinquent amount of the negative bank accounts of borrowers in their 40s at the five major banks is not the entire household debt, but is a value within a narrow range of five banks, borrowers in their 40s, and negative bank accounts. The Monetary Policy Committee's 0.25% point increase on the 26th is not a confirmed decision, but rather a forecast by securities companies and research institutes, and the 93.4% probability of an FOMC increase in December is reflected in the futures market on the 24th. ‘6.5 trillion won in interest burden when interest rates rise by 0.5 percentage points’ is an estimate submitted by the Bank of Korea to the National Assembly in September 2026. The KOSPI intraday departure from the 4,700 mark on the 23rd after the survey was not reflected in the November survey.

title: 123.14 million won certificate — cars that can and cannot be sold, August 2027
deck: Starting August 14, 2027, all vehicle models sold domestically will require Automotive Cyber ​​Security Management System (CSMS) certification. The new/renewal fee is 123,143,000 won and is repaid every three years. Last year, about 1,400 large buses were made, but they could not withstand that calculation. However, there are no actual vehicle verification cases for individual vehicles yet.
author: Insight Brief Editorial Room
tags: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport
summary: Starting August 14, 2027, all vehicle models sold in Korea will require Automotive Cyber ​​Security Management System (CSMS) certification. The enforcement rule only excludes non-autonomous vehicles that self-certify by August 13, 2027, so there is no grace period for self-driving vehicles.

The new and renewal fee set by the notice is 123,143,000 won, 86.2 million won for self-certified manufacturers, and certification is renewed every three years. Kia Grandbird, which produced 1,403 units last year, notified labor and management of the suspension of production due to the judgment that it would be difficult to meet Euro 7 and cybersecurity costs.

Foreign certification does not replace domestic sales. Renault Korea, Geely, and Polestar reviewed the joint application in September, and even after passing the CSMS, the first delivery of the Ziker 7X began on October 21st through the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport's procedures. Certification only examines the management system, and there is no actual verification of individual vehicles yet.
body:
Starting August 14, 2025, new vehicle models released in Korea cannot be sold without the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport's Automotive Cyber ​​Security Management System (CSMS) certification. From August 14, 2027, when the grace period ends, the same conditions will apply to car models already on sale. The enforcement regulations only exclude non-self-driving cars that self-certify by August 13, 2027, so there is no grace period for self-driving cars from the beginning. For the remaining 9 months, the threshold is in the notice. The new/renewal fee is 123,143,000 won.

## 12 items, documents and field, 3 years

The basis is Article 30-9 of the Automobile Management Act newly established in February 2024, and the procedures are contained in Notice No. 2025-637 on November 4, 2025. Manufacturers undergo document and on-site reviews with 12 items that identify, evaluate, process, and verify risks from development to post-production. The review is conducted by the Korea Transportation Safety Authority's Automobile Safety Research Institute. The certificate is valid for three years and undergoes a follow-up management review every year. If it is missing or cancelled, production, import, and sales are restricted.

As of May, there were 10 production companies that completed the screening. Tesla Korea and BYD Korea are included. The Korea Automobile Importers and Distributors Association has 22 companies and 29 brands (as of June).

> “Cars have transitioned from simple means of transportation to software-based vehicles (SDVs), which are moving computers.” — Park Joon-hyung, Director of Mobility and Vehicle Bureau, Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, May 27 Policy Seminar

## If you divide 123,143,000 won by the logarithm,

The fee is 123,143,000 won for both new and renewal, and 86.2 million won for self-certified production companies. Since it is renewed every three years, certification is not a document you buy once, but a fixed fee that you pay periodically.

Fixed costs are divided into logarithms. Kia produced 1,403 Grand Bird large buses last year. If you split the fee alone, it costs 88,000 won per unit, but in reality, it requires more risk analysis, testing, documentation, and manpower. Kia found it difficult to meet this cost and the Euro 7 standard and notified labor and management of the suspension of production of the Grand Bird. This car has been sold for over 30 years.

Thinner areas are specially equipped vehicles. Vehicles made by modifying chassis, such as ambulances, fire trucks, camping cars, and refrigerated trucks, are few in number and have old platforms. According to a survey by the Korea Automobile Manufacturers Association, a specific company spent a total of 158 million won, or 1.6 million won per vehicle, to certify 99 vehicles over 5 months. Although it is a different initial safety inspection cost than CSMS, it shows the share of regulatory costs in the price of a car.

## Foreign certificates do not replace domestic sales

Although the system translates UN R155 into domestic law, foreign screening results do not replace domestic certification. Cars sold domestically require domestic procedure certification, and overseas output is used only as preparation material.

- European Union: New car models July 6, 2022, all new car registrations July 7, 2024
- China: January 2026 for new models, January 2028 for all car models (GB 44495-2024, industry data)
- Korea: August 14, 2025 for new car models, August 14, 2027 for all car models
- United States: No federal legal obligations, focus on self-certification and recommendations

Korea started late. The time to prepare is short. Renault Korea, Geely Automobile, and Polestar jointly applied for CSMS certification in September. This is the first case where three companies applied for one certification together. Renault Korea, which manufactures the Polestar 4 at its Busan factory, was the applicant, and the final responsibility was assumed by the brand, Polestar.

The schedule was also pushed back. Ziker 7X passed CSMS certification at the end of August, but first deliveries began only on October 21 due to overlap between the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport procedures and environmentally friendly vehicle registration. It has been four and a half months since the reservation was made on June 5, and pre-orders have exceeded 1,500 units.

![A scene where a huge seal is stopped above a narrow inspection gate, and an old large bus in the next lane is standing in front of a barrier — Image · AI Illustration](/assets/img/articles/csms-all-models-2027-cost.jpg)

## The door is in the management system, but the car is still there.

What the certification examines is the company’s management system. There are no proven cases yet on whether individual vehicles can withstand hacking. An official from the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport said to a media outlet, “BYD and Tesla are also cases where only manufacturer certification has been completed.” The Corporation is preparing a plan to include an actual vehicle survey in the self-certification conformity survey conducted in about 20 cases each year. A request for verification of actual vehicles was also made during the October government audit.

The data side is divided into layers. The Personal Information Protection Committee is investigating seven connected car companies, including Ziker. The plan to rationalize autonomous driving regulations announced by the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport on October 23 requires service providers to obtain permission to store data domestically and transfer it overseas, but connected cars for consumers are omitted.

## Not confirmed

The number of certified production companies is as of May and there is no count since then. Whether or not CSMS is applied to specially equipped vehicles depends on the exclusion provisions of the enforcement rules and the timing of self-certification for each vehicle type. There is no data counting the number of vehicle models discontinued after August 2027. The reason for Kia's suspension of the Grand Bird came from labor-management discussions and reports, and was not revealed in writing by the company.

The test on August 14, 2027 is a lineup, not a document. There are no companies left with the certificate, but only car models that can spread the price of the certificate to thousands of units.

title: Process the ore and pay — zinc processing fee - $173, Korea negotiates 2027 benchmark
deck: The 2026 annual benchmark zinc concentrate processing charge (TC) was $85 per tonne. This is the number agreed upon by Canada's Tea Chrysosys and Korea Zinc. However, the spot index on November 20th was -$173.57. In the market where smelters receive ore and pay, metal prices rose and Korea Zinc's operating profit in the third quarter was halved.
author: Insight Brief Editorial Room
summary: The annual benchmark TC for zinc concentrate in 2026 is $85 per ton (Tichrysosys-Korea Zinc agreement, $80 in 2025). On November 20, the SMM import concentrate weekly index was -$173.57/dmt, down $5.35 from the previous week, and on October 9, the spot valuation of fastmarkets arriving in China was -$115 to -$150, an all-time low.

On November 20, LME zinc spot was $3,670 and 3-month zinc spot was $3,502.50, which was $167.50 more expensive and inventory decreased to 145,675 tons. The metal fell from $3,875 on November 4 (+28.7% from the March low) to $3,670 on the 20th, but smelters increased their losses due to negative processing costs and falling by-product prices.

Korea Zinc's third quarter sales were KRW 6.0861 trillion (+46.3%), operating profit was KRW 141.7 billion (-48.2%, -75.9% compared to the previous quarter), and the operating profit ratio fell from 9.2% to 2.3%. CRU predicted an all-time low, predicting that the benchmark discussion range for 2027 would be $0 to $60 per ton.
body:
A zinc smelter receives concentrate (raw material from ore) from a mine, converts it into metal, and receives a processing fee (TC) in return. The annual benchmark for 2026 was $85 per tonne. This is the price agreed upon in March by Canada's Tichrysis and Korea's Korea Zinc ($80 in 2025). However, the imported concentrate index compiled by Shanghai Metal Market (SMM) on November 20 was -$173.57/dmt. The smelter processes the ore and pays $173 per ton. In the same year, the annual contract value and spot price increased by $258.

## $40 in January became -$173 in November

The processing fee for spot concentrates arriving in China (CIF), as calculated by fastmarkets, hit a new all-time low of -$115 to -$150 on October 9. It flipped by more than $200 in 9 months from the January valuation (+40~$60). SMM's imported concentrate weekly index was -$173.57 on November 20, down $5.35 from the previous week (-$168.22). Average light was around -170 dollars, and high quality light was up to -220 dollars. In the same week, China's domestic Zn50 processing fee was -2,350 yuan per ton.

The cause is not the ore but the smelting ability. CRU expects that smelting capacity will increase rapidly between 2025 and 2026 and will also increase in 2027. The mine side collapsed in the opposite direction. According to the International Lead and Zinc Research Group (ILZSG), global mine production in the first half of 2026 decreased by 2.6% compared to the previous year. Over the 10 years from 2015 to 2025, mine production decreased by 8.6%, but smelting capacity remained the same (Reuters Andy Holm). Antamina in Peru and Red Dog in Alaska mined low-grade sections, while mines in Australia and Sweden changed their plans after the earthquake.

China lives at a loss. Concentrate imports in October were 406,400 tons, down 3.0% from the previous month, but up 19.2% from the same month last year, and the cumulative total from January to October was 4,437,600 tons (+2.0%). Port inventories increased by 4,000 tons in a week to 263,000 tons. This is winter stockpiling.

## Metal prices have risen, but the surplus has become thinner.

In the case of metal, the situation is the opposite. On November 20, the official LME zinc spot price was $3,670 per ton, and the 3-month zinc contract was $3,502.50, which was $167.50 more expensive than the spot price. This backwardation has continued since June, and warehouse inventory was 145,675 tons, down 13% from a month ago. It was 28.7% higher than the March low ($3,010) at $3,875 on November 4, but fell 4.6% in four days from $3,848 on the 16th to $3,670 on the 20th due to concerns about interest rate hikes and the strong dollar.

The problem is that this price is not the responsibility of the smelter. Concentrate prices rise first and processing costs are negative. Although the benchmark rose by $5 in 2026, the payment terms for by-products such as silver and germanium changed, so real conditions did not improve as much as nominal (fastmarkets March). CRU pointed out the risk of China's production cuts in the first quarter of 2027, saying that by-product profits have been making up for losses in processing costs, but the recent decline in by-product prices has increased smelter losses.

![Pile of zinc concentrate and cast zinc ingots under the lime-colored sky, night view of the smelter in the background — Image · AI illustration](/assets/img/articles/zinc-tc-negative-benchmark-2027.jpg)

## In Korea, Korea Zinc is one side of the contract.

The party that agreed on the 2026 benchmark is Korea Zinc. It joined hands with Tichrysosys in March at $85 per ton, and this figure became the standard for the global concentrate market. This company's signature is also a reference point in the 2027 negotiations.

The third quarter report card shows the structure as is. Sales increased 46.3% from a year ago to KRW 6.0861 trillion, but operating profit decreased 48.2% to KRW 141.7 billion. Compared to the previous quarter (KRW 587.1 billion), there was a sharp decline of 75.9%, and the operating profit margin fell from 9.2% to 2.3%. The surplus has been maintained for 107 consecutive quarters, but the margin has become thinner. The company cited the decline in metal prices and exchange rates and the initial costs of the Tennessee smelter in the United States. Zinc sales volume itself remained at 146,374 tons (exports of 79,144 tons) in the second quarter. The quantity sold remains the same, but the raw material cost takes the margin.

## Number to be determined in December

The strength to endure comes from by-products. If the price of silver moves by $1 per ounce, annual operating profit changes by 10 to 12 billion won (Shinhan Investment & Securities). The target for germanium sales is 14.5 tons per year, starting in January 2027, and the international price is $12,500 to $17,000 per kg. Copper, sulfuric acid, and indium also come from the same smelting process.

There are no really important numbers yet. CRU expects the 2027 benchmark to hit a new all-time low and said the discussion range is $0 to $60 per ton. I think it will be close to the bottom. If this contract is confirmed at the end of the year or the beginning of the year, Korea Zinc's 2027 margin will start from that number.

> As smelting capacity outstrips mine supply, smelters are competing for concentrates and making up for the share that processing costs cannot be made with by-product profits.
> — CRU, November 13, 2026

There are three things to see next year. Benchmark confirmation, when LME inventory and backwardation will be lifted, and whether by-product prices can continue to support the smelter. Another variable is that China will turn into a net exporter of zinc bars by 2026. CRU reported that Southeast Asian plating and rolling companies prefer Korean, Japanese, and Australian brands over Chinese products. There remains a responsibility to endure as a brand rather than price.

factCheck.title: Fact check & sources
factCheck.note: The $258 difference between the annual benchmark value ($85) and the spot price (-$173.57) is calculated by subtracting the two values. The 4.6% decline in zinc spot prices from November 16th to 20th was calculated at Westmetal's LME official price (3,848 → $3,670). As for the by-product payment conditions of the 2026 benchmark, fastmarkets reported that silver payments were reduced and germanium payments were newly established, but some of the reporters denied this, and the main text was written as 'conditions have changed and are not as good as nominal.' The LME official price and closing price are evaluated at different times, so they may differ by several dollars even on the same day. Unless otherwise noted, the figures in the text are LME official prices and SMM·fastmarkets valuations.

title: 2.3 times the number of new homes - 66,000 unsold local units are not decreasing.
deck: The selling price per 3.3㎡ of a local apartment is about twice the existing market price. Gyeongbuk is 2.31 times. Of the 65,941 unsold units at the end of September, 72.6% were in rural areas, and 83.7% of unsold units after completion were also in rural areas. Local house prices rose 0.29% this year, and the basic construction cost, which pushes the sales price, rose 4.07%.
author: Insight Brief Editorial Room
tags: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport
summary: The national average apartment sales price per 3.3 m2 from January to November this year was 22.01 million won, 1.3% higher than the existing market price (21.73 million won). However, in Gyeongbuk, it was 16.42 million won versus 7.1 million won, which was 2.31 times, Jeonnam and Gwangju 2.14 times, Gyeongnam and Gangwon 1.98 times, Chungnam and Ulsan 1.86 times, and Daegu 1.78 times. Based on the same area, new construction in local areas receives twice the surrounding market price.

As of the 16th, local house prices rose only 0.29% this year (8.91% in Seoul). On the other hand, the basic construction cost announced by the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport in September was 7,682,000 won per 3.3㎡, up 4.07% from the previous year and 4.86% from March of this year. This construction cost standard accounts for 47% of the local sales price.

Of the 65,941 unsold units at the end of September, 47,884 (72.6%) were in rural areas, and 23,067 (83.7%) were unsold after completion. The competition rate for first place in September was 0.67 to 1 in Busan, the first time it fell short since the survey, and 94.58 to 1 in Seoul. The next confirmation points are the National Assembly seminar on the 25th, the Monetary Policy Committee meeting on the 26th, and the October housing statistics at the end of this month.
body:
Write the conclusion first. The price of a new apartment in a local area is about twice the market price of an existing apartment in the neighborhood. Gyeongbuk is 2.3 times, Jeonnam and Gwangju are 2.1 times. It is too large to be a new construction premium, and the market price does not move as it is structured to receive the future price increase in advance.

## 16.42 million won and 7.1 million won per 3.3㎡

Real Estate 114 counted apartments nationwide from January to November of this year, and the average sale price per 3.3㎡ was 22.01 million won, and the existing market price was 21.73 million won. The national difference is 280,000 won (1.3%), but this value is the average of Seoul and other regions.

In Gyeongbuk, it was 2.31 times 16.42 million won versus 7.1 million won. Jeonnam and Gwangju are 2.14 times, Gyeongnam and Gangwon are 1.98 times, Chungnam and Ulsan are 1.86 times, and Daegu are 1.78 times. Conversely, in Seoul, there was a 2.4% difference between 54.62 million won and 53.36 million won. Converted to 84㎡ (25.4 pyeong), a new apartment in Gyeongbuk costs 417 million won, and an existing apartment in the same neighborhood costs 180 million won (calculated). In the same area and living area, 237 million won is earned.

## Market price is 0.29%, construction cost is 4.07%

According to the Korea Real Estate Agency, as of November 16, the cumulative increase in local apartment sales prices this year is 0.29%. Compared to 8.91% in Seoul and 6.89% in Gyeonggi, it is the same. It fell in Daegu (-0.87%), South Chungcheong Province (-1.48%), and Jeju (-2.22%), and in the third week of November, the regional rate was flat (0.00%).

What pushes up the sale price is the construction cost. The Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport announced on September 15 that the basic construction cost was 7,682,000 won per 3.3㎡. This is an increase of 4.07% from the previous year and 356,000 won (4.86%) from March of this year.

This construction cost standard is 47% of the sale price of 16.42 million won per 3.3㎡ in Gyeongbuk. Since it is a calculation standard for public housing land and sales price cap complexes, it does not correspond one to one with local private sales prices. Still, the direction is clear. **In local areas, the cost of building a building alone exceeds the surrounding market price (7.1 million won) by 8%.** When land costs and financial costs are added, it doubles.

## Of the 66,000 households, 48,000 are in rural areas.

Looking at September housing statistics (announced on October 30), the number of unsold units nationwide at the end of September was 65,941, down 4.6% from a month ago. Among them, 47,884 households are in rural areas, or 72.6%. Among the 27,549 unsold units after completion, 23,067 (83.7%) are in rural areas, followed by Daegu (3,077 units), Gyeongnam (3,067 units), and Gyeongbuk (2,778 units).

Demand also cooled. The average competition rate for first place nationwide in September was 5.15 to 1, the lowest since June 2023. Busan was 0.67 to 1, falling below 1 to 1 for the first time since the 2021 survey, and Seoul was 94.58 to 1. Supply decreased even faster, with local permits from January to September falling 29.0% to 76,197 units, and nationwide construction starts in September falling 46.4%.

> If the market price of existing apartments in the region does not narrow the gap with the sale price, it will be difficult to resolve unsold units next year as well. It is not very likely that next year's sale price will be lower than this year. — Jihae Yoon, Real Estate Research Lab critic, November 20, 2026

![At sunset, a newly built high-rise complex and an alley of low-tiled houses overlap on one screen. The two prices are in the same living area. Image · AI illustration](/assets/img/articles/local-presale-double-price-2026.jpg)

## Special provisions that already exist, 1.5 million won is not enough

It is not that the government has given up. Unsold units after completion of 85㎡ or less in non-metropolitan areas are excluded from the number of houses in calculating transfer tax and comprehensive real estate tax (acquisition price of 700 million won or less, until December 31, 2027). If a person who does not own a home or owns one home buys a second home in 93 areas with declining population, the acquisition tax will be reduced by half (up to 1.5 million won). However, it cannot be used in the same city, county, or district, metropolitan cities, autonomous districts are excluded, and if it is sold within 3 years, the amount of tax reduction is given out. 1.5 million won is not decisive in the face of the doubled sales price.

The industry demands stronger prescriptions. On the 19th, the Korea Real Estate Business Association submitted a request to the government to expand the exclusion of housing units to unsold units before completion, expand second home special provisions to metropolitan cities, reintroduce transfer tax reduction for purchasers of unsold units, and not apply stress DSR to local housing mortgage loans excluding regulated areas until the end of 2028. Daegu City requested that the purchase price of unsold properties be raised from 90% of the appraised value to a maximum of 100% after LH's local completion. The Korea Real Estate Agency will hold a regional polarization seminar at the National Assembly Hall on the 25th.

## Three things to check in December

First, the Monetary Policy Committee is meeting on the 26th. If the base interest rate rises from 3.00% to 3.25% (forecast), the interest rate on pre-sale balance loans will also rise, widening the gap further. Second, the October housing statistics that will be released at the end of this month. It is difficult to determine whether the decline in unsold units in September was a flash or a trend. Third, the sale price in December. The baseline for next year's business feasibility will be whether the supply within the year, such as for Busan's Banyeo District 4 (536 households), can be supplied in line with the surrounding market prices.

People who buy a new house in the countryside pay twice as much and wait for the price to double. It has not yet been decided who will bear the cost of waiting.

title: The keys to 7.12 million Bitcoins are already public — a transfer that must be completed before quantum computers
deck: As of November 10, as of Glassnode, the public keys of 7.12 million BTC (35.4% of circulation) are revealed on the chain. The estimated hardware required to break the signature has been reduced by 1/17 in 9 months, and some point out that the real problem is not the code but the time it takes to move the coins.
author: Insight Brief Editorial Room
summary: As of November 10, 2026, as of November 10, 2026, the public keys of 7.12 million BTC (35.4% of circulation) are already exposed on the blockchain according to Glassnode. It increased by 4.2 percentage points in one month from 31.2% in October, and the main reasons are address reuse (25.8%) and exchange holdings (11.6%).

In March, Google estimated that less than 500,000 physical qubits were needed to decode the signature, and Alice & Bob published a model with 29,588 qubits for about 62 minutes on October 29. 62 minutes is longer than the average block creation time of 10 minutes, making pre-confirmation transaction attacks difficult, but there is no time limit for sleeping coins.

BIP 361 (restrictions on non-converted wallet transactions) and BIP 360 remain as drafted in April, and multi-signature and threshold signature are in the research stage. Exposure estimates vary by institution from 6 million to 6.9 million BTC, and the timing of commercialization and conversion schedule have not been confirmed.
body:
Write the conclusion first. The public key for 7.12 million Bitcoins, or 35.4% of the total supply, is contained in addresses that are already revealed on the blockchain. The fact that quantum computers cannot now break this signature has not changed. There are two things that have changed. Estimates of the hardware needed to break the signature have been reduced by one-seventeenth in less than a year, and the fact that moving the coins could take years before then has become a center of public debate. Based on the data released on November 22nd and 23rd, this article organizes what has been confirmed and what has not yet been confirmed.

## From 6 million to 7.12 million — what counts?

Bitcoin proves ownership with an elliptic curve cryptography (secp256k1) signature. Calculating the private key from the public key is virtually impossible with current computers, and there have been no confirmed cases of the actual wallet key being breached. The problem is ‘coins whose public keys already remain on the chain.’ When a quantum computer with sufficient performance runs the Shore algorithm, the coin enters into a competition for calculation speed.

Glassnode aggregation has continued to raise numbers in the same series.

- Early 2021: Exposure share 24.8%
- May 2026: 30.2% (approximately 6.04 million BTC)
- October 2026: 31.2% (over 6 million BTC, CoinDesk reports)
- November 10, 2026: 35.4%, 7.12 million BTC

The composition is also divided. The volume revealed through address reuse is 25.8%, and the volume stored by the exchange is 11.6%. The remaining 1.71 million BTC in the initial format (P2PK) and 222,000 BTC in taproot output will be reduced when the owner moves. A significant portion of P2PK volume is estimated to be related to Satoshi Nakamoto, so it is difficult to expect movement. CoinDesk reported on October 8 that exposure volume has increased by 5 to 6 percentage points compared to the low in 2023, and has increased by 222,000 BTC (approximately $18.2 billion) since May, of which 123,000 BTC occurred on exchanges. The exposed volume held by the exchange is 1.79 million BTC.

Also make clear what you need to pay attention to. This number measures the 'way the address is used' and does not measure the immediate risk. CoinDesk clarified that this number cannot determine the amount of lost, dormant, or unmovable volume.

## Why now — 1/17

Google estimated that less than 500,000 physical qubits would be needed to break Bitcoin's signature in March 2026. On October 29, Alice & Bob researchers published a model showing that 29,588 pieces can be used in about 62 minutes. It is about 1/17th of Google. The two studies cannot be compared using the same standards due to different hardware designs and assumptions, and Alice & Bob also stated that these are theoretical values. Researchers believe that improvements in hardware performance and reductions in resource requirements will meet in the early 2030s.

62 minutes is longer than the average block creation time of 10 minutes. Therefore, attacks that ‘intercept transactions waiting to be confirmed’ are still difficult. Conversely, there is no time limit for coins that are sleeping with their public keys already revealed. This is why the two risks must be distinguished.

## The migration takes longer than the code

Leo Pan, CEO of blockchain infrastructure company Cysic, said in a CoinDesk interview that “the important clock is migration.” A standard has been established for single signer quantum-resistant signatures, but multi-signature and threshold signatures are still in the research phase. The U.S. NIST launched a multi-party threshold encryption method contest in January, and BitGo and Silence Labs simulated quantum-resistant transactions using the MPC method in May. Commercial distribution plans have not yet been revealed.

The progress speed for each chain is also different. NEAR added quantum-resistant transaction signatures in July, and Algorand introduced the Falcon-1024 account in August. Bitcoin is still there. Rootstock has announced a plan to introduce quantum-resistant signatures in 2028, but it must modify its bridge (PowPeg) and hardware security module, and the Bitcoin protocol itself cannot be changed.

## No agreement yet — BIP 360 and 361

In April 2026, Jameson Roff and six co-authors proposed a draft of BIP 361. The plan is to gradually abolish vulnerable signature methods and ultimately restrict transactions for wallets that have not been upgraded. Roff argued that it is better to freeze dormant Bitcoin than to have it stolen by future quantum attackers. Blockstream CEO Adam Baek opposed mandatory freezes and favored voluntary upgrades. Neither approach was adopted, and BIP 361 and BIP 360, which proposed a new output type to reduce exposure to certain quantum attacks, are in draft stage.

Industry proposals are also continuing. Coinbase submitted a draft discussion on switching to a quantum-resistant system on October 13, and Bitcoin Core developer Corey Fields presented three plans on November 5 that would require collateral equal to the amount of the transfer when transferring funds from an existing address. The idea comes from the premise that it is difficult to distinguish between the rightful owner and the attacker.

## Estimates vary by institution.

- Glassnode (as cited by CoinDesk, October): Over 6 million BTC, circulation 31.2%
- Glassnode (self-published on November 10th): 7.12 million BTC, 35.4%
- ChainQuery (early November): approximately 35.6%
- Human Rights Foundation: 6.51 million BTC (approximately 718 billion dollars), of which 4.49 million BTC is moveable and 1.72 million BTC is estimated to be dormant and inaccessible.
- QSecure: 6.9 million BTC
- Chaincode (May 2025): Approximately 6.26 million BTC (range 4-10 million)
- City Institute (January 2026): Approximately 25%

The methodologies and base dates are different, so they cannot be combined into one number. The 35.4% cited in the text is a single count released by Glassnode on November 10.

## The market is seeing different numbers

As of 17:30 on November 23, Bitcoin was worth $61,213.67 according to CoinMarketCap, up 2.62% from 24 hours ago and down 5.08% for the week. After falling to $55,130 (lowest since September 2024) on the 21st, it rebounded more than 9% from the low. During the same period, 24-hour forced liquidation was $1.8 billion (long $1.3 billion), and the realized loss over the past 7 days was $11.3 billion, about eight times the realized profit. Last week, there was a net outflow of about $1.1 billion from the U.S. spot ETF, and the fear and greed index was 9 points. Prices are driven by liquidity and sentiment, and security readiness is determined by time.

## Confirmed and unconfirmed

This is what has been confirmed. The exposure volume count, hardware estimates, BIP 360 and 361 drafts, NEAR and Algorand's introduction of quantum resistance, Bitgo and Silence Labs' mock implementation, Rootstock's 2028 plan, and proposals from Coinbase and Core developers are disclosed.

There are many more that have not been confirmed. These are the timing of the practical use of quantum computers, the timing of standardization of multi-signature and threshold signatures, whether to freeze unconverted coins, the conversion schedule and costs of exchanges, trustees, and bridges, restrictions that may arise during the transfer process, and the causes of differences in estimates by institution.

## Checkpoint

- If my wallet has repeatedly used the same address, the coin is in the 25.8% range. Moving to a new address eliminates exposure due to reuse.
- When exchanges and custodians support quantum-resistant wallets determines when individual holders actually respond.
- Whether discussions on BIP 361 go beyond the draft and reach agreement is a turning point at the protocol level.
- The 1.71 million BTC remaining in the initial format will remain regardless of which standard comes out if the owner does not move. It is not a problem for individuals to solve.

This article is not a recommendation to buy or sell specific assets. The figures cited and draft status are as of the time of writing (November 23, 2026).

title: Same $8, but 6.6 times the value of the task — a week without tokens from the AI price list
deck: From November 16 to 20, five companies released new models and new prices. Open AI's displayed unit price fell by 20%, but the price per task fell by 33%. The cost per task of the two models with the same price tag of $8 for input and $40 for output increased by 6.6 times.
author: Insight Brief Editorial Room
summary: Alibaba and Tencent released new models and new prices on November 16th, OpenAI and Microsoft released new models and new prices on the 17th, and Google released new models on the 18th. GPT-6.2 Astra costs $8 for input, $0.40 for cache input, and $40 for output per 1 million tokens, which is 20% cheaper than the previous model and the cache input is 60% lower.

The cache input value was collected at 2.5 to 5% of the input price. Open AI, Google, and Alibaba are 5%, Tencent 4.3%, and Antropic Claude Fable 5.2 2.5%. In Artificial Analysis's coding agent measurements, GPT-6.2 Astra's cache hit rate was 95% and the number of tokens per task was 4.67 million.

The IQ of Claude Fable 5.2 (input $8, output $40) and GPT-6.2 Astra, which have the same price tag, is 65 to 62, but the value per Artificial Analysis IQ task is $26.54 to $4.00, which is 6.6 times higher. The coding agent index was 53 points, the same as the previous model, and the price per task was reduced by 33% from $7.63 to $5.12.
body:
In the third week of November, Frontier AI’s price list changed five times in five days. Alibaba and Tencent on the 16th, OpenAI and Microsoft on the 17th, and Google on the 18th released new models and prices. The unit price went down, and instead, the ‘price of completing one task’ stood in front of the price tag.

## 20% — OpenAI’s reduction

The API price of GPT-6.2 Astra, released on the 17th, is $8 for input, $0.40 for cache input, and $40 for output per 1 million tokens. The previous price of GPT-6 Astra was down 20% from $10, $1, and $50, and the cash price was down 60%. The numbers emphasized by the company are the price per task, not the price tag. In our evaluation, the GPT-6.2 Astra scored 5.2 points higher than the previous model on the Agents' Last Exam, which measures long-term professional work, at less than one-third the cost.

On the same day, Microsoft released seven models and wrote:

> “As token spending skyrockets, we know we also want a model at a price point that allows us to have agents doing real engineering work around the clock.” — Microsoft AI, November 17

MAI Code 2 announced that it delivers 98% of the coding quality of GPT-6.1 Sol at 40% of the price, and 96% of Claude Opus 5.5 at 5% of the price. It also boasted 1.7 times the token per watt of its own accelerator, Maia 200.

## 5% — The main body of the discount is cash

If you place the price tags side by side, they have something in common. Google Gemini 4 Neon, released on the 18th, attached a context of 1 million tokens with an input of $3, a cache of $0.15, and an output of $15. On the 16th, Alibaba's Qwen4-Max had an input price of $1.50 and an output price of $4.50, down 25% from the previous model's price of $2 and $6, and Tencent's Hy4 flash had an input price of $0.070 and an output price of $0.281.

The cache input value was collected at 2.5 to 5% of the input price. Open AI is 5% (0.40/8), Google is 5% (0.15/3), Alibaba is 5% (0.075/1.50), Tencent is 4.3% (0.003/0.070), and Antropic Claude Fable 5.2 is 2.5% (0.20/8). The agent resends the same system prompt and document each time. The value that is not recalculated has come down to this point.

In Artificial Analysis's coding agent measurements, GPT-6.2 Astra's cache hit rate was 95%. This means that 95% of the 4.67 million tokens per task were caches.

## Same $8, different bill.

The clearest comparison is between two models with the same price tag. Antropic Claude Fable 5.2 also costs $8 for input and $40 for output. The IQ is 65 to 62, which is a 3-point difference, and the cost of completing the same quotient task is 6.6 times more, $26.54 to $4.00. This is because Fable uses much more tokens per task.

The measurements of Vals AI are the same. The price per task was $17.94 for Fable 5.2, $10.68 for Astra, and $3.18 for GPT-6.2 Sol, which was the cheapest among the top 10. Astra used the fewest output tokens per task (91,000 on average).

In the Coding Agent Index, GPT-6.2 Astra scored 53 points, the same as the previous model, but the price per task dropped by 33% from $7.63 to $5.12. This is larger than the indicated unit price reduction of 20%.

![Scales weighing two bills in a hallway lined with server racks — Image · AI Illustration](/assets/img/articles/ai-price-per-task-shift-2026-11.jpg)

## There is a difference between a decrease in price and a decrease in cost.

The above numbers are mostly benchmarks chosen by the company that created the model. Independent evaluations confirm cost improvements but do not confirm the 'best of all' claim. In the Coding Agent Index, the GPT-6.2 Astra scored 53 points, the same as the previous model, and the Sol dropped 3 points. The percentage of students who filled in what they did not know in difficult factual questions with guesses was 59% at maximum inference.

Some of the prices are limited-time. Tencent applies promotional prices until November 30th.

The other side of the cost also moved. Tokens are getting cheaper, but GPU and power are not. This is why batch discounts and self-accelerators are coming out.

In Korea, regulations moved first. On November 20, the Ministry of Science and ICT announced the enactment of the Enforcement Decree and Enforcement Rules of the Special Act on Promotion of the Artificial Intelligence Data Center Industry. With the goal of implementation on March 10, 2027, data centers under 50 MW in non-metropolitan areas are exempt from power system impact assessment, and include batch processing of licenses and special zone standards. For service companies that purchase models, the unit price will be reduced, and for companies that run the model themselves, power and land will remain the main costs.

## Not confirmed

The displayed unit price and the per-assignment value are different numbers. A model that looks cheap may actually be expensive in billing, and vice versa. There is no publicly available data yet to determine whether the November cut was due to competition or the result of an actual drop in inferred costs.

It is the bills that remove tokens from the price list, not the companies. The model that completes the same task in fewer tokens wins, and the difference is recorded in the per-task value, not the unit price tag.

title: Oil prices fell 22%, but ABS fell only $25 — the expiration date of the bottom created by 55.7%
deck: On November 20, the Asian ABS offer was between $1,690 and $1,695 per ton, down $25 for the week. During the same period, styrene monomer, a raw material, fell by $48 in three days, while Brent fell by 4% and WTI by 6%. What supported the price was not the cost but China's production cuts. The ABS operation rate was 55.7%, and fell to 51% in October. However, on November 21, Jilin Petrochemical's new line returned to normal load.
author: Insight Brief Editorial Room
summary: On November 20, Asian ABS offers fell $25 (1.5%) on the week to $1,690 to $1,695 per ton in CFR Far East and $1,740 to $1,745 per ton in Southeast Asia. During the same period, styrene monomer (FOB Korea), a raw material, fell $48 (3.8%) in three days to $1,227 to $1,237, Brent was $91.98 (-4.03%), and WTI was $83.21 (-6.04%).

What supported the price was China’s production cut. In November, China's ABS operation rate fell to 55.7% for two consecutive weeks and to 51% in October. The average profit of China's ABS industry in 2026 was -960 yuan per ton, with only a surplus in March when the war broke out, and production in October was 52.03 million tons, down 21.5% from the same month of the previous year.

So the floor is below the cost line. The ABS standard price of 11,683 yuan on November 20 is below the theoretical cost of 13,271 yuan, and the average price of East China ABS is 1,183 yuan lower than the unit price of acrylonitrile. On November 21, Jilin Petrochemical's new ABS line was reported to have entered normal load, creating a variable for production reduction reversal.
body:
On November 18, Asian styrene monomer (SM) was $1,250 to $1,260 per ton FOB Korea, down $25 from the previous day, and on the 20th, it was $1,227 to $1,237. It lost $48 (3.8%) in three days. ABS fell $25 for the week. Asian ABS offers on November 20 are CFR Far East $1,690 to $1,695 and CFR Southeast Asia $1,740 to $1,745. While raw materials fell 3.8%, ABS fell 1.5%. What created this gap was not cost, but China's operating rate.

## It collapsed starting from the cost.

The starting point is Confucianism. Brent fell nearly 20% in less than a week from $117.64, the second highest closing price since the start of the war. Hormuz crude oil flows have returned to pre-war levels, raising expectations of oversupply. On November 19, the January Brent contract was $91.98, down 21.8% from the high, down 4.03% on the week, and WTI was down 6.04% at $83.21. It's been 3 weeks in a row.

Intermediate goods react faster. Benzene FOB Korea fell $25 per day to $930-940 per ton on the 18th. Acrylonitrile (AN)'s operating rate has fallen to around 70%, and butadiene (BD) has lost power by Asian standards while its factory prices in South China remain unchanged.

## Floor made by 55.7%

China's ABS factories are operating less frequently. According to long-term information, the operation rate in November was 55.7% for two consecutive weeks. In October, it fell to 51%, hitting the lowest level of the year, and the monthly average of 52.34% in October was 15.54 percentage points lower than the same month last year.

This can also be confirmed for each facility. Yulong Petrochemical is below 20%, Yongcheng Petrochemical is 40%, and Zhangzhou Qimei/Ningbo Taihua is 50%. 200,000 tons of Shandong Haijiang did not return until November 20th.

The reason for stopping is not price defense but deficit. Longzhong Information calculated the average profit of China's ABS industry in 2026 to be -960 yuan per ton. Only March, when the war broke out, was a surplus, and the rest were deficits. In October, it was -1,373 yuan, profit margin -11.15%, and production was 52.03 million tons, down 21.5% from the same month last year.

![ABS pellets piled up in front of a petrochemical complex at night — What supports the price is not the cost, but the operation rate of 55.7%. Image · AI illustration](/assets/img/articles/abs-55-percent-supply-floor-2026.jpg)

## The floor is below the cost line

Rather than holding on, it is closer to a position where there is no choice but to endure. On November 20, the ABS standard price of Shengyisha was 11,683 yuan, down 9.08% from 12,850 yuan at the beginning of this month. The theoretical cost is 13,271 yuan, and the average cost in October according to Longzhong Information is 13,691 yuan. Spot is below cost in both calculation methods.

The reversal with the raw materials is more noticeable. The average price of East China ABS in mid-November was 11,716 yuan, which was 1,183 yuan lower than the price of a ton of AN at 12,900 yuan. This means that one ton of ABS is cheaper than one ton of main raw material. The current bottom is not a line supported by cost, but a line created by factories taking losses and operating less.

## The reduction is reversible

Since the equipment was not built but temporarily lowered, there is almost no cost to restore it. On November 21, Polymer Update reported that Jilin Petrochemical's new ABS plant was operating at 'near normal load', and on the same day it also reported that the company's other lines were still at low load. Jilin Petrochemical increased its total ABS capacity to 1.8 million tons with a new line in December last year.

The same goes for raw materials. CCF Group wrote in its report from November 16th to 20th that expectations for increased supply have increased due to increased utilization rates due to improved margins. China's SM operation rate was 65.2% from November 13th to 19th, up from 61.8% at the end of October.

December schedules are mixed. Jihwajeyang will begin maintenance on the 50th in early December, but AN 1 (260,000 tons) storage petrification unit will return after maintenance on the 16th. Although there is no capacity expansion, the reduction in production will be returned even if the operation rate of the remaining lines increases.

## Korean calculation

LG Chem's petrochemicals and Lotte Chemicals' basic chemicals posted operating losses of 175.6 billion won and 216.6 billion won, respectively, in the third quarter. Petrochemical exports in October increased 27.5% to $4 billion, but volume decreased 6.8% to 2.73 million tons and unit price rose 36.9% to $1,465 per ton. This is an optical illusion of the month when Dubai oil rose 70.4%.

On top of that, China’s change of direction overlaps. iM Securities said in a report on November 23 that China has turned into a net exporter of synthetic resins this year, and ABS is also on the threshold. China's ethylene capacity is 42 million tons per year this year, up 50% from 2021. China's ABS exports increased 76.6% from January to April to 169,900 tons, and China's ABS production of 5.86 million tons in 2024 is 3.5 times that of Korea (1.68 million tons).

## What's left

The immediate variable is the operation rate in December. While production cuts remain in place, ABS prices are likely to move sideways below the cost line. The problem is that the production cuts are maintained due to losses, and when margins return even slightly, the first thing to return is the operating rate. Although the decline in oil prices is favorable to buyers, home appliance and automobile parts companies have not yet received the full amount of the decline.

factCheck.title: Fact check & sources
factCheck.note: For the Asian ABS offer (CFR Far East $1,690~1,695, CFR Southeast Asia $1,740~1,745, weekly -$25), Thepu Plastic Net used the weekly valuation dated November 21, and the '元/吨' notation in the same data appeared to be an error in dollar notation, so it was written in dollars to match the unit price notation (-$25/ton). SM connected the Polymer Update evaluation on November 18 (-$25 compared to the previous day) and the Longzhong Information and Kemp Price Hub evaluation (-$18) on November 20, and '$48 in three days' is from the evaluation on November 17 ($1,275-1,285, reversed from the article that it fell $25 compared to the previous day in the evaluation on November 18). This is the median difference as of November 20th ($1,227 to $1,237). Brent $117.64 is the value marked by ChemOrbis as the ‘second highest closing price since the start of the war,’ and the date was not specified as the exact settlement date could not be confirmed. 21.8% calculated at $91.98 at the November 19 closing price compared to $117.64. China's ABS utilization rate of 55.7% is the weekly tally of Longzhong Information (November 13-19), and October's 51% is the lowest of the year for the same agency. The industry average profit -960 yuan/ton is the cumulative average in 2026, -1,373 yuan is the single month value in October, the period varies. ABS theoretical cost varies depending on the calculation agency (Sunta Chemical's 13,271 yuan, Longzhong Information's October average of 13,691 yuan), so the two values ​​are written together. The comparison that ABS is cheaper than acrylonitrile is the East China spot price (mid-November). The exact capacity of Jilin Petrochemical's new ABS line is divided into 200,000 tons (new main body method) and 600,000 tons (reported to be in operation in November 2025) depending on the data, so the text does not specify the capacity, but only reports the first Chinese report that the total capacity was 1.8 million tons with the completion of the main body method line. Securities company Forecast (iM Securities) cited it as a report on November 23 without seeing the original text of the report.
