title: From ‘possession’ to ‘distribution’ — Actual coordinates of Korea’s stablecoin payment infrastructure ahead of the registration system on December 3
deck: On the 23rd, the Cucon-Triple A business agreement and InX's name change (Korea Onchain Infrastructure) came out on the same day. Ahead of the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act virtual asset transfer business registration system that goes into effect on December 3, we have separated and organized how far the domestic payment infrastructure has come and what has not yet been confirmed.
author: Insight Brief Editorial Room
summary: On November 23, Cucon announced a stablecoin payment and settlement business agreement with Triple A. The scope of this agreement, which was signed at the Singapore Fintech Festival on the 19th, includes services for charging USDT and USDC with won-based Bipple Money for domestic QR payments and ATM won withdrawals, joint verification of global remittance and settlement models, and seeking a two-way payment network between Korea and ASEAN.

On the same day, Inx operator changed its name to Korea On-Chain Infrastructure and revealed the results of the first stage of PoC on Circle's Arc testnet, showing USDC deposit of 44 seconds, withdrawal of 18 seconds, and less than 1 cent per transaction. The company has applied for registration as a virtual asset transfer business with the Ministry of Finance and Economy in accordance with the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act, which takes effect on December 3.

The revised Foreign Exchange Transactions Act, which takes effect on December 3, requires businesses transferring virtual assets across borders to pre-register and report to the Bank of Korea's foreign exchange computer network, and stipulates imprisonment for up to 3 years or a fine of up to 300 million won for violations. The two companies' service launch dates, fees, and registration approval have not yet been confirmed.
body:
Write the conclusion first. From December 3, only ‘registered businesses’ will be able to allow virtual assets to cross the border in Korea. However, in the same week, two domestic payment infrastructure companies released empirical results showing that “USDC is recharged, paid with QR at stores, and won in won at ATMs.” The closing of regulatory doors and the opening of services coincided at the same time. Based on the announcement and figures confirmed on November 23, this article divides and organizes what is true and what is not yet true.

## On November 23rd, two companies said the same thing in one day

On the 23rd, Cucon announced that it had signed a stablecoin-based global payment and settlement business agreement with Triple-A, a Singapore digital asset payment company. The agreement ceremony was held at the Singapore Fintech Festival 2026 on the 19th. There are three scopes of cooperation revealed by the two companies.

- Operation and expansion of stablecoin charging, QR payment, and ATM won withdrawal services
- Joint design and verification of stablecoin-based global remittance and settlement model
- Seeking two-way payment and settlement business linking Korea and ASEAN

At the center are Cucon’s electronic wallet Bpple Wallet and the X Stablecoin platform. When a user recharges USDT/USDC with won-based Bipple Money, payment is made with QR at domestic stores and won is withdrawn from ATMs. Coocon explained that it was designed so that foreigners who do not have a domestic bank account can use it through passport-based identity verification (KYC). Coocon has previously linked overseas payment methods such as Alipay Plus, WeChat Pay, Union Pay, and Indonesian QRIS to the domestic QR payment network, and has announced that payments can be made at approximately 500,000 QR affiliated stores linked to Seoul Pay.

On the same day, Infinity Exchange Korea, the operator of the exchange INEX, announced that it had changed its name to ‘Korea On-Chain Infrastructure’. Corporate registration was completed on November 5, and the exchange service name and exchange business will be maintained. The technology verification results disclosed by the company are specific.

- On the 22nd of last month, the first stage of technology verification (PoC) was completed on ‘Arc’, a blockchain specialized in payment and settlement of USDC issuer Circle.
- Based on testnet, it takes 44 seconds to deposit USDC from another blockchain into Ark and 18 seconds to withdraw it back to the outside.
- Network cost less than 1 cent per transaction
- In September, ‘Circle Mint’, a USDC issuance and redemption window for institutions, was approved, and onboarding and corporate due diligence (KYB) of Stripe subsidiary Bridge was recently completed.
- Apply for registration as a virtual asset transfer business with the Ministry of Finance and Economy in line with the cross-border digital asset transfer system that will be implemented on December 3

The sentence that runs through the announcements of the two companies is the words of Lee Jae-gang, CEO of Korea Onchain Infrastructure. “The core of stablecoins is distribution, not holding.” Both companies say that they will not be in the business of buying and selling assets, but will establish a channel for assets to come and go.

## What changes on December 3rd?

The revised Foreign Exchange Transactions Act (Act No. 21714), promulgated on June 2, 2026, will come into effect on December 3. This law newly defines ‘virtual asset transfer business’ and requires prior registration with the Ministry of Finance and Economy from virtual asset business operators who wish to perform this business. Registration requirements include completing reporting under the Specific Financial Information Act, being connected to the computer network of related organizations such as the Bank of Korea's foreign exchange computer network, and having computer facilities and professional manpower.

The revised enforcement ordinance further specified the requirements. Each business office must have at least two people with two years of experience in foreign exchange work or who have completed training, and the target work includes not only sales and exchange, but also storage and management, brokerage and mediation, and transfers between domestic virtual asset business operators and personal wallets (non-custodial wallets). The Ministry of Finance and Economy stated that transfers to and from personal wallets are interpreted to have ‘substantially the same effect as transfers between the Republic of Korea and foreign countries,’ regardless of the residence of the wallet owner.

Registered businesses must notify the foreign exchange information concentration agency (Bank of Korea foreign exchange computer network) of cross-border transfer details. This data is shared with the National Tax Service, Korea Customs Service, Financial Supervisory Service, and Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU). If you operate without registration or with false registration, you will be subject to imprisonment for up to 3 years or a fine of up to 300 million won (up to 3 times the value of the object if it exceeds 300 million won), and virtual assets will be added to the list of confiscation and collection targets. There are no transition regulations, so registration must be completed by December 3, and the Ministry of Finance and Economy recommended that registration documents be submitted by November 12, three weeks before the registration processing date.

To summarize, it is as follows. The announcements made by the two companies this week were not made because regulations permitted it. It is closer to an application to preoccupy the passage before regulations begin.

## Background in numbers — balance decreased, participants increased

The recent trend in the stablecoin market is ‘reduction in size, expansion in participation’. According to a November 21 report citing the RWA.xyz tally, as of November 20, the stablecoin market capitalization was $273.87 billion, down 6.16% from the previous month, and monthly transfer volume plummeted 59.01% to $4.38 trillion. On the other hand, the number of monthly active addresses increased by 6.08% to 61.63 million, and the number of holders increased by 2.07% to 308 million.

The concentration of currency composition is also confirmed numerically. According to Moody's Ratings, 99.5% of the world's stablecoin market capitalization is dollar-linked assets, and more than 80% of the issuance volume is distributed on two networks, Ethereum and Tron. In the same data, the International Monetary Fund (IMF) calculated that as of 2024, of the total cross-border transfers of USDT and USDC, transfers between developed countries and emerging countries account for 52%, and transfers between emerging countries account for 34%.

The tokenized asset market is also heading in the same direction. As of November 20, the total market capitalization of RWA on-chain was $41.42 billion, down 2.47% from the same time last month, but the number of holders increased by 2.42% to 5.85999 million. While the balance decreased, the number of users increased.

The movements of the banking sector overlap here. JP Morgan and Singapore DBS have launched a service that allows companies in the United States and Singapore to exchange dollars regardless of bank business hours by connecting the two companies' blockchain payment networks. This is a case of using ‘tokenized deposits’ rather than stablecoins, and it can be read as a flow in which the subject of payment is expanding from exchanges to banks.

## What precedents tell us

A similar announcement was made fifteen days ago. On November 18, Galaxia Money Tree, together with Gwangju Bank, Hyosung TNC, and Hyosung Japan, verified the Korea-Japan two-way remittance procedure based on actual trade contracts. The onramp, which confirms won deposits and converts them into stablecoins, and the offramp, which connects stablecoins to won payment, were added to the actual contract structure. However, it was a test environment in which no actual funds were exchanged.

On the same day, NHN KCP announced that it had connected Google's AI agent payment standard AP2 and web payment protocol x402 to its payment infrastructure and verified the flow from payment request to stablecoin settlement. This is a case aimed at an environment where AI pays based on conditions instead of a person opening a payment window.

What the three cases have in common is that they are all ‘empirical’. Since 2019, there have been several demonstrations of blockchain payments in Korea, but cases that led to actual sales and users were rare. The key this time is not technology, but registration, settlement, and fee structure.

## Not confirmed yet

- Service launch timing and fees of Coocon and Triple A. At the business agreement stage, only the types of supported assets and plans to expand franchises and ATMs were disclosed.
- Whether or not Korea Onchain Infrastructure has been approved for registration as a virtual asset transfer business. Only the application was confirmed, and the issuance of the registration certificate was not confirmed. Ark PoC is also in testnet stage 1, and mainnet small amount verification is scheduled.
- List of businesses registered by December 3rd. Neither the financial authorities nor the industry disclosed it.
- Meaning of ‘1 cent’. This is a network fee and is different from currency exchange spreads or withdrawal fees.
- KRW stablecoin issuer. There is no confirmed content until the Financial Services Commission's Virtual Asset Committee releases the government bill for the Framework Act on Digital Assets on the 24th.

## Checkpoints to check

First, who are the businesses that completed registration before December 3rd? For routes that are not registered, cross-border transfer operations are restricted.

Second, testnet numbers and actual service speed are different. We need to see if the mainnet micro-verification results and success rate are disclosed.

Third, costs are divided into three stages. Network fees, currency exchange spreads, and withdrawal fees must be combined to arrive at the actual cost of use.

Fourth, as the payment market grows, the number of recommendations such as ‘exchange money on your behalf’ or ‘just connect your wallet and you can make money’ also increases. The same warnings are repeatedly posted in domestic coin information rooms.

What was confirmed this week was the declaration that a passage would be laid and its conditions. Whether money actually flows through that channel can be determined by the registration list after December 3 and the fee schedule for the first commercial service.

factCheck.note: The contents of the law were cross-checked with the provisions of the Foreign Exchange Transactions Act (Law No. 21714, promulgated on June 2, 2026, implemented on December 3, 2026) by the National Legislation Information Center, the Ministry of Finance and Economy's 2026-10-07 legislative notice press release, and the legal newspaper commentary (2026-11-12). The enforcement ordinance amendment is at the legislative notice stage, and the wording may change during the review process of the Cabinet Office and the Ministry of Government Legislation, so it is referred to as an ‘amendment bill’ in the main text. The announcements of the two companies are based on Electronic Newspaper, Digital Times, Digital Today, and Financial News reports (2026-11-23) citing each company's press releases, and the figures (44 seconds, 18 seconds, less than 1 cent) disclosed by the companies may differ from actual service performance as a result of technical verification in the testnet environment. Stablecoin/RWA market capitalization and transfer volume are values ​​reported by Decoin News (2026-11-21) citing the RWA.xyz tally, and may vary depending on the tallying agency and standard time. Moody's 99.5%, Ethereum and Tron over 80%, and IMF cross-border transfer proportion were quoted in the EToday (Nexblock) 2026-11-22 report. Cucon's 'approximately 500,000 QR affiliates linked to Seoul Pay' is a standard figure for linking existing overseas payment methods as reported in the Information and Communication Newspaper on 2026-11-19, and is not a value confirmed to be applied to stablecoin payments. The Korean won stablecoin issuer, the launch schedule and fees of the two companies, and whether registration was approved were left as 'unconfirmed' as there was no public data at the time of writing this article.

title: Three branches of 162.3 trillion won — 45 trillion will be spent, 12 trillion will reduce debt, and 104 trillion will remain.
deck: Ten days before the legal deadline on December 2, the ruling and opposition parties fought over the 162.3 trillion won future response fund. However, the money actually spent next year is 45.4 trillion won, and 104.4 trillion won is surplus funds not included in total expenditures. The government's management fiscal balance of -0.1% and national debt ratio of 48.3% are calculated from the omission of 104 trillion.
author: Insight Brief Editorial Room
tags: National Assembly Budget and Accounts Committee
summary: The 2027 national tax revenue budget is 584.4 trillion won, the largest ever. Corporate tax increased by 115.4 trillion won (113.9%), accounting for 68.3% of the total tax revenue increase, and when the increase in income tax is added, it is 93.9%. The Future Response Fund of 162.3 trillion won is calculated by combining the amount exceeding the trend line of the 6.2% average annual growth rate of domestic taxes from 2015 to 2025 and the share of local allocation taxes and education grants from this tax revenue.

Among the funds, the actual project cost to be executed next year is KRW 45.4 trillion (KRW 4.7 trillion for frontier-level AI development, etc.), KRW 12.5 trillion will be allocated to reduce new issuance of government bonds, and KRW 104.4 trillion will be set aside as spare funds. Since this reserve is not included in total expenditure, the growth rate of total expenditure in 2027 is calculated to be 12.8%, the managed fiscal balance to GDP is -0.1%, and the national debt ratio is calculated to be 48.3%.

The National Assembly's Budget and Accounts Committee will intensively review the fund project on the 23rd and open a subcommittee meeting from the 24th. The People Power Party demands a full cut and restoration of 30.5 trillion won in local allocation taxes, while the Democratic Party of Korea demands that the original plan be defended. If there is no agreement by the legal deadline of December 2nd, there remains a possibility that the Democratic Party of Korea will handle the majority of the seats alone.
body:
Write the conclusion first. The remaining ten days until December 2 are not a fight over whether to raise 162.3 trillion won. It is a battle over where the money is calculated and where it goes.

The National Assembly's Budget and Settlement Special Committee will intensively review the Future Response Fund project at the Budget Plan Coordination Subcommittee on the 23rd, and will hold a subcommittee from the 24th to begin final coordination. The Democratic Party of Korea said it would defend the 820.9 trillion won bill and the establishment of a new fund, while the People Power Party demands a full cut and restoration of the local allocation tax. This is why the subcommittee has postponed only this item since the 16th.

## 584.4 trillion minus 162.3 trillion

The national tax revenue budget for 2027 is 584.4 trillion won. It is the largest ever, 40.7% more than the 2026 supplementary budget of 415.4 trillion won and 49.8% more than the main budget. Of the increased KRW 168.9 trillion, corporate tax accounts for 68.3%, at KRW 115.4 trillion (113.9% increase, KRW 216.7 trillion). Income tax will increase by 43.2 trillion won to 180 trillion won, of which earned income tax will increase by 29.2 trillion won (39.9%) and dividend income tax will increase by 8.5 trillion won (183.6%). Combining the two taxes accounts for 93.9% of the increase in tax revenue.

The size of the fund also comes from this number. The government calculated the amount exceeding the 2027 trend line drawn at an average annual growth rate of 6.2% in domestic taxes from 2015 to 2025, and the share of local grants and education grants that will be automatically distributed to local governments and offices of education in relation to that amount, at KRW 162.3 trillion. **In other words, 162.3 trillion won is not the value of the necessary business, but the amount by which the semiconductor industry has pushed tax revenues above the trend line.** There was also an observation that the fund could grow to around 200 trillion won if more excess taxes are collected this year in the September revenue re-estimate.

## 45 trillion will be spent, 12 trillion will be reduced, and 104 trillion will be left over.

The actual project cost to be executed next year is 45.4 trillion won. This includes KRW 4.7 trillion for frontier-level AI development, KRW 3.8 trillion for three types of marriage, childbirth, and childcare packages, and KRW 3.5 trillion for local future growth support. 12.5 trillion won will be transferred to the Public Fund Management Fund and used to reduce new issuance of government bonds. The remaining 104.4 trillion won will be set aside as surplus funds to prepare for tax revenue shortfalls.

This is where the budget numbers diverge. In 2027, total income will increase by 30.4% to 880.8 trillion won, but total expenditure will only increase by 12.8% to 820.9 trillion won. This is because the 104.4 trillion won saved is not included in total expenditures. As a result, the managed fiscal balance to GDP improves from -3.9% to -0.1% this year, and the national debt improves to 1,519.8 trillion won or 48.3% of GDP.

> If 104.4 trillion won had not been set aside as surplus funds, the expenditure increase rate would have exceeded 27%. — Park Chang-hwan, Budget Director, Ministry of Planning and Budget, briefing on September 1, 2026

The People Power Party estimates the actual size, including surplus funds, to be 925.3 trillion won (27.1%).

![Budget archives at the end of the fiscal year — books are stacked and execution must be completed within the year. Image · AI illustration](/assets/img/articles/mirae-fund-162-trillion-split-2026.jpg)

## Three places of divergence

The first is the purpose of 104.4 trillion won. The People Power Party argues that by repaying existing government bonds with 3.3 trillion won instead of issuing deficit government bonds of 100.1 trillion won, the national debt can be reduced by 116.9 trillion won and interest savings of more than 3 trillion won per year can be achieved. The government is reducing the amount of issuance by only 12.5 trillion won, saying that a sharp reduction in the amount of issuance will shake the government bond market, and managing the surplus funds with the goal of earning a profit higher than the 3-year Treasury bond interest rate.

The second is the local allocation tax. An estimate was made at a public hearing at the National Assembly on the 3rd that if the fund transfer amount is first subtracted from domestic taxes, even if the statutory grant rate of 19.24% is left as is, next year's local grant tax will be 30.5 trillion won less than the 100.2 trillion won under the current formula. The local government's counterargument is that local accounts within the fund have a set purpose and cannot be exchanged for autonomous financial resources.

Third is control of the National Assembly. The fund management plan can be changed up to 30% of the fund's business expenditures without National Assembly approval. As of next year, it is 13.62 trillion won. There is no limit or prior approval for transfers to make up for general accounting tax revenue deficits.

## Number remaining after December 2nd

Passing the original bill, cutting the total amount, or lowering the limit on voluntary change — whichever it is, there are three things that remain in December. Whether the 45.4 trillion won project undergoes review by the standing committee again, how much government bonds are issued, and how the local allocation tax is distributed. The quantity of government bonds issued is determined by the government bond interest rate, and the interest rate is then transferred to the recalculation of the loan interest rate. Establishing a new fund requires the enactment of the Future Response Fund Act, and the bill will be reviewed separately from the budget plan through a public hearing in the National Assembly's Finance and Economic Planning Committee on the 3rd.

Of the past five years, the budget proposal met the legal deadline only once last year. The previous four years were all late on December 3rd, 24th, 21st, and 10th. What has not yet been confirmed is the final amount as of December 2 and whether the funds will remain.

title: 1,066 units Next is 30 minutes — the value of teaching humanoids has changed
deck: Korea ranks first in robot density in the world with 1,066 robots per 10,000 people. However, this month's number was not logarithmic but time. 40% zero shot became 95% in 30 minutes, and 96% came from the Mercedes line.
author: Insight Brief Editorial Room
summary: According to the International Federation of Robotics (IFR)'s 'World Robotics 2026' (November 12), Korea's manufacturing robot density ranks first in the world at 1,066 units per 10,000 workers. Singapore has 873 units, Germany 469 units, Japan 452 units, the US 323 units, China 193 units, and the world average is 152 units. However, there was a decrease of 154 units (12.6%) from the Korean figure of 1,220 units released by IFR in April 2024 data, and among the countries with figures in both announcements, Korea was the only one to go down.

Google DeepMind released Gemini Robotics 2.5 on November 10 and announced that Aptronic Apollo 2 performed kitting of automobile parts at the Mercedes-Benz production lines in Kecskemet, Hungary and Sindelfingen, Germany with a 96% success rate. In 200 tasks, the success rate is improved by 30-100% compared to the previous one, and the performance speed is reduced by 20-30%. It is the result of a single task that the company specifies as a proof of concept (PoC).

NVIDIA GR00T 2 had a zero shot score of 40% in 50 tasks that the target robot had never learned, and the score was 95% after 30 minutes of fine tuning on one RTX 5090 with 5 demonstrations (less than 3 minutes of data) per task. For preliminary learning, 402,730 hours of human first-person video, 10,184 hours of gripper demonstrations, and 23,500 hours of robot remote control were used.
body:
Korea is already the country with the largest number of industrial robots in the world. However, the news in the robotics industry in November 2026 was not about deploying more robots, but about the time it takes for robots to learn new tasks. It is organized into four numbers.

## 1,066 units — 1st place, down 13%

In 'World Robotics 2026' announced by the International Federation of Robotics (IFR) on November 12 (local time), Korea's manufacturing robot density ranked first in the world at 1,066 units per 10,000 workers. There are 873 units in Singapore, 469 units in Germany, 452 units in Japan, 323 units in the US, and 193 units in China, with the world average being 152 units. Looking at the automobile industry alone, it ranks second in the world with 2,812 units, and the non-automotive industry ranks first with 882 units.

The problem is direction. The Korean figure announced by IFR in April this year as 2024 data was 1,220. It decreased by 154 units (12.6%) in 7 months. Among the countries with figures in both announcements, Korea is the only one that went down. The gap with second place Singapore was halved from 402 to 193. IFR did not explain the reason for the decline. The meaning varies depending on whether the number of mobile robots has decreased or the number of workers has increased, but it cannot be determined through public data.

## 96% — success rate off the production line

On November 10, Google DeepMind released Gemini Robotics 2.5, a robot model. In 200 tasks, the success rate was 30-100% higher than the existing model, and the same task was completed 20-30% faster. What stands out is the testing location. At the Mercedes-Benz production lines in Kecskemet, Hungary, and Sindelfingen, Germany, Aptronic's humanoid Apollo 2 completed the 'kitting' task of taking car parts out of containers and placing them on trays in the order of assembly for each vehicle, with a 96% success rate. The workflow is managed by a separate inference model, and 2.5 controls the hands and arms. The company stated that it was a proof of concept (PoC).

> "Used with people in actual industrial settings, that's why we created Apollo. Performance increased significantly within a few weeks of attaching the model, and performance hardly decreased even when moved to the Mercedes-Benz production line." — Jeff Cardenas, Aptronic CEO

Safety figures were also released. The safe task completion rate around obstacles increased by 33% and when people were nearby, it increased by 43%, and Gemini 4 Argon's risky request rejection rate in the robot jailbreak test stand was 99.5% (previously 82%).

## 40% became 95% in 30 minutes

More direct numbers are in the GR00T 2 that NVIDIA released in November. The zero-shot success rate in 50 tasks that the target robot had never learned was 40%. Here, 5 demonstrations per task, less than 3 minutes of robot data, and 30 minutes of fine tuning with one RTX 5090 resulted in 95%.

Pre-training data supports this performance. 402,730 hours of human first-person video, 10,184 hours of hand-held gripper demonstrations (2,897 tasks), and 23,500 hours of robot remote control were mixed into one lump. When we experimented with increasing the proportion of human images from 0% to 100%, the progress rate of Silrobot's 72 tasks increased from 50% to 70%. This means that movements that the robot has not learned with its own body are copied from human videos.

![Humanoid taking car parts out of a bin and placing them on a tray in assembly order — Image · AI Illustration](/assets/img/articles/humanoid-learns-in-30-minutes-2026.jpg)

## 30 minutes to reach the Korean factory

Hyundai Motor Group announced on November 17 that it would conduct field tests at the Global Foundry semiconductor plant using Boston Dynamics' Atlas. This is the first customer outside the car. Atlas is learning parts sequencing work at the application center of Hyundai Motor Group Metaplant America (HMGMA) in Georgia, and the goal is to enter the HMGMA parts sequencing process in 2028. The plan is to deploy 25,000 units at Hyundai Motor Company and Kia factories around the world and produce 30,000 units per year in the United States.

Costs are still greater than benefits. Boston Dynamics' cumulative sales in the first to third quarters of this year were KRW 136 billion, up 29% from the same period last year, but its net loss was KRW 626.6 billion.

If the bottleneck in robot introduction is not the price of the robot but the 'period of teaching the process', the model of learning a new task through five demonstrations lowers the cost of adding different tasks to each line. This is the same reason why Hyundai Motor Company converts skilled workers' gaze, hand positions, and work sequences into data in robot application solution jobs. The hardware has already been sold, and the remaining cost is data.

## Not confirmed

Four things must be distinguished. 96% is the success rate of concept verification for a single operation, not the operation rate or cycle time of the entire line. A 40% zero shot is a 60% failure rate. Both figures were announced by the company that created the model as its own benchmark. The cause of the decline in IFR's figures for Korea was not disclosed. Robot density is only an indicator of the penetration of automation and is not a proxy for productivity or technological competitiveness.

The number in November moved from ‘several units’ to ‘minutes.’ The 1,066 units per 10,000 people still ranks first in the world, but whether that lead is maintained is determined by the time it takes to teach new tasks rather than the speed at which more robots are deployed.

factCheck.note: All robot-related performance figures are values ​​announced by the companies that created the model (Google DeepMind, NVIDIA) as their own benchmarks, and independent verification results have not been confirmed. In particular, the 30-minute fine tuning is an evaluation of 50 tasks that the target robot has never learned, and 96% of the Mercedes-Benz line is the result of a single task (automobile parts kitting) that the company specifies as proof of concept (PoC). The overall line operation rate, cycle time, and defect rate have not been disclosed. The IFR robot density decreased from 1,220 units announced in April (2024 data) to 1,066 units announced in November (2025 data), but IFR did not explain the reason, and the text did not estimate the cause and only listed two possibilities. IFR also included a caveat that the figures for Korea, Japan, and Germany may be higher than the actual figures due to exports from robot system integration (SI) companies. Boston Dynamics' sales and net loss were quoted from Hyundai Glovis quarterly reports and performance reports, and it could not be confirmed whether these were audited figures directly disclosed by the company. The pre-training data time, such as 10,184 hours (10,184 hours), is based on the scheme released by NVIDIA.

title: Exports double, but ships are empty — 3 weeks when $9,000 collapsed
deck: Exports from November 1 to 20 were $77.4 billion, the highest ever (+101.5%) in the same period, and in the same week, the Shanghai Container Freight Index (SCFI) fell for three consecutive weeks, recording 3,503.78. 49.7% of exports are semiconductors, and half of them go by plane, not ship. In addition, 600,000 TEU ships are being released due to the return to Suez. We have summarized the numbers for each route and how this drop is calculated by the side purchasing the raw materials.
author: Insight Brief Editorial Room
summary: Exports from November 1 to 20, announced by the Korea Customs Service on the 23rd, amounted to $77.4 billion, an increase of 101.5% compared to the same period last year and the highest ever for the same period. Semiconductors accounted for 49.7% of the total at $38.5 billion (up 294.4%), and the trade balance was in surplus at $27.1 billion. In the same week, SCFI fell for three consecutive weeks to 3,503.78 on November 20, falling 4.98% compared to 3,687.35 on October 30.

The routes diverged. In the Americas, it fell by $611 (6.51%) to $8,776 per FEU, breaking the $9,000 line, while the West Coast of the Americas plummeted to $6,711 (-5.63%), South America's Santos plummeted by $3,110 (-15.19%), while the Middle East fell by $6,670 (+1.32%) and the Mediterranean Sea fell by $6,670 (+1.32%). $3,678 (+1.63%) rose for three consecutive weeks. Drewry WCI is also down for 4 weeks in a row (+126% compared to the previous year) at $4,176.

The structural cause is the Suez capitulation. Gemini will sequentially switch three services between Asia and Northern Europe on December 4, December 20, and January 14, 2027, reducing the number of ships per route from 14 to 13 and from 13 to 11. Zeneta calculated that 600,000 TEUs tied up in the Cape of Good Hope bypass have already been released, and Alphaliner estimates the fleet growth rate for 2027 to be 9.2%.
body:
The two numbers came out in the same week, but in opposite directions.

According to the Korea Customs Service on the 23rd, exports from November 1st to 20th amounted to $77.4 billion, a 101.5% increase over the same period last year and the highest ever for the same period. Semiconductors alone accounted for 49.7% of the total at $38.5 billion (294.4% increase). However, in the same week, the Shanghai Shipping Exchange's Container Spot Freight Index (SCFI) fell for three consecutive weeks to 3,503.78. This is a loss of 183.57 points (4.98%) from 3,687.35 on October 30.

It is not a contradiction. This is because exports that are not loaded on ships have increased.

## Half of exports are not loaded onto ships

According to the Korea Customs Service, last year's aviation exports accounted for 0.3% of the total weight, but 39% in value. The maritime cargo was 97.9% by weight, but the value portion was 60%. Semiconductors and server components increase exports by value, not weight.

This year, the focus has become more severe. According to Incheon International Airport Corporation, semiconductors accounted for $338.4 billion, or 73.6%, of Incheon Airport's cargo exports of $459.9 billion from January to September. During the same period, airport cargo volume increased only 5.7% to 2.57 million tons. The amount has more than doubled, but the actual weight moved is almost the same.

The amount of cargo loaded into containers has actually decreased. Incheon Port's container export volume from January to September was 11.83 million tons, a 7.3% decrease from the previous year, with vehicle parts (-16.7%) and machinery (-26.8%) leading the decline. The export boom and the container slowdown are two faces of the same event.

## 3 weeks when $9,000 collapsed

On November 20, SCFI was 3,503.78, down 1.92% from the previous week. The three-week decline is 4.98%. It was divided by route.

- $8,776/FEU during the Americas — $611 (−6.51%)
- West Coast Americas $6,711/FEU — $400 (−5.63%)
- South America (Santos) $3,110/TEU — $557 (−15.19%)
- Europe $2,253/TEU — $38 (−1.66%)
- Mediterranean $3,678/TEU — $59 (+1.63%)
- Middle East (Dubai) $6,670/TEU — $87 (+1.32%)

During the Americas, it fell 13.95% from $10,199 in three weeks, breaking the $9,000 level. Drewry calculated that the World Container Freight Index (WCI) fell for four consecutive weeks to $4,176/FEU (126% higher than the previous year). Shanghai-New York fell 9% to $8,194, a 15-week low, and Los Angeles fell 5% to $7,026, a 12-week low. Conversely, Genoa rose 6% to $4,436, and Rotterdam was flat at $3,496. Shipping companies announced that they would increase the number of cancellations on American routes from 4 to 10 next week, and announced peak season surcharges (PSS) of $1,000 to $1,600 per FEU for Asia, Europe, and the Mediterranean in December.

![Container ship and gantry crane docked at the dock at dawn — The freight rate is not determined by the amount of cargo, but also by the speed at which the ship turns. Image · AI illustration](/assets/img/articles/scfi-suez-return-freight-divergence-2026.jpg)

## Returning ship, unraveling ship

The structural cause of the decline is the Suez closure. Maersk and Hapag-Lloyd's Gemini announced on the 16th that they would divert three services from Asia to Northern Europe (NE1, NE2, NE3) from the Cape of Good Hope via Suez. NE1 is from the Mary Maersk leaving Ningbo on December 4, NE3 is from the Arlette Maersk on December 20, and NE2 is from the Damietta Express on January 14, 2027. The number of ships per route will be reduced from 14 to 13 and from 13 to 11, respectively.

According to Geneta, about 600,000 TEUs of the ships tied up in the Cape of Good Hope bypass have already been released into the market. According to Lloyd's List Intelligence, the number of container ships that passed through Suez in the four weeks until late October was about 3.4 million TEU, which is 60% of the number in October 2023 before the Red Sea incident. In addition, the order backlog calculated by Alphaliner of 15.12 million TEU (43.9% of the operating fleet) approaches 9.2% of the fleet growth rate in 2027. HMM also switched its India-Northern Europe route to Suez, and Premier Alliance switched its two Asia-Mediterranean services starting this month.

## Only the contract fare went in the opposite direction.

While the spot price fell, the contract side held out. On November 20, CCFI was 1,923.21, up 0.2% from the previous week, and Korea Ocean Business Corporation's KCCI was 4,608, down 1.3%. This means that the decline in spot prices ahead of the year-end contract negotiation season has not yet transferred to the contract.

The temperature difference in domestic ports is also in the same direction. According to the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries, the number of containers at Busan Port in the third quarter increased by 11.2% to 6.77 million TEU, but the increase was in transshipment (4.09 million TEU, +20.3%), and import and export decreased by 0.3% to 2.68 million TEU. Middle East import and export volume decreased by 46.3%.

## For the importer, the calculation is the opposite.

The current freight rates are favorable for those purchasing raw materials. For cargo imported under CIF/CFR conditions, the arrival cost is lowered as the sea freight rate decreases. For shippers selling to Europe and the Americas, the drop in freight rates is an improvement in costs, but the direction may reverse depending on the speed of PSS, cancellation of flights, and return to Suez in December. The Middle East and Mediterranean are already the opposite. Zeneta's Peter Sand warned that if Red Sea security deteriorates again, shipping companies could return to the Cape of Good Hope and freight rates could rebound. The current decline is not a confirmed trend, but a conditional calculation depending on which side of the sea the ship is sailing into.

factCheck.note: Freight figures were cross-checked with the Shanghai Shipping Exchange raw index and domestic reports (Maritime News, Shipping News Net). The SCFI composite index was 3,572.33 on November 13 → 3,503.78 on November 20, which is consistent with the original index and reports. The European route freight rate was reported by Maritime News and Forwarder News as $2,253 per TEU, while Get News reported it as $2,238, which is a difference, and adopted $2,253, which is consistent with the original index series report. The expression that SCFI is 'the lowest in several months' was divided into after August 21st (Maritime Newspaper) and after mid-September (Forwarder News) depending on the media, so it was not used in the main text and only the decline and decline for three consecutive weeks were written. The Suez transit ship used about 3.4 million TEU (60% of October 2023) over four weeks according to Lloyd's List Intelligence, and the period was different from the 3 million TEU (September 28 to October 25, about half) in other reports covering the same issue, so it was not listed together. Drewry WCI's valuation is based on November 19th, and some media outlets' expressions as 'the week of November 12th' appear to have been confused with the previous week's valuation ($4,305), so it was summarized as of November 19th. The Korea Customs Service's import and export figures for November 1-20 are provisional and may differ from confirmed figures later. The statement that semiconductors are transported by air was only limited to the extent supported by the Korea Customs Service's statistics by transportation method (39% of air exports last year) and the 73.6% share of semiconductors in Incheon Airport cargo exports, and no data directly counting the air/sea share by item was confirmed.

title: The expansion fund came out five times and did not buy stocks three times — conditions of the card taken out at 4,869
deck: At 8:02 before the market opened on the 23rd, Samsung Electronics pointed to 173,200 won, down 5.41% in the premarket. The government took out the three devices the afternoon before. Reorganizing the increase fund activation system, easing the daily purchase limit for treasury stocks, and monitoring illegal short selling. We examined five cases since 1990 and the calculations of current regulations to determine what conditions are required for the three devices to actually put money into the market.
author: Insight Brief Editorial Room
summary: At 3 p.m. on the 22nd, an emergency market situation review meeting was held at the Seoul Government Complex, presided over by Deputy Prime Minister Lee Hyung-il and attended by Bank of Korea Governor Shin Hyun-song, Financial Services Commission Chairman Lee Eok-won, and Financial Supervisory Service Chairman Lee Chan-jin, and confirmed the reorganization of the capital fund activation system, the relaxation of the daily purchase limit for treasury stocks by 3 months (from the 24th), and special intensive surveillance of illegal short selling. At the Nexttrade premarket at 8:02 on the 23rd, Samsung Electronics was down 5.41% to 173,200 won, and SK Hynix was down 6.02% to 1,046,000 won.

The expansion fund was launched five times in 1990, 2003, 2008, 2020, and 2022, and was actually implemented three times in 1990, 2003, and 2008. In 2020, even though 10.76 trillion won was raised, it was not executed due to a rebound due to individual purchasing, and the same was true in 2022. The Korea Institute of Finance evaluated that the effect of reducing volatility was significant, but the effect of rebounding returns and increasing liquidity was not statistically significant.

The treasury stock card is a measure to change the calculation formula for the daily limit. The current daily limit is the smaller of '10% of the reported acquisition quantity and 25% of the average daily trading volume of the past month', or '1% of the total number of issued shares', and if relaxed, the entire number of reported shares to be acquired becomes the upper limit. However, the limit on distributable profits, the obligation to incinerate within one year of the 2026 revised commercial law, and the company's voluntary judgment limit the actual purchase size.
body:
Write the conclusion first. **Among the three devices that the government brought out on the 22nd, none of them have 'money coming into the market today' yet.** The increase fund is not an injection but is in the stage of refining the activation system, the relaxation of the limit on treasury stocks is a rule change that takes effect from the 24th, and short selling is not a restriction but rather a surveillance.

The numbers before opening on the 23rd were like this. In the Nexttrade (NXT) premarket at 8:02, Samsung Electronics was at 173,200 won, down 5.41% from the previous trading day, and SK Hynix was at 1,046,000 won, down 6.02%. On the 20th, KOSPI closed at 4,869.96, down 267.93 points (5.21%), and KOSDAQ closed at 645.68, down 5.71%. Based on the KOSPI closing price, it is the lowest in 10 months. Afterwards, in New York, the Nasdaq fell 5.28% and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell 10.73%.

## 3 p.m., decided in six hours

The meeting was held at the Seoul Government Complex at 3pm on the 22nd. It is an emergency market situation review meeting, the so-called F4 meeting, presided over by Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Finance and Economy and attended by Bank of Korea Governor Shin Hyun-song, Financial Services Commission Chairman Lee Eok-won, and Financial Supervisory Service Chairman Lee Chan-jin.

The confirmed content is three lines. First, we will immediately begin preparations such as reorganizing the activation system and improving effectiveness so that the stock market stabilization fund can be immediately deployed depending on market conditions. Second, the limit on the number of daily stock purchase orders for listed companies will be relaxed for three months from the 24th (the Financial Services Commission passed the resolution on the 23rd). Third, a special intensive surveillance period for illegal short selling will be operated for three months and trends in credit loans, outstanding transactions, and counter sales will be checked.

The reason the meeting was urgent was because of the timetable. The US market, which was open after KOSPI closed, collapsed further, and over the weekend, KOSPI 200 overnight futures fell an additional 6.99%, and the US-listed Korean ETF (MSCI Korea) fell an additional 8.42%. The decline was to be reflected all at once at the opening price on Monday.

## The expansion fund only bought stocks three out of five times.

A fund’s performance comes before its name. Since 1990, it has appeared five times in Korea, and stocks have actually been purchased three times.

|Year|Size of composition|Compared to the market cap at the time|Actual Execution|Results|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|1990|4.86 trillion won|5.6%|Execution (purchase until the end of 1992)|Failed to rebound for two years, liquidated in 1996|
|2003|400 billion won|0.1%|Execution (from February 3)|Execution date KOSPI +1.44%, KOSDAQ +1.64%|
|2008|KRW 501.5 billion to KRW 515 billion|0.1%|Execution (5 months, KRW 103 billion per month)|Execution date KOSPI +5.8%, KOSDAQ +6.25%|
|2020|10.76 trillion won|0.7%|Not executed|Rebound due to individual buying, no need for funds|
|2022|2020 fund reuse plan|—|Not executed|The announcement alone calms the market|

The last two cases show the nature of recent expansion funds. During the COVID-19 shock in March 2020, the five largest financial holding companies, 18 financial companies, and the Korea Exchange raised 10.76 trillion won, but there were no actual purchases. The market turned around first as individual buying began to increase in April. In October 2022, it was only announced that the 2020 fund would be used, but it did not lead to execution.

Song Min-gyu, senior research fellow at the Korea Institute of Finance, analyzed five cases as event studies in the 2024 Financial Brief and summarized them as follows. The reduction in volatility after the announcement of the expansion fund was statistically significant in the cases of 1990, 2008, and 2020, but the effects of the stock price rebound and increased liquidity were not significant. The size was small at 0.1-0.7% of the market capitalization, and the rebound in 2008 also coincided with the announcement of the US Federal Reserve's plan to purchase bonds and MBS on November 25.

> The increase fund may be helpful in alleviating temporary psychological anxiety, but its effect has not led to a rebound in stock prices or increased liquidity. — Song Min-gyu, “History and Implications of Korea’s Securities Market Stabilization Fund”, 2024

So what the market needs to read from the expansion fund now is the signal, not the purchase volume. In 2008, 515 billion won was 0.1% of the market capitalization, and the record that KOSPI rose 5.8% on the execution date is closer to the fact that the declaration of 'buying at the bottom' changed the sentiment rather than the amount.

## The treasury stock card is a measure that changes the calculation formula.

Relaxing the limit on treasury stock is not a measure to release money to the entire market, but rather a measure to lift the upper limit on the number of buy orders that can be placed per day by each company. The maximum orderable quantity per day under the current regulations (regulations on issuance and disclosure of securities, etc.) is calculated as follows.

- ① 10% of the reported acquisition quantity
- ② 25% of the average daily trading volume for the month before the board of directors’ resolution
- Daily limit = **larger quantity** of ① and ② and **smaller quantity** of ‘1% of total issued shares’

If relaxed, the total number of reported shares to be acquired becomes the upper limit. As an example, for a company with a total of 10 million shares issued, 500,000 shares to be acquired, and an average daily trading volume of 120,000 shares for the past month, the current limit is the larger of ① 50,000 shares and ② 30,000 shares, which is 50,000 shares. The reporting volume ends when 50,000 shares are filled per day for 10 days. Once relaxed, up to 500,000 shares can be ordered per day.

There is a precedent that the same measure was implemented for 3 months from July 7, 2022, and for 6 months during the COVID-19 shock in 2020. However, even if the limit is lifted, the total amount that can be purchased is only within the distributable profits under the Commercial Act, and the actual purchase and speed is at the company's discretion. Since the 2026 revised commercial law mandates that acquired treasury stocks be retired within one year, the purchase is a decision aimed at both protecting the stock price and securing financial resources for retirement.

## Missing cards and remaining variables

The Seoul Economic Daily pointed out on the 22nd that the short selling restrictions were omitted from the measures. Direct regulation, which was mentioned as a means of alleviating volatility, was omitted, and only 'illegal short selling surveillance' was included. Contrary trading is also not a blanket suspension. The collateral maintenance ratio and grace conditions for each securities company are different, so the application is different for each account.

This week’s schedule is heavier than policy. On the 25th, the US October Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index, third quarter GDP, and Beige Book will be released. The market expectation is that PCE is 3.8% year-on-year and core is 3.2%, which is higher than September (3.6%, 3.1%). The possibility of a 25bp hike at the FOMC on December 8-9 is reflected in the futures market at 88.6-91.5%. It is closed on the 26th, which is Thanksgiving Day, and closes early on the 27th, so the same ingredients may be affected more with reduced transaction volume.

Supply and demand are not yet dependent on policy. The Korea Economic Daily reported that 15 trillion won in foreign funds was withdrawn from the KOSPI this month. On the 20th, foreigners net sold 1.142 trillion won, selling for 6 consecutive trading days.

## Three things to check in today’s chapter

1. **Fall after the opening price** — Will the fall of Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix decrease after the pre-market -5~6% is reflected? There was an observation (Telegram information room) that the decline of the two stocks in 24-hour overseas trading had decreased to around 5%, but the starting prices were different.
2. **Whether foreigners sell both spot and futures together** — If spot and futures are sold together, downward pressure on large-cap stocks increases.
3. **Scope of spread of selling** — Will it spread beyond semiconductors to financial, automobile, and industrial goods?

There is a difference between a policy announcement calming investor sentiment and creating continuous buying demand. The five records of the expansion fund left the difference in numbers.

title: The 0.25% point on the 26th is already halfway there — the three numbers that 3.25% makes
deck: A survey of securities companies unanimously predicted that the Monetary Policy Committee would raise the base interest rate from 3.00% to 3.25% on the 26th. However, the loan interest rate rose to 4.88% per annum in September, already reflecting the August increase and the rise in market interest rates. The destination for the remaining share is 1,096 trillion won in floating rate loans, and the one weighing the decision is the neutral interest rate in the mid-2% range.
author: Insight Brief Editorial Room
summary: The Bank of Korea's Monetary Policy Committee is expected to hold its last meeting of the year on the 26th and raise the base interest rate from 3.00% to 3.25%. News 1 surveyed 10 securities companies and found that all of them predicted an increase, and the nine researchers who made F&Guide's predictions also did the same. Real GDP in the third quarter was 1.0% compared to the previous quarter (the Bank of Korea's forecast of 0.3%), and consumer prices and core prices in October were 2.8% each, exceeding the target (2%) for six months.

The weight of the increase is 1,096 trillion won. It is calculated by multiplying the household loan balance of 1896.8 trillion won in the third quarter by the variable interest rate ratio of 57.8% at the end of September. If 0.25 percentage points are added, a new interest of 2.74 trillion won per year is created. However, the interest rate for new home mortgage loans in September has already risen to 4.88% per annum and 5.11% for fixed types, so much of the increase has been pre-reflected.

3.25% is a level that exceeds the nominal neutral interest rate (median mid-2% range) announced by the Bank of Korea. The remaining variables are the US October PCE on the 25th, the Federal Reserve hike in December (88.6% probability), and the exchange rate, which rose to 1,346 won. The next confirmation point is the Monetary Policy Committee's dot plot, revised economic outlook, and December loan interest rate recalculation.
body:
Write the conclusion first. It is highly likely that the base interest rate on the 26th will rise from 3.00% to 3.25%. News 1 surveyed 10 securities companies, and all of them, as well as nine researchers who made F&Guide forecasts, predicted an increase. The problem is where and how much that 0.25% point arrives. **Half of the interest rate arrives first at the loan rate before the decision is made, and the other half arrives late according to the contract's recalculation cycle.**

The Bank of Korea raised the rate to 2.75% in July and 3.00% in August, then unanimously froze it in October. The decision leaves open “the timing and pace of additional increases.” At a press conference at the time, Governor Shin Hyun-song said, “The next interest rate decision will be decided based on the economic growth rate in the third quarter and prices in October.” Real gross domestic product in the third quarter was 1.0% compared to the previous quarter (0.3% predicted by the Bank of Korea) and 3.4% compared to the same period last year. In October, consumer prices were 2.8% and core prices were 2.8%, exceeding the target (2%) for six months since May.

## 26th, split in three lines

The first is the base interest rate, and the second is the ‘K-dot diagram’ that plots the outlook for the next six months of the seven members. The number of committee members who reach 3.75% will determine next year’s path. Third is the revised economic outlook that comes out on the same day. The August forecast was 3.3% for this year and 2.9% for next year, but the IMF raised it to 3.9% on the 17th and KDI raised it to 3.8% on the 18th. The prevailing view is that the Bank of Korea will also raise the rate to the late 3% range.

There are also opposing materials. KB Securities and Korea Investment & Securities believed that one member could express a minority opinion to freeze the decision. The basis is the KOSPI adjustment and slow domestic demand. However, the August meeting was also 6 to 1, and the 1 vote was in favor of taking a closer look at the price trend. If the government's card on the 22nd was aimed at psychology, what the Bank of Korea touches on the 26th is price.

## First number, 1,096 trillion won

Household credit for the third quarter announced by the Bank of Korea on the 18th was 2030.5 trillion won, the highest ever. Among these, household loans amount to 1896.8 trillion won, and the proportion of variable interest rates based on the balance at the end of September is 57.8%. When multiplied, it is 1,096 trillion won. If 0.25% point is applied here, a new annual interest of 2.74 trillion won will be added. A variable interest rate loan worth 300 million won is 750,000 won per year or 62,500 won per month.

The weight has become larger recently. The proportion of new home mortgage loans with variable interest rates jumped from 13.4% in December last year to 65.8% in September. As fixed interest rates became more expensive, borrowers flocked to variable interest rates. A person who chooses a fixed interest rate is free right away, but has already paid an interest rate in the 5% range for that choice.

![Empty seats and nameless plaques in the monetary policy conference room ahead of the base interest rate decision, the gavel on the table and the interest rate scale on the wall — Image · AI illustration](/assets/img/articles/bok-325-november-hike-2026.jpg)

## second number, 4.88% and 3.45%

Loan interest rates move ahead of the base interest rate. In September, the interest rate on home mortgage loans based on new deposits from deposit banks was 4.88% per annum, the highest since April 2012, and the fixed interest rate was 5.11%, exceeding 5% for the first time since statistics were compiled in 2013. Credit loans were 6.49%, and total household loans were 4.96%. The August increase and increase in market interest rates have already been applied to September interest rates.

Deposits also rose, but by less. The savings deposit interest rate was 3.45%, up 0.24 percentage points from a month ago. Subtracting the October inflation rate of 2.8%, it is 0.65% in real terms. The real interest rate on home mortgage loans is 2.08%. The structure of deposits barely beating prices and loans losing more than 2 percentage points is the reason why interest rate increases do not work in the same direction for everyone.

## Third number, mid 2% range

When the base interest rate reaches 3.25%, it exceeds the neutral interest rate that the Bank of Korea has stated itself. Governor Shin said that the median nominal neutral interest rate estimated by the model in the government audit was “mid 2% range,” and Deputy Governor Park Jong-woo said 3.00% was also “the upper end of the neutral range.” The increase on the 26th is a decision that crosses the line of neither suppressing nor heating up the economy and enters restrictive territory.

He also moves. The Bank of Korea is re-estimating that AI investment and the semiconductor boom can raise the potential growth rate and neutral interest rate. At the end of September, the 3-year Treasury bond rate was 4.01%, exceeding the base interest rate by 1 percentage point, and securities companies set the final interest rate at 3.50%, with some setting it as high as 3.75%.

## 25th, and 1,346 won

The US personal consumption expenditure (PCE) price index for October will be released on the 25th, the day before the Monetary Policy Committee meeting. The core PCE forecast is 3.2%, which is higher than September (3.1%). The Chicago Mercantile Exchange futures market reflects the probability of a Federal Reserve hike in December at 88.6%. If the Bank of Korea stops here, the interest rate gap between Korea and the United States will widen, and the exchange rate, which hit 1,346.0 won in night trading on the 21st, will test 1,350 won again. Half of the reason for raising interest rates is inflation, and the other half is the exchange rate.

What has not been confirmed is the decision on the 26th itself. The market sees it as a fait accompli, but the Monetary Policy Committee has not voted on it yet. There are three things to look at in the decision. How many numbers of 3.75% are printed on the dot plot, how much next year's prices will rise from 2.3% in the revised forecast, and what number is printed again on the December variable interest rate agreement.

factCheck.note: The base interest rate decision on the 26th has not been made at the time of writing this article. The 3.25% increase is a forecast based on the forecasts of all securities companies and researchers (10 from News 1, 9 from F&Guide, 6 from the Yonhap News survey) and the Bank of Korea's October decision and governor's remarks, and is not a confirmed fact. ‘3.25% is the highest since October 2024’ quoted from The Focus News report. The real interest rate is an approximation obtained by subtracting the October consumer price increase rate (2.8%) from the September new interest rate. The core PCE of 3.2% on the 25th is market expectation, and the 88.6% probability of a Federal Reserve hike in December is reflected in the CME futures market. The nominal neutral interest rate 'mid 2% range' was written together with Governor Shin Hyun-song's remarks during the National Assembly audit and the Bank of Korea's May 2024 estimate report (nominal 1.8-3.3%).

title: The specifications came from Japan and the colors were determined by the bidder — the reason why the fire extinguishers, detectors, and emergency lights remain the same.
deck: There is no provision for ‘red fire extinguishers’ anywhere in the National Fire Agency’s technical standards. The section dealing with the exterior has one line, 'Paint to prevent rust,' which was newly established in 2024, and fire extinguishers in seven colors that have received type approval are already sold. Nevertheless, we followed the rules and statistics to find out why the site was red, where the law actually blocks it, and the size of the organization that handles the standards.
author: Insight Brief Editorial Room
summary: The National Fire Agency’s “Technical Standards for Type Approval and Product Inspection of Fire Extinguishers” does not contain any provisions specifying the color of fire extinguishers. The clause dealing with the exterior is a new line established in July 2024 that states, “The surface must be painted to prevent rust,” and the labeling regulations instead allow the body paint color to be used as the background of the picture. In Japan, the same standard requires at least 25% red on the exterior, so the color is not an inherited standard.

The genealogy of the standard remains numerical. The Fire Service Act of 1958 (Law No. 485) was enacted 10 years after the Japanese Fire Service Act (1948), and the Ministry of Government Legislation's response in 2022 confirmed that the flame retardant performance test specimen of 290 The 7-color fire extinguisher that received KFI type approval is already on sale, and its price is 2.6 times that of the regular 3.3 kg.

The cause of stagnation is not the law but the unit price. The Fair Trade Commission's resolution stated that it is common for construction companies to bid for the lowest price for firefighting work, and a 2013 paper pointed out the fixation of minimum performance standards. What the law actually prevents is by type, and the standards are handled by 288 people at the headquarters of the National Fire Agency, KRW 30.5 billion in fire R&D (1.4% of disaster safety), and 43 people at the National Fire Research Institute.
body:
Write the conclusion first. **There is no provision in the Korean Fire Services Act to make fire extinguishers red.** In the National Fire Agency’s “Technical Standards for Type Approval and Product Inspection of Fire Extinguishers,” the section dealing with appearance is Article 3, No. 15, which was newly established on July 25, 2024.

> Article 3 (General Structure) 15. The surface of the fire extinguisher must be painted to prevent rust. However, fire extinguishers made of corrosion-resistant materials may be excluded.

It just says to prevent rust instead of color. The labeling provisions in Article 38 are more clear. The adaptive fire picture should be a square with a side of 16 mm or more, with a blue or black background, and a white picture. It should be written, “If printed directly on the main container, the background of the picture can be the color of the fire extinguisher’s paint.”

## Skeletons and numbers from Japan

The Korean Fire Protection Act was enacted as Law No. 485 on March 11, 1958 (enacted on June 10). It has been 10 years since the Japanese “Fire Act” was created as Law No. 186 in 1948. It is a common belief that Japanese law was referred to when enacting the law, and in a 2005 article in the Incheon Ilbo, there is a sentence that says, "After imitating the Japanese fire law at the time of enactment of the fire law."

The genealogy is clear in the numbers. In 2022, when the Gyeongnam Fire Department Fire Committee asked the Ministry of Government Legislation the basis for the flame retardant test sample standard (290 The numbers translated based on Japanese rules during the 1973 revision are still used today.

Only the colors are opposite. Japan requires this in Article 37 of the Ordinance Establishing Technical Standards for Fire Extinguishers.

> Article 37 At least 25% of the exterior of a fire extinguisher must be finished in red.

The only exception is residential use. Korea does not have this provision even for business purposes. The genealogy of standards is not the genealogy of colors.

## What the three things determine

Fire extinguisher standards focus on size and material, not color. Container thickness of 0.71 mm or more (Article 11), opening internal diameter of 19 mm (less than or equal to 14 kg of chemical) and 25 mm (exceeding), base welding, and synthetic resin parts are subjected to a 180-day aging test at 100°C (Article 5). The detector's enclosure must be made of non-combustible or flame-retardant material, and the exposed synthetic resin must withstand 7 days at 90℃ and exceed UL94 V-2 (Article 5, No. 4), and the indicator light color is red for operation, green or white for power, and yellow for malfunction (Article 5, No. 31). Portable emergency lighting is not regulated by type approval but by performance certification notice (National Fire Agency Notice No. 2024-30). It turns on automatically when removed from the stand, has a green indicator light and a luminescent sign (100

![Red fire extinguisher shelf and white design fire extinguishers, detector on the ceiling, green emergency light on the wall.](/assets/img/articles/fire-rules-japan-lineage-old-design.jpg)

## It can be changed, but it won’t change

There is no provision preventing changes to the appearance. Article 9 of the 「Rules on Quality Control of Firefighting Supplies」 divides “minor parts and appearance” that do not affect performance into minor changes, and even exempts submission of samples if confirmed only through document review.

It is already on the market. The FIREVO 1.0 kg fire extinguisher receives KFI type approval (Hydrogen 17-23-1) and is sold in seven colors. The price is 46,000 to 55,000 won. A 3.3kg powder fire extinguisher from the same online mall costs 17,420 won. 1 kg of design is three times more expensive than a product with three times more medicine.

The cost of firefighting materials used in the building is determined here. The Fair Trade Commission wrote down its structure in the firefighting and electrical construction bid-rigging resolution (2021-256).

> In the case of fire-fighting and electrical work, the construction company does not perform it directly… It is common to subcontract to partner companies using the lowest bid method.

The decision also states that the construction company “set a low budget for carrying out firefighting and electrical work.” The 2013 paper recorded the results in advance. Fire extinguishers can be sold if they pass only 48 items, so an average of 2.2 million units are distributed over a five-year period, but “excessive price competition, loss of capacity to develop new technologies, and adherence to minimum performance standards” remain.

## Where the law actually prevents

What the standard blocks is not color but type. Type approval for firefighting equipment is mandatory for 32 items, and products without approval cannot be sold or installed (Article 37 (6) of the Act). Even if AI video smoke detection is approved as a flame detector, it cannot replace statutory detectors because there is no video method in the smoke detector type. There are no performance test standards for metal fire (Class D) fire extinguishers, so the Board of Audit and Inspection pointed out the establishment of standards by 2020, and a review was published in an academic journal showing that there are no performance regulations in firefighting laws for suffocating fire extinguishing covers for electric vehicle fires.

## Size of organization covering standards

The number of people at the National Fire Agency headquarters, which manages this standard, is 288 (Appendix 3 to the Enforcement Rules of the Organization, August 2026). At the same time, there were 66,800 firefighters nationwide. The firefighting R&D budget was 30.5 billion won in 2025, or 1.4% of the total disaster safety R&D, and increased to 50.3 billion won in 2026 and 60.8 billion won in the government plan in 2027. The National Fire Research Institute, which opened in 2019, started with 43 people in 1 department and 3 offices.

People change often. With the 2023 rotation plan, more than 90% of those eligible for internal promotion will return to external work, and 1,500 people are expected to change positions every year. Even after it was converted to a national position on April 1, 2020, 91.6% of labor costs are borne by local governments, and the National Assembly Budget Office estimates that this will rise to 94.3% by 2031. In January of this year, the National Assembly Research Service asked, “Is the purpose of the transition to national service being achieved?”

## It is changing

The National Fire Agency and the Korea Fire Industry & Technology Institute announced that they had submitted 53 tasks to the public-private task force in 2025 and reduced the burden of 100 billion won per year by increasing the irregular testing cycle from 6 months to 1 year. The standard for displaying pictograms of international standard designs on fire extinguisher adaptive fire signs was implemented on December 1, 2025, and the National Fire Agency selected this as the best example of active administration in 2026. In 2027, R&D will double in two years to 60.8 billion won.

## One line left

The reason fire extinguishers are the way they are today is not just one layer. There are no provisions binding colors, cosmetic changes are treated as minor changes, and colored fire extinguishers are already approved and sold. What remains is the quantity coming in at the lowest price, a replacement market that is completely divided once the 10-year useful life ends, and a certification wall that does not recognize firefighting facilities outside the list of types. It was not possible to confirm how much each of the three worked without unit cost data. What is more difficult than changing the standard is changing the unit price at which the standard is used.

I only wrote to the extent confirmed by the original text of the law, government documents, Fair Trade Commission resolutions, and statistics. The timing of the start of the red practice could not be confirmed in the literature.
